111.chongun: The east wind melts the ice, and a withered tree meets spring: good fortune has returned at last. Wealth flourishes, and your undertakings succeed, even if late. Little goes out and much comes in; even small accumulations bring substantial results. Misfortune recedes and blessings arrive, putting your mind at ease. A bright moon stands high, illuminating heaven and earth. It is as though spring has returned to an ancient land and revived every plant. Why hesitate over small doubts when planning something great? Meeting a helpful person brings honor to you and peace to your home. You intend to make a major change and begin something new. Doubts and worries may arise, but effort must accompany your plans. Financial prospects open a little in spring and bear fruit in the seventh or eighth lunar month. A good connection helps things fall into place.

months.1: As spring grows warm, a phoenix settles in a nearby pavilion, makes its nest, and raises its young. This image marks troubles fading and happiness returning. A celebration is indicated. Otherwise, increased wealth or additional land will make the household more comfortable.
months.2: Peach and plum blossoms fill the spring garden, each flowering in season. Personal fortune is very favorable, and wealth arrives of its own accord. If financial luck does not materialize, disappointment may follow instead. Even if the outcome is smaller than hoped, keep a generous outlook and wait. The household may gain a member.
months.3: Visit a renowned mountain to gather your thoughts and make a wish, or pray at a temple, and you will find calm. Even when work and business do not go smoothly, maintain a prayerful attitude. An unsettled mind may leave you rushing about without accomplishing much.
months.4: Gossip may arise before your plans succeed, but the reading connects it with improving fortune, so do not worry excessively. As your prospects open, things proceed smoothly. Having passed the steep mountain path and reached the main road, what is there to fear? A broad road lies ahead.
months.5: Watch your words. Even a correct statement can draw you into an argument if you speak carelessly. Keep quiet, as though you had neither seen nor heard what you know. Take the same care when meeting old friends or making new ones away from home.
months.6: Romantic involvement can invite gossip. If you stray from your steady course instead of following it like an ox, others may talk. Avoid seeking new connections or traveling far to launch a new venture. Remaining at ease within your present circumstances is the most favorable course.
months.7: The flowers that bloomed in the second lunar month finally bear fruit. If advancement through an official position does not arrive, your children or family may have cause to celebrate. If neither happens, unexpected adversity is indicated instead. Wait calmly and respond wisely.
months.8: Something seems to take shape, yet its substance remains elusive; there is an element of illusion. Nevertheless, wealth arrives and brings comfort. What first appears difficult and blocked eventually opens up. The greater the obstacle, the greater the eventual joy.
months.9: As time passes, wealth begins to recede. Avoid lawsuits and involvement in other people's disputes. Financial loss is indicated through an unwise association. Be especially considerate with those closest to you; respecting their dignity helps avert trouble.
months.10: You are constantly on the move, as though under the influence of the traveling-horse sign. There is much to do, but personal fortune is unfavorable, so watch your health. Excessive busyness can wear you down. If the difficulty does not affect you personally, a change may occur at home. Handle everything carefully.
months.11: Financial prospects are poor and your mind is unsettled; travel northeast is unfavorable. Staying home and maintaining your existing work is beneficial. Reaching beyond your circumstances out of desire for something else brings difficulty. For peace of mind, limit travel and keep to what you already do.
months.12: Do not start a new venture. Worrying fruitlessly will only exhaust you. Your energy and ambitions are strong, but resources are lacking, so favorable and unfavorable prospects are evenly balanced. More goes out than comes in, and spending feels unrewarding. An undertaking needs both commitment and money.

112.chongun: The full moon begins to wane again. Matters reach a satisfactory conclusion at first, then diminish like the moon after its fullness. Keep to an upright course rather than seeking improper gains. Gaining first and feeling disappointed later is an ordinary part of life. There is a small concern at home, like autumn grass meeting frost. Accept it wisely without panic, and the clouds will clear to reveal the light. Sincere effort brings progress: how could wholehearted work fail to open a way? Even if the household's prospects are unsettled, the traditional reading advises avoiding houses in mourning to keep the mourning-visitor spirit at bay. Wealth is plentiful in spring, so do not miss the opportunity.

months.1: A favorable, smooth beginning may be followed by difficulty, so take care in everything. Seeking your wish in the wrong place is like looking for fish in the mountains. Quietly preserving the family livelihood is favorable; searching for something new will not bring results. Exercise restraint.
months.2: Wealth arrives from the east and north. Even an apparently empty undertaking yields something substantial, leaving you satisfied and at ease. A small investment brings a large return. Unexpected luck arrives without your having sought it, bringing pleasure.
months.3: Guard against theft; if theft does not occur, another worry may arise. Unfamiliar mountains and waters leave you lonely without a close friend. Even in unfamiliar surroundings, you may become involved in another person's affairs and face legal trouble. Avoid disputes that would upset you.
months.4: Financial luck brings a modest gain, accompanied by gossip that you must endure. An unwise association may cause a loss. Although money comes in, little may remain in your hands, making the effort feel empty. Careful speech and sound relationships help you retain the gains.
months.5: You wish to pursue many things but cannot put them into practice as intended. Trivial matters may draw gossip, so take care. Away from home, approach friendships with the caution you would use with strangers. Proceeding without first assessing your abilities is unfavorable.
months.6: At home you feel restless, yet going out brings little benefit. The south is unfavorable, so avoid unplanned travel. You may attract criticism as though you had done much wrong when little has happened. Settle your mind and remain within your circumstances to avoid loss.
months.7: A small boat on the sea feels unsafe even without wind. Difficulties come first, but you recover and ultimately succeed. Heaven grants happiness wherever sincerity reaches. Work wholeheartedly while carefully protecting yourself, and you can overcome hardship.
months.8: Money comes in, but illness may affect your body, so attend to your health. Desiring what lies beyond your circumstances leads to disappointment; assess your position accurately. False accusations or involvement in someone else's quarrel may arise. Exercise restraint so your health does not suffer.
months.9: Jade lies buried in earth: who can see its radiance and value it? If your plans come to nothing, growing worries may be difficult to bear. Thinking only of the hidden jewel while approaching other people's disputes can bring harm. Be careful.
months.10: If your parents are not the source of concern, your own prospects are unfavorable. The traveling-horse sign brings restless movement. Staying home is favorable and travel harmful; maintaining existing work is better than beginning something new. Wisely reduce the number of things you want to do.
months.11: There is no better course than remaining within your present circumstances. New schemes or movement may leave you regretting them. The north is unfavorable, so avoid travel. When the way is blocked, pause, put yourself in order, and rebuild your strength before pushing at fortune's door again.
months.12: You strive to escape your difficulties, but they do not readily resolve. Do not discuss grand ventures with new friends. Losses may grow without any gain. Money dwindles while courage alone remains abundant, leaving favorable and unfavorable prospects evenly balanced. Avoid haste to avoid harm.

113.chongun: An oriole settles on a willow branch, every part of it gleaming like gold. Heaven above and the marsh below suggest light shining across heaven and earth. An auspicious dragon returns, indicating help from a benefactor. If wealth does not arrive, honor may come through your children. Carving stone into a jewel shows that labor brings achievement. Spring brings many happy events, but also gossip, so take care. The traditional text warns of mourning if you do not move house or make a change. Social ease over conversation and drink offers ways to sustain your livelihood. With harmony at home, the heart can rest. Everyone you meet seeks to help you, and an unexpected gain may follow. This year, sincere devotion and a willingness to welcome good fortune can bring light.

months.1: Spring grass meets rain and grows lush and green. Wealth becomes similarly abundant, bringing peace to your life. Fortune returns like spring to the plants, and a happy family event is indicated. Observe the right timing, and your plans can succeed.
months.2: Your undertaking succeeds almost as soon as it begins, bringing great pleasure. Traveling away from home may bring an unexpected gain. Peace in the household helps everything proceed smoothly. You may confidently pursue what you intend to do.
months.3: A family celebration brings joy and ease. If it is not a marriage, it may be a birth. Someone arrives to help, making success unexpectedly easy. The reading particularly names marriage or the birth of a son as possible celebrations for you or your family. Other people bring happiness.
months.4: Water flows into the eastern sea from a source with a long history. You realize that even a small achievement was not made overnight. Misplaced trust in another person's words makes it difficult to benefit. Keep your own judgment. Wealth arrives and your body is at ease.
months.5: Financial prospects are very favorable, bringing unexpected money. Even if illness arises, the reading associates sincere devotion with avoiding adversity. It warns of mourning or, alternatively, fire, and advises care. An unexpected gain brings joy, but another difficulty may accompany it, balancing good and bad.
months.6: The driving wind and rain finally clear, revealing the bright sun and moon. Wealth draws near: little goes out and much comes in. Preoccupation with money may make you neglect home life and cause marital discord. Receive this sudden financial opportunity wisely.
months.7: Financial prospects open widely, and a windfall brings abundance. Wealth and official standing leave you without material lack, but illness remains a concern; do not become complacent. Help from another person may make success unexpectedly easy. Remember that neglect can leave room for illness.
months.8: A helpful person supports you, bringing official recognition or position. You find comfort without worry, and the household may gain a member. It is like finding a candle in a dark night, bright enough to illuminate even the difficult path you have already traveled.
months.9: Timely rain revives the grasses as though they were dancing. Treating people warmly brings considerable benefit. Otherwise, favorable prospects may turn unfavorable. Attend to your relationships as carefully as rain is needed by dry grass.
months.10: A clever plan falls into place and your undertaking succeeds. Your circumstances are free of obvious worry, yet a concern lingers in one corner of your mind. If trouble does not arise at home, gossip may lead to an argument. Know that success through elaborate schemes can carry pain and difficulty.
months.11: A favorable light reaches your door, and an official position may come, even if late. Travel is unfavorable; beware of unexpected trouble. Breaking stone to find gold suggests that effort yields something valuable. The opening to advancement, like gold extracted from rock, is earned through work.
months.12: Harmony and happiness in the household bring benefit. Helpers arrive from both east and west. If you do not pass a formal examination, joy may come through the birth of a son or meeting a good person. Since happiness comes through people, cultivate relationships sincerely.

121.chongun: You pass a leisurely day playing baduk, the sound of the stones ringing clearly. A fish that lived in a well finally heads toward the sea, full of confidence. Family members grow more harmonious each day, and the household is peaceful. Helpful people arrive to support one another, bringing favorable developments. Spring passes comfortably without worry, while summer introduces some obstacles. Yet, like plum blossoms filling a spring garden, wealth and standing come your way, with the prospect of an unexpected gain. Brief clouds disperse and the bright moon returns, making heaven and earth clear. The text also warns that family discord may cause some harm amid otherwise light concerns. Prayer at the beginning of spring, with a readiness to welcome good fortune, is described as especially auspicious.

months.1: A harmonious influence reaches the home, allowing you to enjoy life without worry. With harmony between elders and younger people, neighbors speak well of the household. Blessings draw near, leaving no particular personal concern.
months.2: A fish leaves its well for a broad pond, brimming with new vitality. The family may grow or its property increase, bringing greater wealth. Like peach blossoms in spring, the flowers eventually fall and give way to sound fruit.
months.3: Outwardly there is exuberant laughter, but inwardly worries may arise. Seek a wise balance between the two. Approaching disputes of any kind can bring legal trouble. This month has more adverse than favorable indications, so handle every matter carefully.
months.4: You set out on a road only to find a mountain blocking the way. Arguing over right and wrong invites gossip. Matters seemed slightly awkward in spring, but become blocked as summer begins. Take precautions ahead of time.
months.5: New plans are unfavorable; do not casually devise or rush into another undertaking. Summer resembles being robbed by someone you trust. Carelessness can leave lasting regret. Yet staying home offers little gain, while activity is favorable: sincerity and diligence are the key.
months.6: A long journey or an ambitious plan may expose you to theft. If trouble arises at home, stay and look after it. If you are already traveling or on a particular course, one favorable opportunity is indicated. Watch the timing and consider making a single move.
months.7: Gains made elsewhere let you return home proudly, like someone coming back in splendid robes. An unwise association is unfavorable, so take care in dealings. Obstacles may arise as you begin an undertaking; anticipate them and take precautions.
months.8: Heaven and earth come together in harmony, bringing many benefits. Strong financial fortune turns small accumulations into a substantial achievement. The west is unfavorable this month, so be careful and give your full attention to finishing your work.
months.9: The seventh, eighth, and ninth lunar months bring financial gains, though not large ones. People around you support one another, creating comfort and peace. Benefit is associated with water, particularly fish or seafood. It may be worth directing your attention there.
months.10: A fortunate star shines at the door, suggesting wealth arriving from outside. Avoid romantic entanglements, as the gossip they cause may be difficult to stop. An undertaking may have a beginning but no conclusion, so take care from the outset.
months.11: Be careful in choosing associates; not everyone is well intentioned. Yet a financial windfall may also arise through a connection, so exercise discernment. Meeting a benefactor can bring official recognition and joy.
months.12: The west and south are favorable, with benefits during a venture's flourishing stage and its completion. Good fortune shines at the door, inviting the help of a benefactor. Care in every matter helps avoid loss and brings your work to fruition.

122.chongun: You try to paint a tiger but end up with a dog: an ambitious effort misses its mark. Difficulties and misfortune appear in your undertakings. Reckless action makes success difficult. Moving house or starting something new may bring worry to the household. Plans contain much that is insubstantial, making it easy to spend your strength without achieving anything. Rash movement this year makes harm difficult to avoid. Still, hardship can become easier, and losses can give way to gains, so respond steadily. Wait for autumn, when matters can come to completion. A small initial error becomes a vast distance after a long journey. Material prospects are temporarily blocked; do not let worry about money disturb your peace or keep you awake at night.

months.1: Unrealistic hopes block the way, and work may end in disappointment. Obstacles make every undertaking difficult to complete. Where possible, step back rather than distress yourself. You want many things, but events do not match your wishes. Do not rush.
months.2: Illness is indicated, and the text advises caution around households where someone is ill. Arguments and gossip can also wound the mind. Clouds fill the sky without releasing rain, creating frustration. Yet those clouds will eventually turn to rain.
months.3: Fortune is very favorable, and an undertaking can succeed once begun. Family members come together with one mind, bringing peace at home and ease within. The east and south are ultimately favorable, with benefits in beginning a task and carrying it through.
months.4: Many matters become blocked, and the resulting strain can cause family discord. Summer's reading calls for care because adversity is near. Prayer at a renowned mountain temple is traditionally suggested as a way to avert trouble. Approach each matter with that same attentive spirit to avoid greater harm.
months.5: Money reaches your hands, yet someone departs. The month resembles laughing with joy at first and crying with sorrow afterward. Physical discomfort and an unsettled mind leave you unable to sit or stand at ease. Respond decisively.
months.6: Help from others can finally bring money in, like grass growing greener after rain. Undertakings may succeed and produce a financial return. These are the fruits of calm preparation; gather them without haste.
months.7: Meeting a valued helper brings the joy of achieving your aim. Trouble and illness recede, making room for good events. Remain steady and within your circumstances, and even adversity can turn into a blessing. Recognize that restraint itself can be good fortune.
months.8: Choose your associates carefully. A poor connection can make harm difficult to avoid. Unease at home and worries on every side call for attention to your surroundings. If there is no financial loss, illness is a concern. An orderly daily life is the course advised for avoiding trouble.
months.9: Avoid arguments. Gossip can harm both body and mind, and legal trouble may arise. Take care with lawsuits and documents. With favorable timing absent, forcing an undertaking only adds distress.
months.10: Instead of working with the land and tasks already given to you, you seek a gold mine within them, yet neither approach yields much. Be wary of someone intending harm. Your activities may have a name but little substance, leaving you to expend your thoughts in vain.
months.11: Good fortune arrives to help, offering an unexpected gain. Wisely avoid those who intend harm. The west and north are named as favorable directions, with benefit as you complete work and after its completion.
months.12: This year's financial opportunity lies in the three winter months, so attend to it carefully. Family members unite, bringing peace to the household. Care and restraint allow blessings to arrive of their own accord. A missed opportunity may be difficult to recover, so proceed thoughtfully.

123.chongun: Even after securing new territory, you find its former owner still occupying it. Avoid insubstantial ventures; leaving them alone is wiser. Intention without accomplishment can only add to your hardship. An official position is described as unfavorable, while faithfully tending your existing work, as a farmer tends crops, is beneficial. Blind faith in someone close can lead to failure: test even a familiar bridge before crossing. This year's reading also calls for leaving the old and pursuing the new. Yet stepping onto uncertain ground can shatter hopes placed in a trusted person. It is difficult to foresee an event turning into sudden adversity before your eyes. Take care with disputes, which may lead to litigation and gossip.

months.1: Personal prospects are unfavorable, with concern about trouble at home. Money does not flow freely, and effort does not readily produce a gain. In the first lunar month, trying to hurry matters will not bring the desired result. Wait for the right time.
months.2: Snow covers the world, and frost falls on top of it: weariness and hardship accumulate. If there is no financial loss, someone may depart. Beware of gossip. Carelessness may cause you to lose something and also draw blame from others.
months.3: An old tree meets spring, and light spreads far and wide. The north is unfavorable; care with temporary relationships can help you achieve your aim. Adversity waits ahead, so guard against theft. Remaining within your circumstances brings the good news you have awaited.
months.4: You climb a high pavilion with others and spend the whole day pleasantly. Avoid desiring what lies beyond your circumstances, and you may obtain what you seek. Treating another person's words too casually can bring harm that later regret cannot prevent.
months.5: Personal fortune is unfavorable, making money difficult to obtain even with effort. With a restless, scattered mind, plans do not come together easily. If there is no material loss, gossip may cause trouble. Exercise restraint.
months.6: Many things run against you, making failure more likely in the reading. Blindly trusting a friend in a joint venture invites gossip. To guard against failure, approach all matters carefully and remain alert to disappointment from someone you trust.
months.7: This month favors leaving the old behind and putting something new into practice. Spring grass finally receives rain and grows stronger each day; there is little cause to hesitate. Fortune follows a level road and your circumstances are peaceful. Move forward with renewed strength.
months.8: Wealth is indicated in the east or south, associated with the energy you bring to beginning a venture. Growing resources bring ease. Avoid romantic entanglements, since the gossip they provoke may be difficult to escape.
months.9: The storm finally clears, and moonlight shines brightly through a mountain window. Take care around fire and water, and choose associates thoughtfully. The dark night can then give way to a bright day. Gather your convictions and proceed.
months.10: Value your connections, and a meaningful relationship can bring substantial benefit. The west is named as favorable, representing gains made while bringing work to completion. Adversity turns into a blessing; even with good and bad intertwined, joy outweighs the difficulty.
months.11: The month is unfavorable, so new efforts are difficult to complete. Looking for fish on a mountain captures the futility of these plans. Avoid litigation, which brings loss in this reading. Patience and endurance are preferable.
months.12: Avoid unnecessary dealings with government offices, where financial loss is indicated. The text also cautions against visiting households affected by illness. With these cautions observed, the final lunar month brings several happy developments. You can at last achieve your aim and share the joy.

131.chongun: The sun begins to descend once it reaches its height, and the moon begins to wane once full. An older person drinks with a companion and struggles against drunken drowsiness. Moving house can bring a favorable outcome, even if late. Trying something new is desirable; otherwise, at least revise your existing work to improve your prospects. Spring, however, does not favor planning another undertaking, and summer readily brings gossip. Greed will not sustain success; pushing pleasure to an extreme is dangerous. The lower follows the higher, indicating revision of the old and the beginning or pursuit of something new. Seeking what lies beyond your circumstances brings harm without benefit.

months.1: The remaining snow has not melted, so the grasses cannot yet emerge. You are like someone in a mountain valley, deeply lonely and weary. Family members may misunderstand one another instead of living harmoniously, turning a benefactor into an enemy.
months.2: The traveling-horse sign reaches you, indicating at least one distant journey. Do not use it to launch another venture: even if you begin, profit is difficult to obtain. You may be grateful simply to escape harm. An undertaking may start without reaching a conclusion, leaving disappointment.
months.3: Unexpected success spreads your name both near and far. A helpful person arrives to support your achievement. The east and south are favorable this month. Pay attention to these directions and give particular care to beginnings and new activity.
months.4: Frost falls on young spring grass, making growth difficult and incomplete even when it occurs. If there is no financial loss, abundant gossip is indicated. Like a young girl who has lost her way and rushes about without knowing the direction, you need to proceed carefully.
months.5: Time spent with others brings an equal mixture of favorable and unfavorable prospects. Guard your mouth as tightly as a bottle stopper, and you can avoid disputes. Staying home offers benefit and a possible unexpected gain. Do not invite failure outside while abandoning the benefit already within reach.
months.6: Your name travels far and everyone knows it, but fame without substance leaves disappointment. Personal fortune is also unfavorable, without a solid foundation. Even with someone you address as a close brother, do not casually disclose your innermost thoughts.
months.7: A goose returning south carries a letter. Affairs are favorable, and official recognition draws near, but the message arrives somewhat late, like the returning bird. Casually changing your land or base of operations is unfavorable, so take care.
months.8: Quietly remaining within your circumstances is very favorable; expanding your activities is unfavorable. Keep to your role and live peacefully, and money may arrive unexpectedly. Going out in search of it may instead make you miss an approaching blessing. Finding a suitable spouse is not easy.
months.9: Water from every valley joins together until small streams form a sea. The exterior seems substantial, but inwardly there is emptiness and a lack of recognition. Yet your personal circumstances are steady; why lament money that has not arrived? The streams have, after all, formed a sea.
months.10: Looking at the sky beneath a broad-brimmed hat makes it difficult to see the beautiful moon. The east is named as the direction for gain, so take particular care when beginning a task. Careless associations can make approaching harm difficult to avoid.
months.11: This month calls for considerable effort without a matching reward. Keep an upright mind, remain within your position, and act cautiously; the unfavorable can turn favorable. Around the winter solstice, take care with water and fire. Neglecting your surroundings may lead to regret.
months.12: A helpful person is close by, bringing financial benefit. Like an autumn mouse finding a storehouse full of grain, your livelihood is very favorably placed. The final lunar month has many favorable signs and no adverse ones, releasing the accumulated danger and loneliness of earlier difficulties.

132.chongun: Grass grows lush and green along the riverbank. Reputation and profit rise together, filling the household with warmth. Home life is peaceful, with further celebrations and many happy events. A small lingering concern remains despite these favorable signs; that is the flaw in the picture. Overcome it, and joy can continue. Spring brings unexpected success, and summer supports your plans. Like a thirsty dragon finding water, you have many reasons for happiness. An unexpected gain or an addition to the household brings celebration. Financial and personal prospects arrive afresh from both near and far with good news. The traditional reading recommends sincere prayer at the year's beginning to welcome this favorable turn.

months.1: The household grows and farmland expands, increasing the family livelihood. The old departs and the new returns; small accumulations become a great achievement. Financial prospects flourish daily, bringing the calm and ease of strolling through a flower garden in spring.
months.2: A bright spring day opens, and countless flowers compete to bloom. The household thrives and financial prospects flourish, with the transforming energy of a dragon finding water. Use that strength to pursue your plans, and you can achieve your purpose.
months.3: Unexpected success brings celebration and spreads your name in every direction. Helpful people come to support you, producing substantial benefit. Virtue accompanies a growing reputation, and your household's abundance draws others' admiration.
months.4: The north is unfavorable; beware of gossip. While finishing a task, or afterward, talk about earlier events may provoke criticism. A family that cultivates virtue has many reasons to celebrate, so there is no need for excessive worry. Avoiding disputes helps avert trouble.
months.5: Your plans succeed as though you had obtained a wish-fulfilling jewel. The northeast is named as the direction of benefit. Recognize opportunities before an undertaking begins and at its outset. If there is no official advancement, an unexpected gain is indicated.
months.6: You bring wine to a scenic mountain and enjoy it with friends: personal ease and flourishing finances are indicated. Long journeys or distant new ventures, however, are unfavorable. Staying home or maintaining your existing work is favorable, so observe that distinction.
months.7: Financial fortune is very favorable. The moon appears in a clear sky and lights the world. Good developments are indicated in both east and west. Attend carefully to beginnings and conclusions, and an unexpected gain can arrive in keeping with this favorable reading.
months.8: You cut into stone and discover a jewel; great wealth rolls in of its own accord. If there is no official advancement, the joy may be a child's birth. Your spouse has cause to celebrate, and the household blooms like spring. No particular trouble is indicated this month.
months.9: You sit at leisure playing the geomungo under a bright moon and clear breeze. Favorable signs shine on the home, and prosperous finances bring happiness. Matters resolve as easily as snow melting in spring rain and wind. You find a starting point for your intended undertaking.
months.10: Activity in the east brings a helpful person, giving your plans an opportunity to succeed. It is like spring grass growing stronger each day after rain. Winter's reading points toward eventual financial gain, so prepare steadily, step by step.
months.11: In the eleventh lunar month, plans may succeed as though supported by a wish-fulfilling jewel. Timely rain and gentle winds allow flowers to fall and fruit to form. Financial fortune is very favorable. Press ahead with your intentions without hesitation to obtain substantial benefit.
months.12: Avoid disputes, as gossip is plentiful. Travel is favorable and financial prospects are strong, so benefit is found outside. Circumstances flow smoothly and you are at ease. Continue to sustain this favorable course rather than changing or stopping it.

133.chongun: Dry wood meets a flame, leaving safety suspended by a thread. Snow fills a secluded lane, where a lone pine stands. Though solitary, its heart is at ease, so why worry? Traveling in every direction can bring personal pleasure. Money arrives, yet disappears as soon as it reaches your hands. Alone without anyone to rely on, you feel loneliness more deeply. This year calls for care with disputes. A single thought may draw someone in to stay, like catching a crab and placing it in fresh water. Even when you work hard, the credit flows elsewhere. Familiar things become distant and partings occur; the overall image is one of solitude.

months.1: You are lost in deep mountains, wandering without knowing any direction or where to go. The south is unfavorable, so take care when advancing work already begun. Staying home and preserving the family livelihood is favorable; going out to pursue something else is not.
months.2: People do not place their trust in you, making new plans less useful than restraint. Fortunately, meeting a benefactor can replace bitterness with sweetness. Gold enters a furnace and is eventually transformed into a substantial vessel.
months.3: Like a solitary traveler far from home, you must soothe your loneliness without becoming impatient. Personal fortune is unfavorable, with several indications of loss. Gossip waits in the third and fourth lunar months; unless avoided, it may lead to financial damage. Take care.
months.4: The path is uneven, and even a good event may suffer an unwelcome interference. Getting close to disputes brings unexpected adversity, whether legal trouble or gossip. Take precautions beforehand, remembering that an argument can readily become a legal matter.
months.5: A favorable star shines on the home, and you are fortunate to receive help from a benefactor. Every matter begins to open smoothly this month. Try knocking at the door. With financial prospects improving and money arriving daily, move forward energetically.
months.6: Another person's help may lead to marriage or, otherwise, the beginning of a meaningful relationship. Without a firm inner position, your activities may feel insubstantial. Yet a lively turn of fortune brings family harmony and a possible addition to the household.
months.7: If there is no financial loss, personal concerns may appear from time to time. Staying home offers little benefit; going out to seek something else is favorable. It is like an autumn moon rising above a high pavilion while you wander among flowers.
months.8: Meeting a benefactor among a grove of flowers increases your joy. Romantic entanglements are associated with financial loss. An undertaking may begin without reaching its end, leaving something hollow. Still, sincere effort in your relationships can bring good developments.
months.9: The ninth and tenth lunar months alternate between joy and sadness. Keeping to your responsibilities is the best course. The traditional text associates illness with seeking a physician to the south, particularly one with an established, busy practice.
months.10: You launch a boat on the broad sea; if wind and waves rise, smooth progress is difficult. Misplaced faith in a friend may reveal an unreliable situation and leave disappointment. Yet personal prospects are steady and financial fortune favorable, calling for the courage to row toward the waves.
months.11: Seeking something small brings something large, and your wishes are fulfilled smoothly. An unexpected gain provides abundance and peace at home. Winter favors completing existing work and succeeding in new undertakings. A bold attempt is called for.
months.12: A supposed benefactor offers words without substance, so do not rely on that person too heavily. Rash action can invite a disruption difficult to manage. Careful handling of every matter ultimately brings a favorable outcome. Proceed without impatience.

141.chongun: A tiny boat floats among waves on a vast, distant sea. However rough or far the journey, wealth lies elsewhere and can be obtained by going out. Already on the road, you are destined to travel far at least once. If there is no concern at home, gossip may arise instead. Far away in unfamiliar lands, even your gains may leave little to keep. This year, avoid disputes. In the fine rain and spring wind, true spring flowers fail to bloom while empty blossoms flourish. Seeking deer in a marketplace offers little hope of seeing even a tail, much less a head. One person tills the field while ten share the harvest: there is much work and little return.

months.1: If hardship does not affect your parents or siblings, concern may arise through your children. An undertaking begins favorably but ends unfavorably. Once you have left home, where should you go? If you know benefit lies elsewhere, the reading calls for facing the difficulty and making the journey.
months.2: Favorable and unfavorable signs are balanced, bringing joy at one moment and sadness at another. Already working in a field, what use are a hundred distracting thoughts? Concentrate on your existing work. Relatives may be distant, leaving you to establish and protect your household yourself.
months.3: Financial prospects exist, but the text also warns of repeated mourning. Being on the road brings unavoidable spending or loss. This month is half favorable and half unfavorable. If mourning does not occur, busy movement and travel may instead bring losses.
months.4: The prospect of litigation sends you running in every direction. Approaching disputes may ultimately bring legal trouble. Be especially careful about gossip this month: becoming caught in it and then arguing can lead to official or legal difficulties.
months.5: For a person of generous character this is favorable; for one of petty character it is unfavorable. Fortunately, a good turn of fortune allows your undertakings to succeed. Financial aims can be fulfilled as intended, and affairs come to completion, bringing considerable joy.
months.6: Staying home is unfavorable and traveling favorable, so a fresh challenge may be preferable to continuing as before. In the fifth and sixth lunar months, benefit lies elsewhere or in a different activity. The landscape may be unfamiliar, but the opportunity is there, making the journey worthwhile.
months.7: A favorable beginning gives way to difficulty, and achievement comes only after effort. Care in every matter ultimately allows favorable circumstances to return. Body and mind are hard to settle, bringing distress. Since accomplishment follows labor, patience and endurance are the best course.
months.8: New plans are unfavorable, so do not hastily pursue another undertaking. Keep to your role and maintain the present situation. Activities can easily prove hollow; seeking what lies beyond your circumstances may bring overwhelming disappointment. Avoid launching a new venture.
months.9: Fish and dragons miss their season and lose their vitality. Illness is indicated, so attend to difficulties in advance. A modest sum can be obtained this month. Seeking a large gain instead may reveal the limits of your situation.
months.10: You want to cross a river but have no boat, making your aim difficult to achieve. Do not readily believe promises, whoever makes them. A name without substance is no boat at all. Since you cannot advance despite wanting to, remain where you are and wait for another opportunity.
months.11: Personal fortune is unfavorable; beware of unexpected adversity. Seeking additional wealth brings harm rather than gain. Restraint is the way to preserve your resources. Staying quietly within your circumstances is preferable to desiring what lies outside.
months.12: You put all your strength into seeking work, yet a beginning lacks a conclusion. Joint plans are difficult to complete, so do not rush. Minor disagreements or gossip can lead to repeated quarrels. Take particular care with partnerships.

142.chongun: A hundred people farm together, making this year's provisions lasting and plentiful. Welcome rain falls after seven years of drought, bringing great joy. Going out is favorable and can bring recognition. You may appear very wealthy while possessing less in reality, so avoid boasting. Many people offer help, and benefit arises through them. Hardship soon gives way to ease, with unexpected money possible. Gains come through skillful speech and documents, which deserve your attention. Who can measure the ambitions of a dragon hidden in the sea? Spring returns even to shaded ground, reviving all things. Like that hidden dragon, prepare to unfold your ambitions. The traditional reading recommends respectful prayer as you do so.

months.1: Benefit lies with someone you have known closely for a long time. An unexpected helper may also appear and bring a financial gain. With a warm spring wind, all things revive. Your time has finally come.
months.2: Financial prospects are good, but losses accompany them, so take care. Your reputation benefits and others praise you, though money does not necessarily follow in equal measure. There is instead a concern about loss. Exercise care when trying to secure a profit.
months.3: Remaining steady in your existing work is favorable; moving to pursue something else is not. Watch for gossip this month. Spring balances good and bad, so not every undertaking succeeds. Yet your intended aim can resolve readily, making continued progress worthwhile.
months.4: Peach and plum trees meet spring; their flowers will fall and fruit will form. If there is no official advancement, a child's birth or another addition to the household is indicated. A celebration is expected this month. Prepare for it so the occasion is even happier.
months.5: Do not seek wealth elsewhere or desire another person's possessions, as gossip will multiply. In the fifth and sixth lunar months, efforts to gain may instead lead to loss. Avoid excessive desire. Two people have opposing intentions, making completion of their shared work difficult.
months.6: Personal circumstances are steady and favorable, but financial prospects are incomplete. Be careful when seeking money. Reaching beyond your circumstances invites loss, so think first of preserving what you have. If official advancement or an opportunity for it does not appear, a dispute may arise instead.
months.7: Fortunately, meeting a benefactor may bring an unexpected gain. The seventh and eighth lunar months resemble a hungry person finding food and escaping deprivation. A celebration awaits beyond the clouds and far away. Endure present difficulties, and you can reach it.
months.8: Bees gather among the flowers in a spring garden, bringing abundant joy. A happy letter from afar suggests the arrival of a dear friend. Several people help one another, and financial prospects flourish. With a good friend and favorable finances, little more is needed.
months.9: A favorable star shines on you and spreads your reputation in every direction. Like autumn chrysanthemums flowering overnight, matters come to completion quickly this month. Before the year ends, many unexpected developments arrive to help you.
months.10: Where does the lone goose fly as it cries in the middle of an autumn night? If concern does not arise through your parents, adversity may affect your children. A period of deep loneliness is indicated. Little comes in and much goes out, adding to personal hardship.
months.11: You seek something small and obtain something large, making affairs run smoothly. The household has enough, and family members are peaceful and happy. Repeated joys bring ease to both body and mind. This is a time to apply yourself to your plans.
months.12: Careless associations can expose you to unexpected harm. Remaining on your present ground and relying only on familiar sources of gain are described as unfavorable. Yet reaching beyond your circumstances brings a greater failure. Even when what you have seems unfavorable, preserving it remains the better course.

143.chongun: Rain pours down at night, and a traveler can neither advance nor retreat, finding only distress. Personal fortune is unfavorable; searching and planning do not produce the desired gain. Even a small matter may bring tears. Abandoning an old livelihood to seek a new one risks losing the former as well, so protect your existing work. Personal difficulties make success hard to achieve. Spring contains the prospect of unexpected adversity: do not casually begin another venture. Small moments of joy exist, but sadness is greater and can obscure them. Help from others has limited substance and is insufficient for the task. Still, assistance is indicated between the seventh and eighth lunar months.

months.1: New spring shoots meet frost, making growth difficult. Staying home and preserving the old is favorable; going out or moving to pursue the new brings harm. Travel is unfavorable. Carefully maintain what you already have.
months.2: Avoid rash action, as unexpected adversity is a concern. Readily believing and following another person's words may bring harm. When two people have different intentions, how can their shared work succeed? Even a result may prove hollow. Proceed with great care.
months.3: Trouble at home is difficult to avoid this month, so attend to household matters and your own condition. Clashes and incompatibility may bring sadness and tears. Dealings or joint plans with others carry the prospect of failure. Choose such arrangements carefully.
months.4: Unspoken distress weighs on your mind, and affairs feel insubstantial. Adverse signs outnumber favorable ones. Romantic connections, however, are described as the most favorable relationships. Giving attention to such a connection is traditionally associated with easing this difficult period.
months.5: Stability is favorable; leaving home to pursue plans is not. Good fortune finally arrives late, so recognize the opportunity and respond boldly. Personal energy and money increase, improving your circumstances, but concern about your parents may arise. Good and bad remain balanced.
months.6: If illness does not arise, gossip may be difficult to avoid. Keep away from disputes, as legal matters are unfavorable. Travel southeast is also unfavorable. Take care when beginning or expanding work to avoid regret, especially with movement east or south.
months.7: Beware of unexpected adversity in the seventh and eighth lunar months. Still, a new turn of fortune begins, like greenery growing clearer in spring wind and fine rain. Fortunately, meeting an old connection can bring benefit and assistance into your home.
months.8: Going east from home brings considerable difficulty; leaving existing work to pursue something new is unfavorable. Travel west or north is also unfavorable, calling for care as work bears fruit and afterward. When personal fortune is poor, attend carefully to everything and wait.
months.9: Financial prospects are very favorable in the ninth and tenth lunar months. Adversity finally recedes and the door to joy opens. Do not plan another undertaking, however. Wealth flourishes in the south and north; put more energy into work already under way.
months.10: The upper and lower levels are out of balance, leaving good and bad evenly mixed. A wandering, undecided mind makes failure easier. Moving house is unfavorable this year; staying home and diligently maintaining existing work is beneficial. Work toward harmony between those above and below you.
months.11: Wealth and official standing flourish in the eleventh and twelfth lunar months. The traditional text pairs childbirth with the alternative possibility of mourning. Rice and timber are unfavorable, so take care. At the same time, prepare to receive the improving material and professional prospects.
months.12: Moving east is unfavorable, while preserving your ground is favorable. Keep the old rather than desiring the new. An unwise association can bring harm, so take care. Yet benefit itself comes through relationships, making thoughtful attention to them essential.

151.chongun: Seeking fish in a tree means meeting obstacles at every turn and obtaining nothing. You try to move but stop halfway; you find a companion only to part again. With no settled intention, your actions drift like clouds. This is an unfavorable period for success, so seek stability and avoid mistakes. An unsettled mind encounters many barriers. Refrain from plans beyond your circumstances. Seeking profit outside may lead to failure. Without anyone to help, how can you be sure of success? You notice a sore fingernail but overlook a stomachache, too busy addressing the nearest problem to see the larger one. Do not force a gain, as that breeds mutual resentment. Even a fire cannot produce a fine blade if it has no useful work to do.

months.1: An unforeseen calamity suddenly blocks the way, darkening your outlook. Do not plan another undertaking in the first or second lunar month. There are favorable financial signs, but an apparently good beginning may turn unfavorable. Be careful with gains that look immediately attractive.
months.2: The household spirit is stirred; the traditional text calls for moving house or, failing that, taking a long journey, otherwise warning of trouble at home. Spring's financial prospects carry substantial difficulty, so avoid greed. Do not readily trust others' words when finishing a task; late advice can be harmful.
months.3: You wish to farm but have missed the season, making an autumn harvest difficult. The text cautions against visiting households affected by illness. Financial opportunity exists, but rushing to seize it may make it slip away. Wait, then take hold of it.
months.4: The flowers have fallen without setting fruit, offering little basis for expecting great wealth. A new venture brings no benefit, and people may fail to get along. Restraint is best; do not devise another undertaking. Recognize that this is not the time to seek something new.
months.5: Grass dried by drought finally meets welcome rain and turns a deep green. Seeking and planning work brings the desired result, along with an unexpected gain. Personal fortune is very favorable and the household peaceful. This is the time to put your effort into action.
months.6: An unfavorable beginning gives way to a favorable end, balancing good and bad. Matters are not clearly black or white this month, so act thoughtfully. Distant travel is unfavorable and staying home favorable. Preserve your existing livelihood rather than casually beginning something else.
months.7: If there is no financial loss, legal trouble or gossip may arise; prepare beforehand. The traditional reading suggests moving house or temporarily changing your work to avert adversity. Financial opportunity exists, but a favorable beginning can turn unfavorable. Protect gains while they are available.
months.8: An adverse spirit is pictured at the door, calling for attention to illness. A family member may leave, or a relationship may end, creating distance and disappointment. Unfavorable signs outweigh favorable ones this month. Calm your mind and avoid reacting to every development.
months.9: The ninth and tenth lunar months may bring a child's birth or another addition to the household. A wealth star shines on the home, bringing joy through unexpected money. Autumn leaves may seem more beautiful than peonies, reflecting the many happy events of this period.
months.10: The east and north are described as harmful, calling for care before and at the start of a task. Distant travel is unfavorable; staying home is favorable. Preserve the family livelihood rather than launching another venture. The text also names the west and north as directions of benefit.
months.11: In the eleventh and twelfth lunar months, wealth comes from the north, associated with the period after work is completed. You live comfortably, sheltered from worldly turbulence. An unwise association can still cause harm, so attend carefully to your relationships.
months.12: Health and wealth flourish, bringing peace to the household. Planning another undertaking, however, can diminish that happiness. Someone's help brings unexpected success. Waiting is preferable to hastily starting new work.

152.chongun: Fire reaches the roof beam, yet the swallows and sparrows nesting there do not understand the danger. Joy and sadness alternate in this turn of fortune. Many matters become blocked, and time can pass without useful results. A mother goes in search of food but returns to find an empty gourd, adding to the distress. Gathering and dispersal are uncertain: what is gained may be lost again. This year's reading favors moving house or trying a new undertaking. A thirsty horse climbs a mountain without finding a spring, while a lone bird flies between a cold sky and a white earth. Be cautious with outsiders, from whom little benefit is indicated.

months.1: A bird's wing is broken in flight, making it difficult to choose between advancing and retreating. Water or fire may cause a fright, so take care. The first and second lunar months are half favorable and half unfavorable. Do not give up; continue your existing work.
months.2: Helping someone out of sentiment despite lacking trust can turn a favorable situation unfavorable. Spring brings concern involving your spouse or children. Personal circumstances are tiring. Avoid travel and new undertakings, which may add distress.
months.3: Your benefactor is associated with the west and north. Benefit comes while completing work or afterward. The traditional text recommends prayer to the Buddha in the third and fourth lunar months, warning that difficulties involving cousins or a wife or concubine could be hard to bear.
months.4: Listening to sweet words can expose you to petty tricks. Empty reputations and appearances cause disappointment. Preparing against adversity may allow trouble to turn into a blessing instead. Unspoken distress in your heart leaves you constantly wanting to leave home.
months.5: Seek money sincerely. You may not obtain everything you want, but your effort receives some return. A benefactor from the east offers unexpected help. Care when beginning or taking up new work brings benefit. Even if the gain is not large, a modest profit is possible.
months.6: Yin and yang come together, allowing a wish to be fulfilled. Joining forces with another person can help you accumulate property. Personal fortune and finances are favorable, so do not hesitate to meet others and plan work. Good fortune accompanies your steps.
months.7: Longevity and blessings continue through the seventh and eighth lunar months, and your work carries on smoothly. If official advancement does not arrive, your descendants may have cause to celebrate. Like walking pleasantly among flowers on a blooming morning or moonlit evening, this is an image of happiness.
months.8: A joint undertaking may appear favorable but turn unfavorable, so take care. Remaining within your circumstances is best. Rushing around to begin new work brings no benefit. Approach every matter carefully this month.
months.9: An undertaking may have a beginning without a conclusion. Involvement in other financial interests brings harm. A helper who can relieve your difficulty is associated with the west and north. Give careful attention to completing your work and to what follows.
months.10: You prepare to act but cannot advance, leaving distress to accumulate within. Romantic or sexual entanglement is associated with harm. Benefit lies in the west and north. Be decisive about bringing your work to a sound conclusion so that the gain can follow.
months.11: Money arrives, but another person's envy may bring harm. The east is unfavorable and the west favorable. Instead of beginning something new or accelerating it, finish your existing work well. Thoughtfully chosen relationships can bring substantial benefit.
months.12: The traditional text recommends sincere Buddhist prayer as a way to avert adversity. Before planning work with someone, understand that person's deeper intentions. Like a mountain bird that has lost its nest and hovers without knowing which way to go, you need care to find the right direction.

153.chongun: Though the year is poor, a hungry person finds abundance. Timely rain and gentle winds recall the peaceful age of the sage ruler Shun. An unexpected gain allows you to acquire and expand property. Avoid quarrels, and matters can resolve smoothly. The beginning may be difficult, but fortune opens later and brings achievement. A windfall offers a period of peace and plenty. Humility rather than arrogance can avert a sudden loss. Nourish the roots, and branches and leaves grow thick before bearing fruit. Even a butterfly in a dream enjoys splendor; when sincerity reaches your dreams, what can block your path? Honor is indicated. The traditional text recommends humble prayer to welcome favorable fortune.

months.1: In the first and second lunar months, a wealth star shines at your door and brings benefit. Going out to seek money is favorable and may yield more than expected. Conditions are balanced and the harvest plentiful, with songs of peace all around. Making use of this time provides considerable help.
months.2: A spirit of good fortune shines at the door, allowing many tasks to succeed. Like a thirsty dragon finding water and moving freely, you encounter favorable developments. A small concern remains amid the happiness: jealous people may spread gossip.
months.3: Benefit is associated with the west and north. Give attention to finishing your work, and gain follows. If there is no official advancement, a child's birth or an addition to the household may occur. Unexpected success fills you with confidence.
months.4: Warm, harmonious energy fills the doorway in the third and fourth lunar months. A dragon flying high in the sky suggests meeting an important person. Adversity disappears and blessings return, with a helpful benefactor always close by.
months.5: Benefit appears wherever you go, as though a great sum could be gained in a day. A benefactor's support is considerable. Timely rain and gentle winds let every grain crop set seed, promising a plentiful harvest. Your undertaking is described as successful.
months.6: Beware of adversity this month. Quarrels with others become tangled from beginning to end without a clear resolution. Yet the wealth star is with you, leaving no particular obstacle to a financial gain. Keep clear of arguments.
months.7: In the seventh and eighth lunar months, you may take on someone else's trouble and suffer from it. If their adversity does not affect you directly, deception may instead occur. Poor associations invite gossip. Choose people carefully and keep relationships harmonious.
months.8: You have a wish, but events do not match your expectations. Blocked personal prospects make money difficult to obtain despite effort. Greed and reaching beyond your circumstances prevent your plans from succeeding. Remain measured and exercise restraint.
months.9: The ninth and tenth lunar months bring happy events. Plans can succeed, earning others' admiration and respect. Yin and yang unite, and all things flourish. Joy comes through the fulfillment of something you have long desired, so approach it thoughtfully.
months.10: The household grows and farmland expands, bringing blessings and resources that others admire. Avoid romantic or sexual entanglement; the resulting gossip may be difficult to escape for some time. Benefit is associated with the west and north. Finish your work well.
months.11: The eleventh and twelfth lunar months resemble fish and dragons finding water, opening a vigorous period of life. The south is unfavorable, so avoid traveling there. Interfering unwisely with work already flourishing is not beneficial. Guard against gossip and maintain your existing work.
months.12: You visit a spring garden with others, with good and bad evenly balanced. New undertakings likewise carry a mixture of both. Avoid disputes, as gossip is plentiful. Remaining within your circumstances and avoiding rash action is the best way to preserve this year's fortune.

161.chongun: Gentle spring rain falls on a branch of plum blossoms. Many people help you, like rain nourishing that branch, allowing your wishes to be fulfilled. Fortune is very favorable, with warm spring breezes everywhere. Yet money gained does not all accumulate; some of it is lost, so take care. A favorable beginning may end unfavorably, requiring attention in every matter. Benefit lies away from home and can be found through travel. Consider opportunities outside your present sphere. Like green grass on both sides of a river, your achievements ride the spring wind. Spring peach blossoms and autumn chrysanthemums meet, balancing worry and joy. A fading moon shines at the village entrance, watching over a distant landscape.

months.1: In the first and second lunar months, profit does not come as readily as you wish. Money exists, but is spent as soon as it arrives, leaving little chance to accumulate it. You devise many plans yet find gains difficult to obtain. Apply effort instead of expecting an easy course.
months.2: Going south brings difficulty first and success later. Put energy into advancing your work. There is much to see and hear in both east and west. Like seeking fish in a clear river, looking for money can yield enough. Attend to both the beginning and the conclusion.
months.3: Changing your base is favorable, so do not delay. If a move is not possible, changing your surroundings may help. The south is the most favorable direction. Continue advancing existing work rather than launching something new. The third and fourth lunar months do not favor seeking money.
months.4: You seek work in many places, but obtaining the intended result and profit is difficult. Without moving or changing your surroundings, a dispute over documents may arise. Getting close to arguments can cause considerable harm; avoidance is the best course.
months.5: A poor association can harm you, so refine your judgment of people. Avoid litigation, which may end in a serious defeat. This month has more adverse than favorable signs. Starting legal action on hope alone can bring a burden difficult to manage.
months.6: A distant journey brings benefit near water. Pay attention to matters connected with water. Trading or business activity is favorable, so do not miss the time. Wishes can be fulfilled and bring joy. Begin the intended work without hesitation.
months.7: Someone connected with wood is indicated as a helper, making a partnership favorable. Be cautious about distant travel; staying home is preferable. Expectations that reach too far are a warning sign. Illness is a concern this month, so look after your body.
months.8: A benefactor arrives at your window on a moonlit night. Substantial money comes without your having sought or struggled for it. Who is this helper? The connection grows from treating people with trustworthiness and maintaining sincere relationships.
months.9: Restraint is the best course this month. Letting sentiment prevent you from acting straightforwardly can complicate matters and turn them unfavorable. If official advancement does not occur, an addition to the household is indicated. Prepare so that you can welcome the joy.
months.10: An undertaking may prove insubstantial, so examine it closely. Matters can become complicated, calling for preparation and care with gossip. Personal fortune is also uneven. A wise response is especially valuable.
months.11: Many matters resist your efforts and remain blocked, making staying home favorable. Preserve the family livelihood instead of starting something new. Benefit is associated with the west and with finishing well. Good and bad are balanced this month, so remain within your circumstances.
months.12: You naturally find ease, and affairs proceed smoothly. Financial prospects become very favorable, offering substantial resources. Otherwise, a child's birth or another addition to the family brings joy, a particularly precious kind of news.

162.chongun: Fish and dragons bathe beneath rising summer clouds, an image of recognition with nothing left to envy. Seeking improper gain or joining corrupt dealings may bring litigation. Advancing and retreating between south and north can bring your plans to completion. Know when to press ahead while work flourishes and when to pause and put things in order. Financial prospects are strong, and movement brings considerable benefit. Life is peaceful, allowing affairs to follow your intentions. Litigation is unfavorable this year, so avoid entering disputes. As a bird returns to an old nest that needs repair, attend to your home and base. Your name spreads in every direction and people look up to you. Flowers compete to bloom, spreading their light far and wide. The traditional text recommends sincere prayer to welcome good fortune.

months.1: The first and second lunar months bring confidence and little to envy. Three people meet with united intentions, allowing financial aims to be achieved. Peace prevails among those above and below, easing body and mind. It is like countless flowers blooming at once and filling the distance with light.
months.2: Do not go east or west; your plans will be difficult to fulfill there. A private worry fills your mind, leaving little room to consider the affairs around you. Seeking rabbits beside a river captures the difficulty of obtaining what you want. Settle your mind and observe calmly.
months.3: A happy celebration is indicated in the third and fourth lunar months. Soon afterward, the traveling-horse sign reaches your door and takes you away from home. The west and north are favorable; the east and south are unfavorable. The outcome and reward may be good, but take care when beginning.
months.4: Avoid romantic or sexual entanglement, which brings harm rather than benefit. Wealth lies outside and can be obtained by going out. Looking beyond your existing work may yield a gain. The fourth lunar month's southern breeze carries warmth and favorable prospects into your affairs.
months.5: An argument is possible in the fifth and sixth lunar months. Avoid the east and south during these months. Starting or joining an undertaking may draw you into conflict. Even a sympathetic, understanding attitude does not prevent every dispute. Avoid the quarrel before seeking mutual understanding.
months.6: You cannot clearly judge whether to advance or retreat, and right and wrong are difficult to distinguish. Whether to trust or doubt someone close becomes a problem. Misplaced trust can cause substantial loss. Avoid moving east or west, where someone intending harm is described as following behind.
months.7: Fish and dragons finally find water, multiplying their vitality and courage. A fish swims leisurely in spring waters, with abundant sustenance. Stillness is favorable and movement harmful. Good fortune calls for the wisdom to preserve it.
months.8: Rain finally falls after drought, and all things welcome it. A poor association can cause harm, so protect your property carefully. Yet your body is strong and resources plentiful, bringing peace to the household. Relationships are the particular area requiring care.
months.9: Avoid the east and south, where harm may be considerable. Beginning and expanding work carries danger. Personal fortune is very favorable and unexpected money may arrive, so do not rush into activity. A joint undertaking is also described as bringing substantial benefit.
months.10: Wealth and physical strength flourish, favoring the fulfillment of a wish. Gossip remains a concern, and achievement takes a meaningful amount of time. Living peacefully within your circumstances brings benefit. Excessive activity beyond your position can damage the blessings already present.
months.11: Warm harmony fills the home in the eleventh and twelfth lunar months. If there is no unexpected financial gain, a family celebration is indicated. Relatives live peacefully together, as though spring has arrived indoors. Harmony during success can become strained after a setback, so take care.
months.12: A benefactor arrives to help and brings unexpected success. Choose associations carefully and treat people sincerely; this can turn a possible loss into assistance. A wealth star shines at the door, and resources arrive naturally, bringing satisfaction.

163.chongun: White dew has fallen: autumn is the time to fold away the fan. Knowing the right way to advance or retreat allows you to respond well and succeed. Yet favorable conditions can turn unfavorable, so take care in all matters. If there is no dispute, gossip may still arise. Staying in feels unsettled, while going out brings little benefit; judgment is needed. Initial difficulty gives way to prosperity, with a benefactor coming to help. Honor and distinction are accompanied by material reward. The old departs and the new appears, opening financial prospects widely. People discuss matters face to face while their hearts remain far apart. Your name may be known everywhere, yet the purse and box remain empty. The traditional reading recommends sincere prayer so that inner substance can match outward appearance.

months.1: Worry may arise amid happiness in the first and second lunar months. Money exists, but accumulating it is difficult. Meeting a benefactor, however, can bring official recognition and allow you to put your worries aside. Pay attention to such a connection.
months.2: Living away from home makes unfamiliar customs difficult to understand. Helpful people work together to bring your undertaking to completion, and benefit comes from every direction. You may obtain the money you seek. Still, the sense of not knowing your way in an unfamiliar place remains a concern.
months.3: Personal ease and a bright state of mind bring considerable joy. A benefactor appears from the south and offers assistance. Help comes while you are diligently advancing your work. Understanding when and how to advance or retreat allows further progress to be favorable.
months.4: A solitary moon hangs high and lights the distance. Financial prospects begin favorably but end unfavorably, so take care. Gossip may accompany them. Standing out so sharply that you become isolated is not a wise course.
months.5: Little comes in while much is spent. Stability is favorable, but moving to pursue something new is not; avoid careless action. Wealth associated with the east eventually turns unfavorable. What is gained at the beginning may prove disadvantageous in the end.
months.6: Worldly affairs seem like a dream, and parting is described as favorable. A letter arrives from afar, prompting thoughts of when you might return home and deepening loneliness. Yet separation between siblings is associated with adversity. Protect your bond and work toward reconciliation.
months.7: A favorable star reaches the door, bringing success through another person. Only from this point do financial gains begin to arrive. Romantic or sexual entanglement may lead to regret, so take care beforehand. Good relationships bring blessings, but desire requires caution.
months.8: Misplaced trust can cause harm, especially with someone close. Preserving the old is favorable; moving to pursue something else is not. Remain within your circumstances and avoid rash behavior. Unfavorable conditions can then turn favorable, showing the value of protecting what you have.
months.9: A lack of family harmony can quickly turn good circumstances bad. Mixed hardship calls for care so that belongings are not lost. Unfavorable signs outweigh favorable ones this month. Careless action may cost both possessions and peace of mind. Caution is best.
months.10: Your old base is unfavorable, and moving is favorable. If a move is not possible, change your surroundings or even your place within them. A new undertaking is also acceptable. When snow covers the world, an opportunity for a modest gain arrives. Metal objects are unfavorable, while land is beneficial.
months.11: Gossip is plentiful in the eleventh and twelfth lunar months. If your name does not become known, an unexpected gain may occur. If neither happens, illness is a concern. Recognition itself can provoke gossip, so respond wisely.
months.12: A benefactor reaches your door, bringing many happy developments. A wealth star also shines there, allowing financial aims to be met. Restraint is the best course this year. It can lead you to the helper whose assistance allows your work to succeed.

211.chongun: You till fields by day and study by night, then return home in splendid robes. Diligent effort brings lasting blessings of its own accord. With no particular personal worry, you naturally feel at ease. Avoid reckless schemes, which bring loss instead. A celebration comes between spring and summer; broadly, this year's reading offers benefit wherever you go. Like a tiger commanding the animals of a mountain valley, your confidence grows and the way ahead is clear. Your undertakings meet little resistance and can succeed as intended. Exchanging a sheep for an ox conveys exceptionally favorable financial prospects. The family's sons establish households of their own, while the eldest smoothly takes over the father's livelihood and increases its wealth. Greed, however, brings loss. The traditional reading recommends setting greed aside and praying sincerely to welcome this favorable fortune.

months.1: Heaven and earth come together, indicating a celebration. Even without marriage, growing closer to one another can bring an unexpected financial gain. If two people pursue their purpose with a single heart and intention, their work can succeed without particular fault.
months.2: A favorable star shines on the home, bringing a celebration for the children. Do not covet another person's property without thought. Money does not arrive merely because you wish it; appropriate effort must come first. That earned reward is the blessing described here.
months.3: A fish transforms into a dragon, revealing remarkable change. Sitting in a high pavilion on a bright moonlit night, you enjoy a happiness difficult to express. Standing on a broad road, you naturally encounter wealth from outside. The path ahead opens like a dragon working its transformations.
months.4: Dry branches meet spring and put forth flowers and leaves. Business activity brings a celebration, even if it produces no windfall. Be careful in choosing friends, however. A poor friendship can cause financial loss.
months.5: Wealth fills the home, drawing admiration and respect. Warm spring breezes seem to blow from every direction, a particularly favorable personal outlook. Yet do not believe another person's words too readily. Someone who appears to act for your benefit may ultimately deceive you.
months.6: A small item is exchanged for a large one, leaving resources to spare. The traditional text singles out a person surnamed Lee as especially favorable. Joining others in business can bring enough wealth both to help people in difficulty and to enjoy abundance yourself.
months.7: Avoid indulgence in drink and sexual affairs, which the reading associates with loss. It also warns that illness arising from such excess can be difficult to recover from, calling for care from the outset. Travel east is unfavorable and may turn a good sign into an adverse one.
months.8: Only effort and sweat bring favorable results, eventually making all your affairs prosperous. Another person may obstruct you this month, so keep some distance even from a close friend. Avoid frequenting drinking establishments; no benefit is indicated there. Exercise restraint with alcohol.
months.9: The ninth and tenth lunar months bring heavenly blessings. Financial prospects are very favorable, with success in your undertakings, money, and influence. A benefactor seeks you out and offers wholehearted help. Even an unlikely venture may succeed unexpectedly and bring unanticipated gains.
months.10: A civil-service examination is described as favorable. Even without passing, a joy comparable to the birth of a son may arrive. As in the previous month, financial prospects flourish and resources continue entering the home. An unwise association can still cause harm, so choose carefully.
months.11: Your plans follow your intentions. Seeking money brings money, and seeking ease brings ease. Yet half of this month's gains are described as slipping away; the text suggests giving to others first. Excessive desire overfills the vessel. Leave a large bowl only half full.
months.12: Keeping close to a trustworthy person helps your undertakings succeed. Wealth, honor, and recognition reach a high point, drawing widespread respect. Do not desire more than your circumstances can support, however, or your work may ultimately prove empty.

212.chongun: Gold enters the furnace, is refined, and becomes a great vessel. Favorable personal fortune brings achievement and a widely known name. Praise and respect fill the household with joy. The traditional text pictures heavenly help drawing official recognition toward you. A favorable star shines on the home, bringing honor and distinction. Yet periods of glory alternate with moments of worry. Casting your line into a clear river, you can see worldly affairs plainly and need not be anxious. With a mind as clear as water, why fear official trouble? Single-minded diligence brings success. The text also recommends sincere prayer at the year's beginning to welcome blessings.

months.1: In the first and second lunar months, a matter needs discreet handling. It is connected with possible official or legal trouble, so take care. Like flowers opening on one branch while leaves fall from another, conditions are mixed. Thoughtful handling can bring benefit.
months.2: A benefactor appears at the window in moonlight and offers help, bringing a happy development. If it is not a child's birth, it may be marriage. Moving house or changing your occupation gradually improves your circumstances. This is a period of change in daily life.
months.3: Two orioles fly together in the spring breeze of the third lunar month, suggesting a romantic bond. A favorable star shines at the door, and resources arrive naturally to bring joy. If the household does not gain a member, an unexpected financial gain is indicated. Prepare for a good development.
months.4: A dragon a thousand years old finally obtains its wish-fulfilling jewel, bringing many happy events. Your undertaking proceeds without obstruction. Planning and cooperating with another person can bring considerable wealth. Strength arises from working together.
months.5: Spring grass meets welcome rain and grows stronger day by day. With people helping and cooperating, your activities proceed smoothly. An oriole sings on a willow branch, its every part seeming to turn to gold.
