months.6: With a wine bottle beside you, you rest in a pavilion and sing like an immortal at leisure. A pleasant or joyful event is indicated, yet personal fortune is also unfavorable, calling for attention to health. Circumstances soon improve, though gossip remains a concern.
months.7: Seeking a rabbit in the mountains puts you in the right place, so the undertaking can succeed. Benefit lies in the east and south. Pay attention to starting and expanding work. An unseen helper from the north is also indicated; cultivate that connection.
months.8: Two people unite in intention, bringing abundant resources to both. Romantic or sexual entanglement, however, can bring unexpected adversity. Ultimately, like a great vessel taking shape, you can establish yourself, spread your reputation, and attract wealth and honor.
months.9: Staying home offers little gain, while going out brings money. Consider something beyond your usual work for a time. The moon appears in a clear sky and lights the world, leaving no darkness. Wealth is associated with the east; beginning a task can lead to completion.
months.10: The east is favorable, linking a new undertaking with eventual gain. Choosing the wrong people to work with can cause harm, so take care in associations. Restraint is favorable; rash action or grasping at more can bring failure.
months.11: A familiar melody reaches your door on a full-moon night, suggesting a longed-for event. If there is no celebration involving your children, success in a formal examination is indicated. A happy occasion fills the home with warmth and harmony.
months.12: Choosing the wrong person for a role can be harmful; careful associations help avert adversity. Nevertheless, money follows you, allowing wishes to be fulfilled and resources gained. Abundance may let you expand farmland and find further benefit within it.

213.chongun: Wind and waves rise on level ground, startling people and damaging property. Even without such a loss, another person may give you a fright. Avoid travel, which may lead to litigation. Dark clouds capable of spreading harm far and wide quietly cross a mountain ridge; prepare in advance. Excessive, empty desire is unfavorable. Financial loss is indicated, so travel or a new pursuit of profit may bring regret. Even if litigation arises, joining it is unfavorable. If financial prospects remain intact, illness may intrude instead, calling for attention to health. Readily accepting another person's words, even those of someone close, can invite misfortune.

months.1: A horse enters a mountain path and can neither advance nor retreat freely. Unable to run, it remains stuck and frustrated. You face a river without a boat, and the outlook seems dark. On a dark road even the candle is lost, making every direction difficult to distinguish.
months.2: Lost in a deep mountain valley, you struggle to move forward or back. Where is the way in or out? A deep worry lies within, but there is no one to whom you can readily explain it. What you seek is difficult to obtain and the path remains hidden. Avoid rash movement.
months.3: Trouble is indicated within the household. Like fish and dragons deprived of water, you must endure a period of hardship. Once this difficult point has passed, affairs can resolve as intended and your mind can regain peace.
months.4: A traveler asks the way, and a woodcutter leaves his work to guide them: a welcome act of help. With household trouble a concern, the traditional text recommends Buddhist prayer in advance to avert adversity and find the way. Poorly chosen connections with others can still cause harm.
months.5: Official or legal difficulties are hard to avoid in the fifth and sixth lunar months. You may be startled without cause, or through someone else's affairs. Matters depend on other people. Watch without interfering, since involvement can draw official trouble toward you.
months.6: Constant rushing leaves no room for restraint or stability, making peace of mind difficult. Plans do not proceed smoothly and may be unfavorable. Stability is needed to find a way. Since achievement is difficult this month, settle your mind first.
months.7: Trying to catch fish in deep mountains ends with empty hands. Traveling to seek something new offers little satisfaction, and litigation is unfavorable. Quarreling with another person invites financial loss. Take care.
months.8: Affairs rarely follow your intentions this month. Remain within your circumstances and avoid casually coveting what lies beyond them. Many tasks without a firm decision cause distress. Since obstacles are widespread, reduce your worries and take a longer view.
months.9: A bright moon enters dark clouds and becomes difficult to see. Financial prospects are blocked and losses numerous. This makes restraint more useful than action. If there is no loss, gossip may arise instead, so keep out of other people's business.
months.10: Frost falls on flourishing spring grass, making recovery difficult. Avoid beginning a business or devising another undertaking; effort may bring no substance. Concern about your spouse is also indicated. The traditional text recommends Buddhist prayer beforehand to avert adversity.
months.11: The eleventh and twelfth lunar months finally open a steadier period in which you can breathe. The restraint and sincere self-cultivation of earlier months bring their reward. The household spirit stirs, and this is now a favorable time to change your base or begin new work.
months.12: Avoid taking to the road, where unfavorable events await. Work quietly; outward expansion can meet resistance. The south and north are unfavorable for travel. Neither overactivity nor abandoning your work is advised. Proceed calmly, without ambitions so large that they invite unexpected adversity.

221.chongun: Plants meet frost and struggle to survive. Running about without restraint can invite one unusual problem after another. Wealth flourishes in spring, but the east carries losses, so do not invest casually. Unless you move house or try new work, an argument with someone may occur; be prepared for that possibility. Yet avoid rash movement or activity: remaining within your circumstances is the best course. Someone close may cause a loss this year, so choose associations carefully. Support from relatives is limited, and a favor may turn to resentment. Resources recede and setbacks arrive; even farming and silkworm rearing produce little benefit. Financial loss is indicated, with particular caution around water and fire.

months.1: Like someone traveling far from home, you wonder when you can return and rest. If no visitor arrives to discuss a matter, you may move house or change your base yourself. Readily believing others can resemble being robbed by someone you trust.
months.2: Difficulties are hard to avoid this month, so prepare. An old dragon loses its water and weeps by the river; make arrangements before regret arrives. Seeking improper gain will not bring heaven's blessing. Even in hardship, act fairly.
months.3: Looking elsewhere for more may draw the ill will of others. Do not covet their possessions. Yet carving stone into a jewel suggests productive work, like shaping timber into a sound house. Avoid schemes beyond your circumstances to escape harm.
months.4: An oriole on a willow branch adds beauty to the fourth lunar month's spring breeze. Live peacefully within your circumstances, and something good can develop within what appears unfavorable outside. Joint plans with another person may prove hollow, so take care.
months.5: Rain falls in the mountains and swells the stream in front of you. You see the rising water even without seeing the rain itself. Similarly, gossip can reach you without your having argued. Avoid disputes of every kind to guard against financial loss.
months.6: After wandering far away, you finally meet someone from home, bringing great joy. Even amid emptiness there is substance, described as heaven's blessing. A benefactor appears to help, with the south named as the direction to take. Advance your work and bring it to completion.
months.7: Undertakings can prove empty in the seventh and eighth lunar months, so exercise restraint. Someone else's money suddenly enters your home and appears to be a windfall, though the actual benefit is small. An unwise association can make all your affairs unfavorable. Take precautions.
months.8: Financial loss is indicated, so avoid another business venture or investment. A beginning without an end suggests failure if you start new work. Staying home is favorable and movement unfavorable. Preserving existing work is better than seeking something new.
months.9: Benefit is associated with the south. Put more energy into the work already under way. Wealth from outside enters the doorway this month; receive it from within. There is ease amid danger and substance amid apparent emptiness.
months.10: The east is favorable and the west unfavorable. Beginning work brings benefit, while bringing it to a close is described as harmful. A helper is associated with the surname Park or Song. Yet casual connections formed to discuss profit may lead to financial loss.
months.11: Rushing into an undertaking that is too large brings failure. Deep distress makes wishes hard to fulfill; settle your mind first. Even if favorable financial prospects bring money, it may disappear immediately. Remain within your circumstances.
months.12: Two people have different intentions, making right and wrong hard to distinguish. Financial prospects are unfavorable and losses numerous, so judge matters promptly. Staying home feels unsettled, while going out is favorable. If work becomes tangled, briefly turning your attention elsewhere can help it resolve.

222.chongun: Heavy, gloomy rain falls from a blue midday sky. Wealth is associated with the east, and the north is favorable. Attention before and at the beginning of work can yield a gain. Yet personal circumstances are difficult, with possible concern at home. Make use of spring's energy; once its three months have passed, bees struggle to gather honey. You want to advance but lack strength, and intended work is difficult to complete. Unexpected adversity may bring personal worry. Even moonlight disappears from a dark bedroom; however beautiful a face, it cannot be seen there. One person blocks a doorway that ten thousand cannot open. With your head turned southeast, the road ahead is uneven.

months.1: Obstacles make the beginning unfavorable, but later it is as though a lump of gold enters the home. Someone may block your path, and it is hard to tell whether that person is near or far. Moonlight fades as the moon enters clouds. Bring foresight to the situation.
months.2: Wealth lies in the east; a connection there can bring money. Help may come from someone preparing a new undertaking. Personal fortune is unfavorable, however, so watch your health. Not every matter is beneficial, and travel needs care.
months.3: The third and fourth lunar months begin with difficulty and end favorably. If illness does not intrude, a child's birth may bring joy. Meeting a benefactor greatly improves financial prospects and helps fulfill your aim. The benefit comes through another person's kindness.
months.4: A favorable star shines at the door, drawing money and precious things into the home. Wealth is associated with the east, but half of what is gained may be lost again. Profit from a new undertaking is difficult to retain in full. A good beginning can turn unfavorable, so take care in all matters.
months.5: A farmer misses the planting season and faces a difficult livelihood. An unwise association can cause loss, so pay attention. The reading also describes affairs proceeding smoothly and joy through a child's birth or another addition to the household.
months.6: Do not accept another person's words without judgment; considerable harm may follow. Poor associations lead to loss. Listen selectively, or decline the advice altogether. Doing so leaves room for an unexpected gain or an addition to the family.
months.7: In the seventh and eighth lunar months, money finally arrives and brings reassurance. It is associated with the east, though half may be lost after being gained. Not everything earned through a venture can be kept as profit. Gain comes first, loss later, making the end less favorable than the start.
months.8: An undertaking feels insubstantial, and gossip unsettles your mind. Private concerns make worldly affairs seem dreamlike. If these troubles are absent, financial loss is indicated instead. In that sense, the uneasiness may be the lesser burden.
months.9: Gossip in the ninth and tenth lunar months may disturb you at times. Harm is associated with a poorly chosen acquaintance, so take care in dealing with people. Continuing a relationship with someone lacking kindness may expose you to a difficult humiliation.
months.10: Personal fortune is unfavorable, and many matters meet obstacles. Do not push too hard; leave yourself room. Pursuing your wish may be fruitless, so avoid wasting effort. Official difficulties and gossip can add confusion and distress. Patience is needed.
months.11: Take care with fire in the eleventh and twelfth lunar months, as it may cause distress. To seek money, go to the marketplace and meet people directly. Be present where the work happens. Activity in the east is associated with substantial wealth. An active attempt is favorable.
months.12: Someone close may intend harm, so avoid the north. Pausing your existing work may give that person an opening. These circumstances make the undertaking difficult to finish. Few helpers are indicated in either the south or north.

223.chongun: Flowers wither on one branch while blooming on another. Even in spring, pursuing empty desires can bring adversity into favorable circumstances. Personal distress carries the possibility of financial loss. Money may come in, but accumulating it is difficult. Joy and concern balance each other, and carelessness can let time pass fruitlessly. Summer does not favor distant travel or overly ambitious undertakings. Begin on a small scale. You want to do something good, but someone blocks the way. A flower fallen into a privy has lost its fragrance even if retrieved. A rooster crows, the stars grow sparse, and a flock of crows flies south.

months.1: A happy event is followed by a sad one, alternating joy and sorrow. Favorable and unfavorable signs balance each other. A deep concern lies in your heart, and avoiding the associated adversity is not easy.
months.2: The moon emerges from clouds over a dark road, lighting the world and opening the way. The traditional text recommends prayer at a mountain temple to turn adversity into good fortune. Spring has arrived, but the snow has not fully melted, so young grass still struggles to grow.
months.3: Those above and below are not in harmony; remaining within your circumstances is best. The east and south are unfavorable. Casually starting work or plunging in without caution can lead to loss. Financial loss is indicated this month, so take care in every matter.
months.4: Do not speak carelessly about others or readily believe what they say. A plan that goes wrong may cause harm. Marital discord adds personal distress. Though your heart is heavy, the south and north are favorable, and activity there may offer some help.
months.5: Bees work at honey throughout summer, yet no benefit remains. Money arrives only to depart immediately, suggesting waste or financial loss. The difficulty is associated with a poorly chosen connection. Attend carefully to relationships to guard against loss.
months.6: Travel is unfavorable. Whatever others say, staying quietly at home is the best course. Financial prospects are blocked again, so take care with exchanges and transactions. Otherwise, household trouble may arise. Avoid reaching for every opportunity and live steadily.
months.7: A lone pine stands on a rock, and a chrysanthemum is hidden behind a fence. However much they try to display themselves, weak roots and surrounding obstacles keep them from shining. If there is no gossip, legal trouble or illness is indicated. The reading also points to a family celebration, specifically the birth of a son.
months.8: If there is no celebration through passing an examination, a happy event in the household is indicated. Misunderstanding or following another person's words can make a promising beginning turn unfavorable. Even if your mind is unsettled, staying home and keeping your composure is best.
months.9: Money comes through people in the ninth and tenth lunar months, so do not neglect meeting them. Otherwise, illness in the household is indicated. The family's prospects flourish like the moon emerging from clouds and lighting heaven and earth.
months.10: Your effort is no less than anyone else's, yet plans encounter many obstacles. A benefactor nevertheless appears to help, bringing financial gain. What you seek can be fulfilled as intended, giving you personal ease. This is the fruit of the effort you have invested.
months.11: Happy events are indicated in the eleventh and twelfth lunar months. If there is no official advancement, an unexpected gain may arrive. The southwest is associated with substantial wealth. Put energy into your work; active effort is needed for a sound result and its benefit.
months.12: Clouds scatter and the moon emerges, making the whole world bright. Avoid disputes, however, since excessive visibility can invite gossip. There is concern involving your children. The traditional text recommends Buddhist prayer in advance to avert adversity and let the moonlight guide your way.

231.chongun: If you do not act when the right time arrives, when will you have another chance? Recognize the opportunity and take it decisively. Great wealth is difficult to obtain, but a modest gain is indicated. Do not invite or seek dealings with a guest from far away. Once you know the time has come, act promptly rather than delay. Do not miss the opportunity given to you. A valued helper's intended support can become harmful if the moment passes. At the same time, restraint is best: respond without rashness. Even a shallow river can moisten a fish's dry scales. A ram thrusting into fences may meet harm wherever it goes. A deer hiding from people instead encounters a tiger. Take care.

months.1: The autumn sky clears without a single cloud, and the bright moon shines anew. Benefit is associated with the west, so attend to the completion of work. If the household does not gain a member, official advancement is indicated.
months.2: Your spirits rise as high as the sky and your intentions feel fulfilled. Seeking money can produce a gain. Guard against losing belongings this month. A wealth star shines at the door, suggesting substantial resources. Do not miss the timing; make an active attempt.
months.3: An upright mind and cultivated virtue contain their own benefit. Treat people carefully. The north is favorable, with opportunities while finishing work or before beginning it. Recognize and seize the chance. For concern involving your children, the traditional text points to medicine from the south.
months.4: Avoid harmful people and maintain a measured position within your circumstances. You can then avert adversity and find a favorable outcome. A bright moon in a clear sky casts pure light. Affairs become clear and manageable, allowing a wish to be fulfilled.
months.5: Matters do not go as intended: one effort succeeds and another fails. Failure through another person may cause considerable harm. Plans can also prove insubstantial, making new undertakings unfavorable. Avoid starting something new and choose associates carefully.
months.6: A ruler and minister meet harmoniously and bring prosperity, indicating the arrival of a helper. This benefactor is associated with the east and offers support as you begin new work. Receive the person thoughtfully. Something new allows small gains to accumulate into a larger achievement.
months.7: A single branch of plum blossoms beautifies a home and brightens its neighbors. If there is no trouble within the household, concern about a parent is indicated. A person surnamed Jeong or Lee is named as a possible source of benefit. Cultivate relationships sincerely.
months.8: A benefactor comes to support your undertaking, so proceed without undue worry. Yet even abundant gains may lose half their value, requiring care. Do not forget that chasing empty desires can cause harm.
months.9: Misplaced trust in another person's words ultimately proves unfavorable. Joint work may be difficult because the two people have different intentions. Nevertheless, the undertaking itself is described as reaching completion. Do not stop it prematurely.
months.10: Helpers from the east and south support you. Sincerity when beginning and expanding work draws assistance. Benefit lies in the west, so put equal care into finishing. If the gain does not come through income or provisions, it may come through land.
months.11: If empty desire stirs again, substantial harm may be difficult to avoid. Do not covet another person's property. A poorly chosen association can also cause harm. Restraint and an upright course are the most direct ways to protect yourself.
months.12: Benefit is associated with the south and with advancing existing work more actively. An unexpected helper may then appear. Financial prospects flourish and substantial resources enter the home. Guard against theft or misplaced belongings, and do not neglect details.

232.chongun: You encounter a tiger at night and can neither advance nor retreat easily. Obstacles may turn your efforts into an expenditure of strength without result. Empty desire brings hardship. Avoid rash movement, which leads toward failure. Seeking new work or forcing matters is unfavorable. People seem more inclined to harm than help, leaving you uneasy. Though the beginning is wearying and difficult, favorable fortune waits later, so there is no need for despair. If a matter remains unresolved, the traditional text suggests discussing it with a Buddhist monk. A favorable star shines at the door and brings many happy events. Spring is favorable; do not miss its opportunity.

months.1: In the first and second lunar months, you begin to move and then stop again. Starting work as intended is difficult. Yet a favorable star at the door brings a happy event. Spring holds an opportunity that should not be missed. Continue trying despite the difficulty.
months.2: Spring finally returns to the garden, filling it with flowers and fruit. Resources appear in many places, and warm breezes greet you wherever you go. Alongside this abundance, the reading warns of official trouble or, alternatively, illness that may tire the body.
months.3: Money intended for someone else unexpectedly comes to you, like a windfall. Wealth from the southeast enters the home, associated with beginning work and bringing it to completion. A matter requiring discreet handling will arise, with benefit within it.
months.4: Do not casually draw close to unfamiliar people. Illness is indicated, so take care of your body. Caution remains necessary amid happiness, particularly regarding official trouble. Living peacefully within your circumstances can avert adversity and lead to unexpected success.
months.5: Work carried out discreetly finally succeeds and flourishes, likely involving relatives or relations by marriage. Favorable fortune brings a happy event. A lingering unease remains in one corner of your mind, but steadiness can keep it from becoming a problem.
months.6: The moon enters clouds and its light becomes difficult to see. The south is unfavorable, so avoid travel there. Expanding too far in pursuit of prosperity can cause harm. If there is no financial loss, unexpected adversity is a concern. Carefully preserving existing work is best.
months.7: Personal fortune is very favorable, revealing good even within adversity. Roads open north and south, keeping you busy with little leisure. Bringing existing work to completion naturally requires activity. A fierce tiger emerges from the forest with such presence that even the plants tremble.
months.8: Adversity turns into jade, leaving your mind free of worry. Yin and yang unite, bringing favorable prospects. If official advancement does not occur, the birth of a son is indicated. Blocked work resolves beneficially, so continue without hesitation.
months.9: Two tigers fight, and it is unclear which will win. A dispute resembles their struggle and may only increase gossip. Otherwise, it may bring legal trouble and harm. Keep clear of arguments.
months.10: Travel is unfavorable. Remain steady and preserve the old, since seeking the new may cost what you already have. If trouble seems likely at home, the traditional text recommends prayer beforehand to avert it. It also describes an eventual success in a newly planned undertaking.
months.11: An unwise association can cause harm; do not seek improper profit. Personal fortune is unfavorable, so guard your health. Adverse signs outnumber favorable ones this month. Trying to obtain too much may cost even what you already possess.
months.12: You are at ease without particular worry, and the household is peaceful. Clouds disperse and the moon emerges, allowing a wish to be fulfilled. Yet changing occupations may bring only distress. Avoid overreaching and remain within your circumstances.

233.chongun: A dragon submerged in deep water obtains a wish-fulfilling jewel, opening endless possibilities for change. Fortunately, meeting a benefactor can bring recognition. Official or legal trouble, if it arises, will make life tiring and difficult. Acting on misplaced trust in someone's words is unfavorable, so pay attention to relationships. Financial prospects flourish and many undertakings come to completion. With a helper's constant support, little stands in the way of success. Good rain arrives at the right time, suggesting a plentiful harvest this year. A phoenix raises five young, an image paired with building a great fortress in the south. Going out is very favorable and may bring unexpected wealth. Once a phoenix spreads its wings, it can travel far. Good fortune waits at the door; the text recommends prayer at the year's beginning to welcome it.

months.1: Heaven and earth answer one another, and all things hasten to grow. Blessings respond in the first and second lunar months. A benefactor remains nearby, watches your difficulties, and offers unexpected help. This support brings your task to completion.
months.2: Plans come to completion quickly, bringing considerable benefit. Like geese returning together in a flock, you can cover a great distance. If your name does not gain recognition, a child's birth or another addition to the household is indicated.
months.3: Household affairs flourish, and an increase in family members or land improves the family's prospects. Someone else may conceive your intended venture first. Hesitation risks losing the lead. With affairs proceeding smoothly, substantial wealth can enter the home.
months.4: A hostile spirit is pictured watching the door, warning of unexpected adversity. Guard against theft before a loss brings regret. The north is unfavorable, so avoid travel there. If work becomes tangled, stopping altogether to rest may instead cause harm.
months.5: Your plans may provoke another person to act against you. Be cautious about someone associated with the west, particularly a person rushing to finish the work. The possible harm is considerable. A poorly chosen connection can lead to financial loss.
months.6: Benefit lies in the south, making that the favorable direction. Advance work already begun with energy; there is little cause to hesitate. Many activities bring benefit and earn others' respect. Empty desire, however, causes harm. Do not reach beyond your circumstances.
months.7: Avoid disputes, which can cost money. When the reasoning is sound, others have little basis for criticism. If there is no unexpected gain, a child's birth or another household addition is indicated. Keep out of arguments and make the facts clear.
months.8: A dispute can readily lead to legal trouble, so keep your distance. Benefit comes from far away, and moving toward it can bring money. Do not let impatience narrow your view; look beyond the immediate scene. Your name spreads and earns admiration.
months.9: Wearing a laurel crown, you receive others' respect. Like finding a way to survive after being cornered, you discover good within adversity. This is unfavorable for a petty person but very favorable for a person of generous character. Exercise restraint when a situation is beyond your ability to manage.
months.10: A favorable star brings a family celebration. Benefit is associated with the south and north, and with advancing work vigorously before bringing it to completion. Another person's help may produce an unexpected financial gain.
months.11: Happy developments arrive in the eleventh and twelfth lunar months. Though your mind carries distress, circumstances can turn favorable, so do not worry excessively. Your name becomes known near and far, helping many matters resolve easily.
months.12: Another person may cause considerable financial loss. A poor association harms your resources. Yet your mind is described as peaceful and free of worry. If you can readily let go of smaller losses, little remains to trouble your heart.

241.chongun: At home you feel unsettled, while going out lets your mind relax. There are beginnings and impressions but no clear endings or firm sense of direction; activities appear and vanish like drifting clouds. Making too much of an unnecessary matter may lead to an argument. Financial prospects are relatively steady, yet your mind is troubled. Starting or becoming deeply involved can be difficult, while going out is favorable, suggesting that work should be sought outside. Happy developments are associated with the east and north, before and during the launch of something new. A hawk pursues a pheasant, making its destination difficult to discern. In a quiet spring forest beneath a high sky and falling dew, a fan serves little purpose.

months.1: Staying home unsettles your mind, while going out is favorable. Rather than repeatedly worrying over existing work, consider a new undertaking. Avoid travel west or north. Drawing a conclusion before a task has begun is premature. The east alone is named as favorable.
months.2: Uneven personal fortune brings distress and many worries. Entering another person's affairs with an unsettled mind can lead to an argument and gossip. Concern at home suggests taking a trip away from it or finding interest in something new.
months.3: Lost in a deep mountain valley, you cannot easily distinguish any direction. Your mind is equally unsettled, making work feel empty. Putting your home and tasks in order beforehand can help avert adversity.
months.4: A favorable star shines on the home, bringing a benefactor's help. The south and north are favorable, and working alongside another person is advised. You need to enter the field to find the outcome; acting alone is difficult. Small gains accumulate into a substantial achievement and abundant resources.
months.5: Wealth lies in every direction, bringing favorable prospects wherever you go. Joy lights your face, and many tasks can succeed. Benefit is particularly associated with rice and wood: food and making things are the activities described as profitable.
months.6: You earn money on a trading journey and buy extensive fields, an image of abundance. Yet the bright moon enters clouds again, bringing a period of difficulty. If there is no financial loss, adversity involving your children is indicated. The traditional text recommends Buddhist prayer beforehand.
months.7: Personal prospects seem blocked, suggesting trouble at home. Money enters the household, but half is lost and only half remains. A favorable beginning turns unfavorable. The traditional text attributes this to a problem with an ancestral grave and calls for renewed care of the family burial place.
months.8: Rain clouds fill the sky, creating the unease of an approaching downpour. Two people share one intention and gain considerable money day by day. Yet accumulating it is difficult, like rainwater flowing away as soon as it falls.
months.9: A letter arrives from afar, suggesting a welcome meeting with a friend or someone from the past. Even at such a reunion, entering another dispute can lead to gossip. Handle relationships carefully. Seeking work east or west makes your purpose difficult to fulfill.
months.10: Your undertaking does not fit the circumstances and is difficult to complete. Do not covet another person's money, as it can cause harm. Empty desire brings little benefit and invites financial loss and distress instead.
months.11: An unwise association may cause financial loss, so avoid beginning new work or discussing another venture. The east is unfavorable. Even money entering the home can become a source of harm. The mountain path is rough, making progress difficult despite your wish to continue.
months.12: Financial fortune finally returns, and affairs begin to resolve smoothly. Caution in dealings with authorities is needed to keep the favorable course to its end; do not attach yourself to power for advantage. A benefactor can then help you obtain considerable wealth.

242.chongun: A new burial is made over an older person's grave. Two people have different intentions, creating an unfavorable situation. Keep what comes before and after consistent, and prevent the two sides from clashing. If there is no illness affecting a parent, unease may arise elsewhere in the family. Attend to harmony. Rash movement makes loss and gossip difficult to avoid; living steadily within your circumstances is preferable. Difficulty comes first, but later progress opens and a favorable outcome arrives. Affairs can then resolve more easily. Personal concerns remain. A neighbor to the east may be a good friend, while one to the west is less favorable. Even a fault can become something valuable when corrected. Laughter and conversation, however, cannot always restrain the tongue.

months.1: Unfavorable fortune may bring hardship to parents or close family, so take care. You can find and pursue work, though it may not match your intentions. A benefactor from the east offers unexpected help, suggesting new work and renewed vitality.
months.2: The west is favorable. Put your heart into bringing work to completion. Personal worry remains, but financial prospects are very favorable. Peach blossoms fill the second lunar month's spring breeze. Overcoming the personal concern leaves room for considerable happiness.
months.3: An unsettled mind makes it difficult to hold a firm position, and the restlessness may continue even in dreams. Yet adversity turns favorable, bringing substantial benefit. A wealth star shines at the door, allowing resources to arrive naturally.
months.4: Wealth is piled like a mountain, offering reassurance and ease. The west is favorable for obtaining money. Recognize an opportunity as work approaches completion. Unsettling dreams and the prospect of fruitless effort call for greater calm, not less.
months.5: Your base is stirred into movement, favoring a house move or a new undertaking in a different place. Establishing a new home or pursuing new work can turn adversity favorable. Do not act rashly, however; a poorly launched business may fail badly.
months.6: If there is no argument, gossip may arise, so do not interfere in others' affairs. Growing close to an unfamiliar person can bring failure. The source's wording about which connections are safer is unclear. Calmly settling your mind before working is favorable, while restless movement is harmful.
months.7: Seeking fish in a tree is as fruitless as trying to eat a painted rice cake. Yet, with your body on the road, every direction becomes home and movement need not be blocked. Benefit is associated with the south. Find meaning in your existing work and advance it energetically.
months.8: A wish lies hidden in your heart; actively seeking it now can bring fulfillment. Financial blessings accompany you, making a gain possible. Your inner wish can be achieved easily. Unexpected money is associated with both east and west, so attend to beginnings and endings.
months.9: Financial prospects seem good, yet half of the gain may be lost. Gossip may follow, making patience and endurance preferable. The reading also calls the financial situation unfavorable and advises against seeking additional wealth. Trying to gain more may cause an equal loss.
months.10: Casting a line into a blue river suggests catching a large fish. Yet the traditional text pictures a water spirit confusing names and warns about water and fire. A coincidence may make you appear responsible, like a crow taking flight as a pear falls. Possible official trouble prompts a recommendation for Buddhist prayer beforehand.
months.11: A young ox becomes ill, making a long journey too demanding. Tasks are difficult to complete, so do not take on an excessive burden. Seeking benefit elsewhere is unfavorable. Avoid reaching outward and remain within your circumstances.
months.12: Personal danger is indicated, so take care in your movements. Without testing the ground first, you may fall. Small matters can provoke gossip and distress; handle them with a broad perspective. The traditional text recommends Buddhist prayer to avert adversity and turn the unfavorable into the favorable.

243.chongun: The moon hides beyond the western window, and strange dreams recur. Darkness blurs the boundary between sleeping and waking. In a struggle for control, reporting another person may cause blame to fall on you instead. Financial prospects involve gaining and then losing; little comes in while much disperses. Do not desire what lies beyond your circumstances. Stability and restraint are the surest route toward favorable conditions. Gossip is indicated, so avoid quarrels and involvement in others' disputes. Take care with water and fire this year. Returning to your roots allows you, only later, to shed an old layer. Money can easily leak away. Do not casually invest in another business or new undertaking.

months.1: Sorrow and worry fill your heart, with disputes or litigation around you. Begin with an understanding attitude. Your own intentions may be honest, yet many circumstances remain ambiguous. Closeness to a familiar friend may look substantial outside while proving empty within.
months.2: A running horse loses its way and cannot find a route forward. Plans fail to reach completion and may bring financial loss. Even a close friend turns away coldly. If someone harms you, there may be no one ready to take your side.
months.3: Remaining at home within your circumstances brings few mistakes; otherwise, failure is easier. There is no overwhelming concern, yet unfavorable finances leave dissatisfaction. Family discord makes it difficult to settle your mind. Restraint is the best course.
months.4: Keep yourself orderly and your mind composed, and failure has less room to intrude. An unsettled mind drawn into romantic or sexual affairs can become caught in persistent gossip. Having gone hand in hand with someone to a pavilion, how can you simply blame a friend's coldness afterward?
months.5: Money can be gained, but gossip and arguments follow, causing distress. When body and mind are uneasy, turning away from disputes and settling yourself is favorable. A poorly chosen association can cause your undertakings to end in emptiness. Take care.
months.6: A hungry person meets a plentiful harvest, finally enjoying a comfortable livelihood and satisfaction. Your name spreads and earns admiration. Benefit is associated with farming, an image of diligently managing the work already yours.
months.7: Unease is shared, and even sitting down brings no calm. The south and north are favorable; avoid the east and west. Faithfully developing existing work can produce a sound result. Yet an undertaking may seem close to success and still fail to fulfill your aim. Be careful.
months.8: A small beginning produces a great result, like streams joining and flowing to the sea. Money arrives, but gossip may accompany it. Water or fire may cause a fright. Maintain care and restraint.
months.9: You stand in the middle of a road, indicating at least one distant journey. A poorly chosen friend can cause considerable harm, so be thoughtful in your relationships. A deep concern lies within, and others may not understand it. You may have to bear it yourself.
months.10: A mountain and countless treasures sink beneath the water, leaving sorrow beside a deep, broad sea. The traditional text warns of mourning or, alternatively, illness. Good and bad are balanced; bitterness eventually gives way to sweetness. Patience and endurance can lead to a smile again.
months.11: A water spirit is pictured lingering nearby. Avoid carelessness around water or in work connected with it. Otherwise, a serious fright may occur at home. If there is no litigation, gossip may be difficult to avoid. Take care.
months.12: Spring returns to the garden and countless flowers bloom, bringing joy. Good fortune fills the home, and its resources naturally flourish until little is lacking. Planning a partnership with someone else is unfavorable, so be careful when seeking a business partner.

251.chongun: You climb Mount Penglai to seek an immortal, only to return disappointed. Another person's help may bring an unexpected gain, but unreasonable desire leads toward failure. Support from others requires cultivating kindness and goodwill, something not accomplished overnight. Do not readily believe what people say; financial loss may follow. An insubstantial venture has little prospect of success from the beginning, so insisting on it alone invites failure. Rash movement makes regret difficult to avoid. An elder brother attacks the north while a younger brother attacks the west, suggesting a possible chance of victory. Without sound judgment, however, only strength is wasted. Harm can appear in many matters; proceed as carefully as if conducting a battle. Thoughtfulness and sincere prayer at the year's beginning are described as favorable.

months.1: Failure is indicated in your undertakings. You seek and plan work, but completion is difficult. Unclear judgment makes it hard to distinguish the situation properly, wasting your strength. Affairs are uncertain, and even a result may quickly collapse.
months.2: Seeking a jewel in the middle of the sea makes a fine treasure difficult to obtain. Affairs do not follow your wishes; an early smile may give way to disappointment. Do not casually trust someone close. The reading associates such misplaced trust with calamity.
months.3: Being unable to leave home first brings resentment and tears, but later becomes a reason to smile. A small concern at home unsettles body and mind. An unexpected matter may draw you into litigation. Avoid any dispute that arises.
months.4: This is favorable for a person of generous character and harmful for one of petty character. Examine your intentions before acting. Wealth is available in many places, and people arrive to help. Once this opportunity passes, another may be hard to find. Take hold of it.
months.5: Staying home is favorable and going elsewhere harmful. Preserve existing work rather than seeking the new. The reading also describes moving house or changing occupations as a way to turn adversity favorable, provided you wait for a helper before acting. A person surnamed Park is named as the helper.
months.6: Knowing how to let go of something small can help you obtain something large. Yet that outcome may itself cause harm. Two people's intentions separate. Planning work together can make the resulting difficulty hard to avoid.
months.7: Money arrives, but half of it may be lost again. Continuing litigation brings financial loss in its wake. Disregarding and abandoning what is nearby in pursuit of something distant makes success difficult and failure more likely in the reading.
months.8: Breaking stone to obtain gold brings the joy of a financial gain. Even money meant for someone else may unexpectedly come to you. Your name gains recognition, health improves, and wealth arrives alongside them.
months.9: Plants meet autumn and wait anxiously for frost. Moving house, pursuing something different, or traveling is described as favorable, calling for action. Alongside this, personal fortune is unfavorable, and the traditional text warns of mourning.
months.10: Two people share one intention, allowing their work to achieve its purpose. A poor association can instead cause harm, so choose carefully. Yet relationships also help expand farmland and strengthen the family livelihood. Continue to cultivate them with discernment.
months.11: Financial prospects are unfavorable; avoid another business undertaking. Believing someone else's words may cause a setback. Do not let persuasion draw you into an ill-considered plan. Obstacles are widespread, making staying home and preserving the old the best course.
months.12: Money can be obtained, but accumulating it is difficult. Someone from the south offers unexpected help. Put more energy into existing work, and it can succeed. Staying home with a steady mind is favorable; going out to pursue something else is unfavorable.

252.chongun: Without a house or settled place to live, life offers little pleasure. Its quiet, uneventful course makes it easy for time to pass without purpose. Gossip is indicated, so avoid arguments with others. Adversity lurks even within favorable circumstances. Begin by resolving the small concerns within the household. Though the way is blocked at first, it eventually opens. The text invokes the ancient practice of knotted cords in government and counsels accepting it as a custom handed down from long ago. Two family names share one household without harmony, like two tigers fighting. Benefit is associated with going out on the hunt.

months.1: Limited household resources make daily life difficult and the heart troubled. The sun sets beyond the western window, and old resentments fade with it. The household spirit stirs; hastily seeking money is unfavorable.
months.2: You climb a high pavilion and recline at leisure, enjoying laughter and happiness. Money arrives from many directions and draws respect. People of two different family names unite and help one another, allowing resources to arrive naturally.
months.3: Discord between those above and below produces persistent gossip. The continuing talk can turn favorable circumstances unfavorable. If there is no illness affecting a parent, illness elsewhere is a concern. Remain attentive to health.
months.4: Putting on your formal hat and leaving home, you hurry in every direction. Restraint and remaining within your circumstances are favorable; fruitless attempts to obtain money yield nothing. Much gossip comes from rushing without first examining the situation.
months.5: A mouse loses its rice storehouse, suggesting resources running out and another departure to sustain a livelihood. Like someone away from home, you are busy without a moment's rest. Effort and hardship may not produce a matching reward.
months.6: Avoid quarrels, which make gossip difficult to escape. Too many schemes leave the work ill matched to the circumstances and increase criticism. The traditional text recommends a sincere rite at your former home or place as a way to avert much of this adversity.
months.7: Official difficulties stir, so take care and avoid rash action. If a helper appears, the connection may lead to marriage or another favorable relationship. If there is no argument, litigation may still arise. Attend carefully to every matter.
months.8: Do not place excessive expectations on your current undertaking, as a setback is indicated. Favorable circumstances may turn unfavorable. Preserve your position rather than wasting your strength. Going east brings difficulty and possible loss, so do not expand your activities.
months.9: Documents carry favorable signs and can bring a financial gain. Looking out from an inn far from home, you may meet a welcome friend. Avoid desiring what lies beyond your circumstances, and you need not face a hollow result.
months.10: A modest financial gain is possible this month, so do not rush. Official trouble or gossip may occasionally arise. A favorable beginning can turn unfavorable later. Preserve and sustain the good circumstances while they last.
months.11: A hungry person finds food, like gold and jewels rolling into the home. A wealth star shines at the door, bringing abundance through an unexpected gain. Your heart finally feels satisfied. The image is of meeting a benefactor in a pavilion surrounded by flowering woods.
months.12: Accumulated virtue brings a further celebration sooner than expected. Composure and sound care of the household create resources and blessings, leaving little room for interference. Someone among your acquaintances will help you, reflecting the goodwill you have cultivated.

253.chongun: Flowers rise like a wall in a spring garden, while countless things flourish together. Personal circumstances are peaceful, with favorable results wherever you go. A helpful star points to a benefactor whose support you receive. The traditional text associates sexual indulgence with illness and calls for restraint. Harmony among family members brings official recognition. Without that harmony, personal prospects may instead become unfavorable. Eloquence and command over six groups allow free movement through every direction, without obstruction. The petty person's influence diminishes while the upright person's grows. Yet people are not always at ease; there may still be periods of scarcity requiring a plan for making a living. The reading recommends humble prayer at the year's beginning to welcome a more favorable course.

months.1: A favorable major turn finally arrives, allowing many matters to succeed like flowers opening on a bright spring day. Useful plans are associated with the south and north, and with developing your work before bringing it to completion. If there is no official advancement, a child's birth or an addition to the household is indicated.
months.2: Meeting a lovely person brings a happy event and a meaningful connection. Wealth flourishes in the east and south, suggesting achievement through something new. Benefit comes through the help of someone with whom you have already built a close relationship.
months.3: Warm energy reaches the door, and all things begin to flourish together. A dragon obtains a bright wish-fulfilling jewel, opening many possibilities. Make an attempt at what you intend. Like flowers opening in the spring breeze, your purpose finally finds its season.
months.4: Grass beside a green river grows still greener in rain; similarly, a benefactor's help supports your growth. Travel is unfavorable and staying home favorable, so avoid seeking profit outside. A dragon opens heaven's gate, an image of wealth and honor.
months.5: Fortune opens widely, and the household enjoys peace as though singing a song of prosperity. Financial benefit is associated with people surnamed Jeong and Kim; cultivate those connections thoughtfully. The traditional text warns that indulgence in drink or sexual affairs may bring illness.
months.6: You are first to pluck the laurel branch, an achievement that draws widespread admiration. Unexpected honor and distinction come with a benefactor's help. Substantial wealth is associated with the south and north. Put your strength into advancing work already begun.
months.7: Financial prospects flourish, indicating a gain. Setting your sights too high, however, can turn favorable conditions unfavorable. Remain measured and proceed carefully. If there is no illness affecting a parent, a startling event involving your children is indicated.
months.8: You stand in a grand house with confidence and a strong presence. The household is peaceful and harmonious, thanks to cooperation between those above and below. Travel west or north is favorable. Give your full attention to bringing work to completion.
months.9: You rest in a pavilion on a moonlit night, drinking and enjoying yourself with a peaceful mind. A family celebration is indicated, likely a child's birth or another household addition. Wealth is associated with the west and south. Continue your existing work and bring it to completion.
months.10: Even the lamp goes out on a dark road, leaving every direction obscure. Loss of money and purpose brings distress; guard against theft so that your heart is not harmed as well. Benefit is associated with a relationship you have cultivated well.
months.11: Affairs proceed smoothly without obstruction, bringing confidence and pride. If this favorable course fails to appear, an empty result may instead bring deep disappointment. Yet an unexpected benefactor is indicated, offering help and reason for hope.
months.12: Family members unite in intention, and benefit arises from their harmony. A person surnamed Jeong is named as a source of gain, so observe your connections carefully. Even after receiving money, little may remain because considerable spending is required.

261.chongun: Far from home, you meet an old acquaintance and feel great joy. Do not dwell on hardship; ease comes in the end. Personal effort is tiring, but accepting and enduring this period can bring a favorable conclusion. Though your mind has many concerns, financial prospects are very favorable. Let the gains offer some reassurance. You and a benefactor meet and help one another, bringing recognition that spreads widely. Spring is associated with the birth of a cherished child and a celebration. Fallen petals gather in such abundance that they invite a cup of wine. The sun travels high across the sky, and the world first glows red with brilliant evening light. Neglecting relationships can eventually cause loss. The traditional text recommends sincere prayer at the year's beginning to welcome this favorable course.

months.1: An early frown becomes a later smile as fortune gradually opens and returns. The family grows and land increases, filling the home with happiness and laughter. You are busy, but effort can bring a corresponding achievement.
months.2: Someone hears of your difficulty and comes to help, with an unexpected gain indicated. Like spring grass meeting welcome rain, blessings arrive naturally. Adverse conditions turn favorable, bringing joy and increased household resources.
months.3: Personal unease delays financial results; they arrive later rather than immediately. Hard work does not receive an instant reward. Preserve the old and remain steady, and people can come to help. Staying within your circumstances is advisable.
months.4: Yin and yang unite, indicating a celebration. If there is no official advancement, a child's birth or another addition to the household brings joy. The text warns against leaving home because of illness. Seeking benefit outside may leave work unfinished and the body strained.
months.5: Official difficulties stir, so avoid unrealistic dreams and empty behavior. Many eyes are watching. If two people unite their intentions, even difficult work can be completed quickly. Think first of harmony. A family celebration, specifically the birth of a son, is indicated.
months.6: Roads open east and west, keeping you busy away from home. You may rush to begin and finish work. Other people's words offer little benefit, so do not give them undue weight. Private distress and a clouded mind can leave you wondering whom to confide in.
months.7: You sit alone playing the geomungo by bridal candles, an image of elevated circumstances. Favorable fortune comes after hardship, with benefit expected in autumn. Traveling in every direction may begin well but end less favorably. Prepare for what comes next.
months.8: Promptly advancing your undertaking is favorable and can bring it to completion. Put energy into it. If a benefactor arrives, substantial wealth may follow. Value your connections. Spring flowers have found their season and can bloom before setting fruit.
months.9: Your plans proceed smoothly toward completion. Personal fortune is very favorable, with benefits across your affairs. Earlier effort finally bears fruit. Strength and resources flourish, and you return home after fulfilling your aim, full of confidence.
months.10: The south and north offer food and clothing. Advance your work sincerely and finish it well. Wealth is particularly associated with the north, and joining forces with someone can help with completion. A poor association can still cause harm, so choose carefully.
months.11: Affairs move smoothly without obstruction. Achievement comes through people, making good relationships valuable. Spring returns to dry branches, restoring their form. Difficulty comes first and prosperity later, with wealth associated with the south and north.
months.12: Benefit lies far away, so avoid impatience. Travel can bring a gain, and meeting a benefactor may yield considerable wealth. Yet the northwest is unfavorable: money sought there may not come as intended and the effort may prove harmful.

262.chongun: After three years of drought, the year's difficulties are easy to imagine. Work steadily rather than lamenting hardship. Favorable fortune comes later. Though the beginning is difficult, the way eventually opens and the right time arrives, allowing many matters to move forward. Bitterness passes and sweetness returns; success comes after a delay. Your intended undertaking can finally be achieved without obstruction. The traditional text recommends prayer at a mountain temple to avert unexpected adversity and bring harmony at home. A clear moon rises above green mountains, but who raises a hand to welcome it? The moon sets, crows call, and a sigh follows. Moving house or trying another undertaking in advance is also described as a way to avert this difficulty.

months.1: Hardship and distress leave you uneasy. Do not desire what lies beyond your circumstances. Harmful schemes serve no purpose and lead to empty results. Bitterness eventually gives way to sweetness, bringing success, but only after a delay.
months.2: A poor association can cause harm, so be alert to ill-intentioned people from the outset. If there is no legal trouble, gossip or illness may arise. Concern involving your children is also indicated, though it is not described as causing major loss. Avoid excessive worry.
months.3: A difficult period calls for care with illness. The more unsettled your mind, the more attention your health needs. Even in personal hardship, a secure place to live provides support; keep your living situation stable. Eventually, affairs become smoother and even a modest sum reaches the door.
months.4: Plans may be made, but money is difficult to obtain and the return small. Empty desire is unfavorable. Avoid harmful schemes or secret arrangements. Rowing upstream naturally takes effort; make sure your reasoning and conduct are sound.
months.5: The candle goes out on a dark road, leaving every direction obscured. Romantic or sexual entanglement may bring an unusual difficulty too close to avoid. Benefit is nevertheless associated with the east, where a financial gain is indicated. A decisive attempt is advised.
months.6: A rough path lies ahead, making travel unfavorable. Do not pursue distant profit. Disclosing your undertaking to others may cause serious harm, so keep its details private. If there is no gossip, official or legal difficulties may arise instead.
months.7: A painted rice cake can be seen but not eaten. Thoughts are abundant, yet putting them into practice is difficult. The sun and moon are dim, suggesting personal hardship. Look after your body. A private concern may feel unrecognized by others, adding frustration.
months.8: Avoid disputes, which make gossip difficult to escape. Spring returns to an empty valley, and plants joyfully put out new shoots. Someone else's money unexpectedly enters your home, like a windfall.
months.9: Do not rush to begin another undertaking, as it may cause harm. Remain within your circumstances. Good fortune gradually returns, bringing favorable signs to many affairs. From here, matters improve step by step. Respond calmly.
months.10: Rash movement can invite unexpected adversity and illness. Preserving the old and seeking stability can avert much of the difficulty. The west is associated with financial loss and gossip. Hold back from making a hurried decision.
months.11: The eleventh lunar month brings little loss and little gain, balancing good and bad. Wealth is associated with the east and can be found by going out. Planning work produces some sign of progress. People surnamed Kwon and Park are named as favorable connections; treat people sincerely.
months.12: A favorable opening is indicated. Missing it may bring regret that cannot easily be undone. The traditional text recommends sincere Buddhist prayer at a mountain temple for family harmony. Unexpected adversity remains a concern, so avoid distant travel and protect yourself with a calm, attentive attitude.

263.chongun: Under a clear breeze and bright moon, you sit alone beating a water jar like Zhuangzi. Affairs fail to reach completion, while illness adds hardship and invites lament. Yet yin and yang come together, and for a time all things begin to revive. A dragon meets the blue sea, indicating a happy event. A favorable beginning later turns difficult, like leaving home and struggling in an unfamiliar place. Otherwise, concern involving your spouse is indicated. Plant melons and melons grow; plant red beans and red beans grow. Establish your connections with clear intentions. A high mountain stands ahead and an even higher ridge behind. Welcome rain will eventually fall from the drought-stricken sky and bring new shoots. Wait for that time.

months.1: There is little work or business available, making achievement difficult despite effort. If no matter involves the authorities, illness at home is indicated. Prepare against hardship. Meeting a benefactor can bring personal peace, offering something to look forward to.
months.2: A family celebration is indicated through a child's birth or another addition to the household. Wealth lies in the north and can be obtained by seeking it. Concentrate on finishing your work. Avoid the south, where favorable conditions may turn unfavorable. Expanding too much is not advised.
months.3: The west and south are unfavorable. Do not force a thriving undertaking to continue or hastily settle its accounts. A poorly chosen association can cause harm. If there is no argument, gossip may arise, making avoidance of quarrels advisable.
months.4: Official advancement is described in the traditional text as offsetting the ominous sign of mourning a spouse. Otherwise, gossip connected with the situation may multiply. Move with care and composure. A celebration is said to dispel this adverse sign; without one, the text retains its warning of mourning.
months.5: Avoid the south, where favorable conditions may become unfavorable. Expanding work too much is not advised. Meeting a benefactor can bring an unexpected gain, so attend to relationships. Financial loss may still follow; handle every matter carefully.
months.6: Avoid the west, where good prospects may turn unfavorable. Rushing to finish work is risky. Obstacles make even sought-after tasks difficult to complete. Your intention exists, but the result may not follow: a beginning can be left without an ending.
months.7: Take care in all matters, as financial loss may follow. This year's caution particularly calls for abstaining from alcohol. The east and north are associated with disputes. Be thoughtful when discussing a new undertaking and at its beginning, or arguments may be difficult to avoid.
months.8: You want to fly but have no wings, regretting that you did not obtain them earlier. Your undertaking seems empty, yet you can neither advance nor stop easily. Fortune is unfavorable. Do not devise or apply reckless schemes.
months.9: With worry filling your heart, staying quietly at home is preferable. Avoid going out or expanding your activities. Litigation or arguments invite gossip. Even when money is obtained, accumulating it is difficult. Take precautions beforehand.
months.10: A mountain bird leaves the forest and has neither support nor a place to perch. If there is no unexpected adversity, financial loss may be difficult to avoid. Take care when coming and going. Greed leads toward failure; restraint can avert this difficulty.
months.11: Even a modest sum is expected to arrive, with the north named as favorable. Leaving the old and seeking the new brings a happy event ahead. Make a strong attempt. Finding a good horse, even late, offers the chance to travel a great distance in a day.
months.12: Without a firm inner position, your mind wavers between happy and sad developments. Affairs do not follow your wishes, so avoid new plans. An ill-considered attempt can cause harm. Fortune opens in winter, neither exceptionally small nor large. Pay attention to the timing.

311.chongun: Like a traveler hurrying home who reaches a river without a boat, you face uncertainty and disagreement between those above and below. Reputation may suffer, or weariness and humiliation may follow. Winter is especially difficult; forcing a crossing would bring losses. Many ambitions keep you rushing about, yet completion is elusive. Someone who steals the immortals’ wine cannot hide a reddened face, and an offense against Heaven leaves nowhere to appeal. Wait for the right time and avoid reckless advances.

months.1: Regret and self-reproach may leave you feeling misunderstood. Joint plans carry a loss warning, so weigh matters independently. If seeking resources, the north is favorable; follow through carefully.
months.2: Staying home is favorable, while movement may bring regret; do not meddle indiscriminately. Without a move, the reading warns of a surprise concerning children. Unending dark rain makes the bright moon hard to see.
months.3: The road opens, bringing resources and satisfaction. A quietly prepared plan can succeed; careful attention supports peace at home. A household celebration is associated with children, and joy can be shared.
months.4: Avoid distant travel and other people’s affairs, which invite gossip and entanglement. Do not despair over scarce resources: hardship can eventually open a way. The fourth and fifth months call for caution; the traditional text recommends Buddhist prayer.
months.5: Fish and dragons have lost their water: the beginning and end are unfavorable. The old text warns even of mourning clothes. Prepare carefully; fleeing a wildcat only to meet a tiger symbolizes danger on the road.
months.6: Official troubles make matters hard to conclude. Two people disagree, so avoid arguments that could become legal trouble or worry over children. The traditional text recommends prayer at a sacred mountain to disperse worries.
months.7: Benefit lies north and south. Pursue work fully, but make room for proper rest. During the three autumn months, staying within your means helps avert trouble. Empty schemes signal losses.
months.8: Avoid vain ambition and reckless conduct, which offer little benefit. Home may feel unsettled, while a southern journey is favorable; support the work already underway. Returning resource luck is associated with cultivating fields.
months.9: The warning concerns either financial loss or children; attend to the household inside and out. Once this difficult phase passes, opportunities may arise in every direction. Illness is also mentioned, so care for your health.
months.10: Small rabbits cannot resist a group of tigers in a deep valley. Trusting persuasive words out of desperation may trap you in gossip. The north is favorable, the south unfavorable. Observe quietly and avoid extravagant giving.
months.11: The south carries a warning of unexpected trouble. Publicizing ambitious plans unsettles matters. Stay within your means and live calmly to avoid harm. Resources are difficult to obtain; wait instead of exhausting yourself.
months.12: Exchanging something small for something large symbolizes a substantial gain. Resources arrive from many directions, bringing abundance. Secret schemes toward either east or west are unfavorable; avoid plotting.

312.chongun: A blue bird brings news, and a solitary man finds a partner. Ten years of effort may yield their reward in a single day as favorable circumstances return. A helpful person makes plans easier to accomplish; their assistance may lead to marriage or a good friendship. Joy marks the year. Like a fish leaping the Dragon Gate, recognition can rise until your name reaches the world and your horse stands at the palace gate. A fading moon reflected in water accompanies you for a thousand miles. The traditional text recommends sincere prayers at the year’s beginning to welcome this favorable turn.

months.1: A helpful star shines at the gate and a benefactor approaches. A household celebration resembles a gracious person offering a cup, suggesting a romantic meeting. More family members, farmland or a larger home may bring joy.
months.2: Celebrations concerning children and storehouses filled with gold and jade symbolize prosperity. Your name becomes known near and far, earning respect. Like spring flowers meeting their season, your prospects bloom.
months.3: The text raises an illness warning and recommends temple prayer. If illness occurs, it names a physician surnamed Park in its traditional advice. An auspicious star also signifies meeting someone who has survived grave danger.
months.4: Consistency from beginning to end favors honor. Choose companions carefully, as the wrong person may obstruct your work. The text pairs a possible windfall with an alternative illness warning; maintain ordinary care for your health.
months.5: Favorable circumstances return, bringing resources and comfort. An auspicious star suggests pregnancy or another addition to the household. A substantial early gain is followed by stability.
months.6: A household celebration accompanies an unexpected gain. Keep your intentions upright and wait for the proper moment; the reading favors success. Avoid quarrels, which could turn into losses.
months.7: The resource star enters the gate, symbolizing an unexpected gain and delight. Reputation and material benefit grow together, and good news reaches influential households. Joy fills the home.
months.8: Matters are broadly favorable and resources arrive. A benefactor offers help; sincerity in relationships matters. Benefit lies in the west, and completing work carefully may bring an unexpected gain.
months.9: Like losing the path in a deep mountain valley, progress becomes difficult. Plans may stall and others may keep their distance. Staying home is favorable, where a helpful person may come; avoid going out.
months.10: Beside a window on a moonlit night, a substantial plan can take shape and succeed. Documents are favorable, especially those connected with land. Keep your intentions sincere and stay within your means to remain steady.
months.11: Avoid distant journeys, where unfavorable matters await; protecting what you have is better. Plans can proceed as intended and substantial resources may arrive without haste. With renewed confidence, advance where the way is clear.
months.12: Another person’s help may bring a happy occasion, so cultivate connections. Calmness prevents favorable circumstances from turning sour. If plans resist your wishes and worldly affairs feel hollow, keep a broad perspective.

313.chongun: Confusion fills your affairs, like a spirit appearing in daylight. Wind extinguishes a lone lamp; with sun and moon obscured, directions become hard to distinguish. A trusted acquaintance may speak sweetly yet fail to keep promises. Plans falter and deception is possible, calling for vigilance. Staying home is favorable; seeking gain outside is not. Travel is unsettled, and the text particularly discourages crossing water. A full moon must wane and a full vessel overflow. Flowers hidden in the depths, or fine robes worn at night, symbolize qualities that go unrecognized.

months.1: Remaining completely inactive may threaten work, while purposeful activity offers gains. The warning concerns either financial loss or illness. Joy and caution mingle, bringing both laughter and sadness.
months.2: Worldly affairs resemble passing clouds: a favorable start may turn difficult. Guard against gossip or theft through careful words and actions. A boat in stormy water cannot advance easily; exercise restraint.
months.3: Protecting the household steadily can eventually bring good fortune. The reading is cautious about health and urges ordinary care. It traditionally recommends prayers at a mountain temple to avert trouble.
months.4: The sun disappears behind clouds. Going out may bring harm or financial loss, so act carefully. Other people may be involved in those losses; choose relationships thoughtfully.
months.5: Personal circumstances improve and obstacles ease. Resource luck reaches the household, supporting its prosperity. Benefit lies in remaining calmly at home and staying within your means.
months.6: Exchanging something small for something large suggests a gain. Do not covet another person’s resources, which could reverse the benefit. Avoid arguments and the gossip that follows them.
months.7: A bird with an injured wing cannot fly. Work has an order: stop flapping impatiently and do not rush. Gossip is possible, and schemes are difficult to realize, even if pursued secretly.
months.8: The waning moon becomes full again, clarifying what was uncertain. The text favors going south beforehand to avoid unexpected trouble. Continue your work sincerely; joy and hardship are evenly mixed.
months.9: The moon sinks in the western sky and troubled dreams disturb rest. Fear of theft and lost resources may keep you awake. The text warns of a substantial unexpected loss, urging preparation.
months.10: Documents carry risk, so choose associates carefully and do not discuss matters with everyone. Unexpected resources may also arrive through connections you have nurtured. Gains can arise in several directions, potentially bringing a substantial amount.
months.11: You need to cross the river, but an injury at the bank makes passage difficult. Avoid a long journey; the route may be blocked or harmful. Leaving home simply because of discontent can bring needless loss.
months.12: The warning concerns either illness or parents, so attend to health and family circumstances. Something large leaves while something small returns, symbolizing financial loss. Uncooperative affairs can make the world feel dreamlike.

321.chongun: A deep wound challenges even the legendary physician Bian Que. Household spirits are restless, bringing unease at home and hesitation over stalled plans. Take care around water and fire; an empty alarm may startle you. A gain can turn into trouble, and early losses call for a cautious beginning. Midway through the first lunar month, the text pictures a daughter’s birth and an added family member. Though your heart and intentions are ready, gains and losses are mixed. Eventually something small leaves and something larger returns, allowing a principled path to grow. Shallow planning, however, can spoil a clever effort.

months.1: Old ground stirs up gossip. Hold firmly to established foundations rather than starting new ventures. Coveting someone else’s resources can lead to a serious setback.
months.2: Without a move, the reading warns of worries concerning spouse or children; it suggests changing the surroundings. Projects seem close to completion but remain difficult, consuming effort without results. Going out feels easier than returning home.
months.3: A hungry person finds food but no spoon. Apparent windfalls hover out of reach, so they are not yet real gains. Staying near disputes brings hurtful gossip.
months.4: The moon vanishes into dark clouds. Plans made with others struggle to succeed. Boasting about them can provoke gossip, quarrels and hurt feelings.
months.5: Helpers from east and south signal a chance to begin and advance work. Household difficulties may still be substantial and require endurance. Reaching beyond your means could undo earlier achievements.
months.6: Resources lie scattered along the road; persistent pursuit may yield a little. The sixth and seventh months bring obstacles just as matters seem ready to work. Repetition calls for independent judgment rather than reliance on others.
months.7: You wish to advance but see no clear road. Unexpected trouble and unresolved affairs bring more worry than solutions. The traditional text recommends sincere prayer or Buddhist offerings at a mountain temple.
months.8: Following others blindly complicates matters. Romantic or sensual entanglements carry a financial-loss warning. Traveling merely to escape frustration is associated with illness; stay within your limits.
months.9: Unfamiliar companions can bring considerable gossip. The text links remaining in the same place with illness and suggests a change of surroundings or a brief journey, while specifically discouraging travel west or north.
months.10: Many wishes may remain unfulfilled. Poorly chosen company can entangle you in gossip. When everything feels difficult, do not launch unrealistic projects based only on your own assumptions.
months.11: The year’s better prospects lie in winter, so work toward a sound finish. Not everyone offers genuine help; judge flattering promises critically. A household celebration is associated with children.
months.12: Unexpected resources bring delight, described as the fruit of unnoticed good deeds. A benefactor could make the gain substantial. East and west are unproductive for seeking work; avoid forcing either a new beginning or a conclusion.

322.chongun: In the third month of late spring, blossoms fall and fruit forms. Welcome rain ends a drought, clouds part to reveal the moon, and fresh grass by the river feeds the cattle. The year pictures joy through a child’s birth or an added household member; alternatively, marriage or a good friendship. A breeze over an autumn well reaches the paulownia leaves first, announcing the season. Body and mind feel at ease, and many affairs turn favorable. A traveler returning in worn clothes finally changes into new garments. The traditional text recommends prayer to welcome this renewal.

months.1: Yin and yang harmonize, bringing celebration and agreement between generations or ranks. A birth-associated star suggests a child or another household addition. Help from others supports resources and favorable circumstances.
months.2: The text offers official advancement or, if that does not occur, a warning of material trouble. Otherwise affairs proceed smoothly, with images of substantial daily gain, growing standing and abundant resources.
months.3: Upright intentions support unobstructed progress. The text warns of mourning if you do not move and recommends changing your surroundings. If not a birth, another addition to the household brings celebration.
