months.4: A person from the east offers help, favoring a new beginning. Troubles recede and vitality and resources strengthen. Someone surnamed Park may provide unexpected assistance; nurture your connections.
months.5: The resource star favors the northeast. Pay attention before and at the start of a project. Aimless movement is harmful, while a purposeful new undertaking is favored. Resources may follow, potentially in substantial measure.
months.6: Spring returns to hills and fields, making the world feel renewed. If resources do not arrive, a celebration concerning children is suggested. A difficult start turns favorable; look for benefit within adversity.
months.7: In the seventh and eighth months, avoid gossip and interference in others’ affairs. Water and fire oppose each other, symbolizing fruitless conflict. East and west are favored, especially for beginning and concluding work.
months.8: A benefactor’s help supports both resources and vitality. Good conduct and a favorable reputation attract assistance. Affairs proceed smoothly, bringing personal ease and household peace.
months.9: Something small leaves and something larger returns, suggesting a renewed household. Help from others can lead to considerable success rather than a purely solitary achievement. Ventures become favorable and progress opens.
months.10: Arguments may lead to financial loss. Stay out of other people’s affairs to avoid persistent gossip. Others may not understand private distress; take time to steady and comfort yourself.
months.11: Sun and moon remain bright, filling the home with joy. If recognition does not come, material gain is suggested. Household prosperity and flourishing family members add to the happiness.
months.12: Avoid disputes that could entangle you in gossip. Choose associates carefully because financial loss is also indicated. Once conflict begins, it may be hard to resolve; peaceful conduct supports an easier life.

323.chongun: A bow without arrows cannot stop an approaching thief. Resources and virtue provide the foundation for success, but listening to the wrong advice can obstruct a good undertaking. Moving or changing your surroundings may bring gain. Proceed carefully, for steep ridges await. Do not despair over hardship: favorable circumstances can still follow. Joy and sadness alternate; the old text attributes this to neglected ancestral observances. Southwest travel carries a loss warning, as does misplaced trust in a close friend.

months.1: A tiger has run until exhausted. Travel is nevertheless favored toward the southeast, where a firm initiative may help. Across the year, keep quiet rest in mind rather than relying on constant exertion.
months.2: Projects begin but fail to finish; excessive concentration may only drain strength. If not wandering away from home, the text warns of official trouble. The second and third months call for restraint amid repeated resistance.
months.3: The text describes either illness or the pain of childbirth, the latter also a celebration. Avoid crowded places under this cautionary reading. Otherwise, difficult gossip may arise.
months.4: Plans are difficult to complete and offer little immediate gain. East is favorable and south harmful; take a careful first step rather than expanding grandly. Staying within your means and avoiding rash action helps prevent failure.
months.5: Unfavorable circumstances call for care against unexpected trouble. A poorly chosen associate may cause harm; avoid joint schemes with that person. Do not start another venture or a new project amid these uncertainties.
months.6: Obstacles unsettle the mind. Prepare against financial loss rather than waiting until it occurs. Yet spring returns to an old tree, signaling that light and renewal can eventually appear.
months.7: Welcome rain falls on drought-stricken crops, bringing abundance. A benefactor offers joyful assistance. Respect your limits and avoid chasing outside wealth to reduce the chance of failure.
months.8: The warning concerns either illness or a major worry. Without a clear position, unexpected events may leave you hesitant. Avoid arguments that could become official or legal trouble; guard your words.
months.9: The northwest is favorable, possibly through a romantic connection; watch opportunities as work concludes. Gain also lies in the north and may become clear after completion. Time discreet plans carefully.
months.10: Resources are hard to obtain by searching outside; staying home is preferable to impulsive travel. Trouble can recede and plans may succeed. Outward appearances of wealth may still exceed the substance underneath.
months.11: Quietness is favorable and unnecessary movement harmful. Protect current work rather than opening new fronts. Do not despair over a bitter period; honor may eventually follow. Remaining within your means is the sounder course.
months.12: Success and failure alternate. The text warns of mourning or, alternatively, worry concerning children. Ups and downs are ordinary in any campaign; keep your composure. With little gain and much gossip, let needless remarks pass.

331.chongun: Small grasses meet spring, while the lotus waits until autumn to bloom. A great merchant ship returns laden with treasure; seedlings revive in welcome rain after drought. Ventures succeed through other people’s assistance. Trade is favored this year, with money providing the means to earn more. A benefactor helps fulfill your hopes, like a mouse finding a grain storehouse. Gentle moonlight falls over a cradle, and the world appears bright and unhurried. Official documents are favorable and may lead to a helpful person. The traditional text recommends welcoming the year with prayer.

months.1: Spring returns to familiar ground, reviving everything. A change in documents may bring an unexpected gain. Resources are associated with official channels; proceed sincerely rather than chasing unrelated wealth.
months.2: Resource prospects are strong and an unexpected substantial gain is pictured. Yet a dragon in a narrow stream cannot summon its full clouds and rain. Favorable and unfavorable factors mingle, so substance may be less impressive than appearances.
months.3: Flowers bloom in a spring garden at their proper season. Benefit lies in official channels, and sincere effort receives its reward. Worries disperse, joy appears and life feels calmer.
months.4: Two people acting with one mind can accomplish much. A benefactor’s assistance may bring substantial resources, showing the value of good connections. Flowers opening in the spring garden suggest something newly gained.
months.5: The fifth and sixth months picture resources arriving in abundance; prepare to receive them responsibly. An auspicious star uses the old image of an elderly man marrying a young woman. Others’ assistance helps ventures succeed.
months.6: Circumstances turn as winter gives way to spring. With preparations in place, an unexpected gain may feel like a windfall. Household prospects strengthen and a benefactor helps, supported by solid groundwork.
months.7: Cooperation can bring unobstructed progress and material benefit. The seventh and eighth months include matters requiring discretion. Do not place blind trust in a romantic connection from the west; gossip could become difficult to escape.
months.8: A benefactor appears beside a moonlit window. A household celebration is associated with children; alternatively, official advancement arrives as the result of prior preparation.
months.9: Rain falls after drought, promising a rich harvest, and returning spring deepens the green of plants and trees. Affairs are favorable; sustained effort can bring the desired result.
months.10: Small accumulations build into a substantial store. Flowering trees in a spring garden begin to bear fruit. Remaining at home is less favorable than going out to seek resources.
months.11: Set your purpose, for a hoped-for undertaking can reach completion and reward. Avoid the water’s edge under the text’s unexpected-danger warning. Thoughtful effort and practical follow-through support material gain.
months.12: Exchanging something large for something small signals loss. Empty greed can cause distress over money. Staying within your means is wiser and may even allow an unexpected gain.

332.chongun: A new thatched house stands beneath Mount Bukmang, an old image associated with burial grounds. Unfavorable spirits stir quietly, unsettling the home and mind. Yet hardship can turn favorable; the traditional text recommends prayer or Buddhist offerings. The year initially makes it difficult to give every matter full attention, but a difficult beginning may improve later. It warns of illness in a parent or worry concerning children. An aged sky and barren earth leave even a hero’s achievements unrecognized. Disagreement between those above and below prevents lasting ease. Benefit lies in the south, where a plan can finally take shape.

months.1: Without sight of sun or moon, worry darkens the mind. Alternatively, unsettled matters may arise at home. Prepare carefully and avoid associates whose influence could bring financial loss.
months.2: Leaving home without a destination resembles drifting through city streets. Household discontent affects both older and younger members. Misplaced belief in another person’s words may begin well and end poorly.
months.3: An unsettled mind makes resources difficult to obtain. Official work may involve retreat, while ordinary livelihood yields little. Fortunately, a benefactor could help you avoid unexpected trouble.
months.4: Home accumulates worry, while going elsewhere may ease the mind. The east favors meeting a helper and considering a new undertaking. The traditional text recommends Buddhist prayer beforehand to welcome a better turn.
months.5: Documents offer benefit, possibly through more land or an expanded business. Unseen assistance is pictured as dispersing trouble and returning good fortune. Abundant property and fine cloth symbolize household prosperity.
months.6: The warning concerns illness or gossip: mind both health and speech. Do not force a gain, since trouble may turn favorable in its own time. Avoid rash movement and wait for ease to return.
months.7: The text recommends Buddhist offerings to clear remaining troubles and calm the mind. Avoid quarrels and meddling, which may lead to litigation. Blindly trusting others offers little benefit and can bring absurd complications.
months.8: Unfinished matters have a beginning but no conclusion. Obstacles and misunderstandings create frustration. The traditional response described is Buddhist observance and care for ancestral rites.
months.9: Many undertakings can reach completion, bringing joy and peace. Recognition and vitality grow, and resources may be obtained without exhausting effort. The reading counsels appreciating this smooth period rather than searching endlessly for more.
months.10: The warning concerns a parent’s illness or a surprise involving children. Poorly chosen associates can be harmful; avoid indiscriminate dealings. Stay calm and wait, for joy can follow hardship.
months.11: The eleventh and twelfth months mix favorable and unfavorable factors so closely that they are hard to separate. Neglected precautions can turn a good situation difficult. Joint schemes may prove hollow; identify problems early.
months.12: A tree in the east seems to cry, symbolizing a new undertaking becoming tangled and distressing. The reading warns of illness and urges care for health. An unsuitable associate may also bring trouble.

333.chongun: Five successive arrows strike a tiger on the southern mountain. Sincere effort can likewise gain recognition, even if late. An initially difficult period gives way to honor. If not illness, a quarrel may cause hurt, so take care. Otherwise plans proceed as intended and influence allows your wishes to be heard. Waiting for the right moment supports success. A dragon ranges freely through the sky, as a capable person finally meets spring; abroad a general, at court a minister. A benefactor is associated with the east and gain with the west. The traditional text recommends prayer at the start of the year.

months.1: Rain fills a dry spring, restoring water to drink. Yin and yang connect, bringing recognition and a wider reputation. Confidence and vigor spread through your affairs.
months.2: Sun and moon shine brightly, filling the home with laughter. A celebration is associated with children, like welcome rain falling after seven years of drought.
months.3: A dragon gains a long river and open sea, allowing its powers full scope. Resources from another person unexpectedly reach your door. Favorable circumstances support a long-held wish.
months.4: The learned gain office and ordinary people gain resources, so benefit is pictured for everyone. Profit lies in the marketplace. Distant travel is unfavorable; staying home can avert trouble.
months.5: Guard against lost possessions. Do not trust idle advice from someone to the north. The text also contrasts a distant journey with an illness warning if no journey occurs.
months.6: If official advancement does not come, material gain is suggested. An acquaintance may unexpectedly offer help because of a relationship maintained well. Stay firm in purpose; recognition follows effort.
months.7: The seventh and eighth months resemble fish and dragons recovering their water. Yet excessive good fortune can invite worry. Staying within your means and avoiding rash action supports a significant achievement.
months.8: Timely rain promises a good harvest. Helpers from west and north are favored; attend to both finishing work and what follows. The benefactor is likely someone with whom you have already built a good connection.
months.9: The moon rises into a clear sky, creating beauty and calm. Ease of body and mind supports renewed effort. A helper is associated with the northwest; finish carefully and watch the next stage.
months.10: Do not chase imagined wealth elsewhere. Like an autumn lotus meeting its season, your qualities may draw attention. If not an unexpected gain, the reading suggests a birth or another household addition.
months.11: A line cast into a rough river catches a fish only after a wait; patience matters. Favorable circumstances support completing a wish or project. If no windfall arrives, official advancement is suggested.
months.12: Avoid sensual or romantic entanglements that could provoke difficult gossip. A small stream flowing steadily between stones eventually reaches the sea. Consistent progress makes your goal attainable.

341.chongun: On a journey of ten thousand miles, each advance reveals another high mountain. Plans resist completion, prompting changes of place or occupation. Spring brings a scattered mind; arguments may add persistent gossip. Many undecided matters prevent calm. If worry will not lift, going elsewhere may help. Finally the paulownia loses its leaves, so even a visiting phoenix cannot settle and flies away. Moonlight reaches a stream over white sand. The closing image carries traditional warnings of mourning or illness, calling for care.

months.1: A lone pine stands in a deep mountain, and a small boat floats on a vast sea. Contrary circumstances suggest loss, so proceed carefully. Yet affairs have their natural course, and difficulty can turn favorable.
months.2: The traditional text recommends mountain-temple offerings against unexpected trouble. People above and below fail to agree, unsettling plans. An unsuitable acquaintance may cause harm; judge character carefully.
months.3: Spring brings little gain, while summer begins to fulfill your intentions. Northward movement is unfavorable, but complete inactivity is not the answer. Keep working even when effort receives little immediate recognition.
months.4: Green willows and red peach blossoms announce spring. Ease of body and mind accompanies a household celebration. Resources lie outside; a purposeful journey to seek them may succeed.
months.5: Worry and gossip persist, making it difficult to settle. Avoid fighting over small matters. Someone you help may turn from gratitude to hostility, so maintain sensible boundaries.
months.6: A benefactor’s help may bring recognition. Yet flowers falling without fruit and fierce winds suggest incomplete results and unsettled circumstances. Do more than lament; patience is needed.
months.7: A cuckoo cries sadly in moonlit mountains. Avoid the east and new ventures, which offer little benefit. Even an actual gain may be half lost; prepare accordingly.
months.8: Effort may not receive its full reward. The text contrasts financial loss with separation from or conflict with a spouse. Do not let regret over money consume your health; care for yourself for the future.
months.9: Plans do not readily follow your wishes, stirring worry. A night of fierce wind empties the garden of blossoms. With the household unsettled, the old text recommends ancestral observances and prayer.
months.10: Keep applying effort and meet the challenge; a substantial gain may eventually follow. Rushing east and west leaves little rest. The image of a stream entering deep mountains points toward a better future.
months.11: Clouds scatter and the moon appears, refreshing the scene. Like spring grass growing again, progress becomes visible. Going out is associated with gain and welcome events, described as a gift from Heaven.
months.12: Recognize an opportunity and act, even if the gain is modest. Avoid disputes that could become lawsuits; watch your speech. People surnamed Kim or Lee are associated with benefit through relationships built sincerely.

342.chongun: A young person already leaves footprints in the world’s red dust. Household prospects are favorable and children may gain honor. A fierce tiger emerges from the forest, its influence reaching widely; timely rain promises a rich harvest. Official advancement or an unexpected gain is pictured. Circumstances open smoothly, with resources and support seeming plentiful. Spring fills Heaven and Earth, symbolizing children’s growth and possible childbirth. Yet every possession has its owner: care for what belongs to each person and guard against theft.

months.1: Favorable openings appear wherever you go; recognizing one can support a substantial achievement. A person finally realizes an ambition and advances confidently. Vitality, resources and a peaceful home are emphasized.
months.2: The text contrasts honorable official advancement with a less favorable alternative. Meeting a benefactor can bring substantial resources. Overall circumstances are strongly supportive of growth.
months.3: A household celebration suggests a marriage or another family addition. An auspicious star fills the home with joy, alongside the image of resources accumulating like a mountain.
months.4: A helper arrives with the warm southern wind of the fourth month. Hopes can be fulfilled without losing what matters. Resources may come unexpectedly, even without being actively sought.
months.5: If no favorable celebration occurs, the text warns of mourning. Resources may arrive, but outgoing expenses could exceed them. Unfounded gossip can escalate into litigation; take care.
months.6: At home the mind is unsettled, outside it feels tired. An initially difficult phase later turns favorable, with a substantial gain suggested. Fine rain in a spring breeze revives the plants.
months.7: Poorly chosen company is unfavorable; do not enter joint ventures indiscriminately. A helper arriving from the west may assist unexpectedly, making a careful finish important. Favorable and unfavorable factors are evenly mixed.
months.8: Rain breaks a drought and dry branches send out shoots. A hen laying eggs in spring symbolizes a birth or added household member. Avoid quarrels that could renew gossip and disturb a recently quiet mind.
months.9: The resource star favors purposeful activity. However, material abundance may coincide with physical strain, turning a good start less favorable later. Choose associates carefully to avoid harm.
months.10: Wealth and standing inspire respect, though neither is built overnight. Dealings with authorities carry a penalty warning, calling for upright conduct. Joint schemes may fail; proceed cautiously.
months.11: The eleventh and twelfth months favor smooth progress. If not a windfall, a celebration is suggested; any windfall may be modest. Repeated pleasant events support ease of body and mind.
months.12: Your reputation spreads widely. Across the year, staying within your means remains the best approach. The twelfth month especially emphasizes recognition; preserve a steady attitude as attention grows.

343.chongun: A thirsty dragon finally finds water, opening the prospect of abundant resources. Do not rush indiscriminately: mountain paths and fiery stretches still lie ahead. Private hardship may be difficult for others to understand. A difficult beginning can nevertheless end in progress and eventual gain. Joy and worry, favorable and unfavorable turns, are evenly mixed; laughter and tears are ordinary companions. Occasional official trouble or gossip is the caution. Mandarin ducks nuzzle together, resisting outside interference, yet on a mountain road you may find no guide or familiar companion despite searching north and south.

months.1: Even as a wish takes shape, unresolved doubts remain. Riding swiftly along a mountain path is difficult. Gains may be followed by larger losses, but the road must still be worked through carefully.
months.2: After wandering and searching, resources may appear only on the journey home. The text contrasts a windfall with a mourning warning if none comes. Benefit lies along the road; respond when a real opportunity appears.
months.3: Far from home, loneliness may tempt you to grasp at any support. Do not follow others’ words blindly, which could lead to disappointment. East and west carry loss warnings; take care at beginnings and endings.
months.4: The moon enters dark clouds and directions become hard to distinguish. The warning concerns illness or children; attend to health and household needs. Quiet envy from others makes avoiding conflict worthwhile.
months.5: The source gives mixed directional advice: it warns against west and north, especially at completion, then favors east and west for beginnings and endings. A fish leaving a spring for the sea symbolizes renewed freedom.
months.6: Retreating to a mountain for cultivation symbolizes dignified character. The southeast favors beginning and advancing work. Unexpected danger is pictured outside the gate; careful conduct can help avoid it.
months.7: Joint plans may fail. Obstacles make distant travel or overly ambitious schemes unfavorable. Scarce resources naturally increase strain; recognize the situation and endure it patiently.
months.8: An unsuitable acquaintance can bring loss, so be thoughtful about relationships. Do not neglect connections altogether, since benefit also comes through people. Genuine assistance could lead to a substantial gain.
months.9: Avoid outside ventures or unnecessary excursions, which offer loss rather than benefit. Joy and worry are mixed. Manage yourself carefully, enduring private strain without making it everyone’s concern.
months.10: An autumn night may bring homesickness and regret after overreaching. Staying calmly within your means can avoid this pattern. A visitor from the east is described unfavorably; avoid a joint undertaking.
months.11: The sun reaches the western hills and a returning traveler hurries home. Yet plans remain difficult to complete, making restraint the wiser course. The text warns of either official trouble or persistent gossip.
months.12: This month, genuine effort to obtain resources may yield something. Across the year, however, busyness may exceed the reward; accept what is available and prepare for later. Household discontent and financial loss are described as the remaining troubles passing through.

351.chongun: Trying to complete an undertaking before it has matured is compared to an unmarried maiden indulging in an unsuitable dalliance. Those above and below oppose one another, and the resulting harm may be considerable. Act at the proper time to overcome disadvantage; restless action and fanciful thinking eventually work against you. Basic provisions are already available, so approach your work with a settled mind. A household celebration is indicated, with benefit in extending landholdings. An unsettled life may finally shed its faults and bring an undertaking to completion. Do not despair over present hardship: later recognition and prosperity are suggested. The traditional verse recommends a Buddhist offering as a way to invite blessings.

months.1: Uneven wind and rain make crops difficult to ripen. Conditions seem unfavorable wherever you turn, like a solitary pine trying to root on bare rock. Keep your undertaking modest rather than expanding it.
months.2: A smile outside may conceal a frown within, and a promising beginning may lack a conclusion. Blindly trusting others brings disappointment. Prepare for unsettled household affairs and repeated setbacks.
months.3: Resources are difficult to obtain, and belongings may be lost. Empty ambition can bring small gains and larger losses. Wishes are hard to fulfill this month, so protect what you have.
months.4: An old dragon exhausts itself trying to rise into the sky. Clouds hide the sun, leaving the direction unclear. Arguments and gossip can prolong your distress; avoid being drawn into them.
months.5: Poor company may cause financial loss. Progress resembles rowing upstream. Conditions at home are unfavorable, while a move may help; advance carefully rather than forcing a rapid result.
months.6: Harmony at home allows resources to arrive and offers relief from hard work. A substantial unexpected gain is indicated; otherwise, gossip may be the concern. Do not force a profit.
months.7: A move or change of business is indicated; if neither applies, a change in your surroundings may be useful. Household concerns make the year demanding. Creating an enemy now can leave lasting harm.
months.8: The verse points either to an unexpected gain or a lost possession. Clouds cover the moon, making both advance and retreat difficult. Children may also be a source of worry; respond with sound judgment.
months.9: An auspicious helper may appear, yet two tigers fighting leave the outcome uncertain. Household disagreement can complicate matters. Pay attention to your health and avoid escalating conflict.
months.10: Wind scatters the plum blossoms, leaving neither beauty nor fruit. The text warns of mourning or concerns involving children. Good connections can provide help, so continue to act generously and cultivate goodwill.
months.11: Leave an old approach and seek a new one, like entering a spring field. Gold in a furnace can become a fine vessel. Your wings are not ready yet: stay within your means and allow achievement to come later.
months.12: A phoenix nesting and laying an egg in a pavilion represents a hopeful new beginning. The wealth symbol favors preserving or extending landholdings. Abundant resources and peace are linked to the good deeds you have accumulated.

352.chongun: A blue dragon rises into the sky, gathering clouds and rain. Choosing a suitable place and moving there is favorable. Spring brings a brief opportunity, so recognize it while it lasts. A boat in shallow water suggests little outward display but substance within. Advancement in office or an unexpected gain is indicated. Yet the crab hiding its eyes in the spring breeze advises patience: what is gathered in the morning may be scattered later if you rush. The cassia branch symbolizes success in examinations or recognition; if that does not apply, the verse points to a substantial financial gain. Proceed steadily. The traditional text recommends devotion at the opening of the year.

months.1: Fruit on golden platters and flowers above a feast suggest abundance and celebration. An enemy may become a benefactor, or a thief may confess. Your reputation receives praise in many places.
months.2: A ruler and ministers working in harmony symbolize flourishing affairs. Marriage, a new family member, or a romantic connection may bring joy. If there is no advancement in office, an unexpected gain is indicated.
months.3: Resources lie far away; travel to seek them when a clear opportunity appears. Wealth and influence are favored. Be selective about company, since a poor association can bring loss.
months.4: The verse favors the south while placing resources in the north. Sincere effort and careful completion bring a favorable result. An outwardly modest situation may be rich within, but the wrong associate can cause a substantial loss.
months.5: The wealth symbol points to a substantial gain, and undertakings are described favorably. An unexpected gain or advancement in office may provide the main benefit of the month.
months.6: A benefactor may offer an ingenious plan that succeeds. The household may grow, with a celebration involving children. A shared undertaking is favorable when you work together.
months.7: The cool seventh month brings the image of plucking cassia: examination success or recognition. Unexpected achievement earns praise at home. A small concern may arise, but affairs eventually proceed smoothly.
months.8: Wealth and influence revive like the world in spring. Cast a line into the blue sea and allow time for a large fish to bite; do not rush. The verse places resources in the mountains.
months.9: A white moon in a blue sky suggests a clear, cool beauty. The east and north are favorable. Take care before beginning and at the first steps, then make a considered attempt to fulfill a wish or obtain a gain.
months.10: A ship with a favorable wind crosses the open sea, leaving earlier hardships behind. A celebration rewards your efforts. Gain is indicated, though a minor physical concern deserves attention.
months.11: A dragon receiving a wish-fulfilling pearl represents newly available possibilities. A benefactor may help bring a substantial financial gain. Grain and other resources are described as plentiful.
months.12: The bright moon shines with many times its usual light. Joint plans may prove hollow, so an independent effort is favored. Avoid disputes and gossip that could disturb otherwise favorable conditions.

353.chongun: The opening image is a dream of a woman’s embrace in the night. Slender wisteria branches stretch between two warring states, a precarious position in which cooperation can provide a bridge. When two people unite, benefit is possible. Unexpected recognition may bring celebration, but the wrong associate can cause loss. A peaceful home and a calm approach to seeking resources favor gain. Someone close may also cause harm, so use judgment in familiar relationships. Wishes and financial opportunities may arrive without forcing them; a magpie’s cheerful song announces welcome news. The traditional text recommends prayer to welcome good fortune.

months.1: An unfavorable situation may turn favorable and bring peace. Home is more auspicious than outside activity. Like a boat meeting a new storm halfway across a river, a venture may face a sudden complication.
months.2: Different intentions make shared work difficult. Another person may cause loss, so choose companions carefully. A traveler hurrying as the sun sets reminds you to consider the time and distance still required.
months.3: Avoid disputes and the gossip they can generate. Resources remain steady, but give your health appropriate attention. Plans made in spring may prove hollow or remain unfulfilled.
months.4: Red peach blossoms in spring symbolize a romantic connection. A birth or another addition to the household is indicated. Resources lie to the west; carry matters through carefully to completion.
months.5: A traveler loses the way at sunset. Someone close may cause harm, so care for familiar relationships without abandoning judgment. The north is favorable, and benefit comes from within; avoid initiating or concluding a major undertaking now.
months.6: A boat struggles upstream: advancing brings worry, while retreat is also difficult for lack of strength. Concerns involving parents or children may add to the burden. Conserve your energy.
months.7: Unexpected recognition may come, but remain cautious. Matters involving children are favorable, and resources are plentiful. Blindly following another person’s words can invite gossip and unrest.
months.8: When two people agree in purpose, their work can succeed and bring gain. If this does not concern an undertaking, marriage or romance may be indicated. Going out and taking part in activities can be beneficial.
months.9: An upright heart and generous conduct bring benefit. Harmony between yin and yang suggests a celebration. Bring affairs to completion so that you can enjoy greater ease and peace.
months.10: White jade remains buried in a mountain, waiting for its time to emerge. Rushing toward future profit wastes effort. Outside activity may bring harm, while an established foundation offers benefit; wait calmly.
months.11: A rare opportunity for an unexpected gain may appear, so recognize it. The right associate can bring substantial benefit, while the wrong one can cause loss. Energy and resources otherwise flow smoothly.
months.12: Abundant resources allow body and mind to settle. Rain and a spring breeze revive the plants, suggesting renewed life and household ease. Give generously from what you gain to sustain the goodwill built by earlier good deeds.

361.chongun: The opening image asks why the hunting dog should be boiled once the cunning rabbit has been killed, warning of the danger of being discarded after serving a purpose. This year brings difficulty, so avoid chasing empty pursuits. Recognition and profit may be accompanied by unsettling gossip. As the sun sets and the landscape darkens, boarding a boat is unfavorable. Spring offers little return, making a hurried start to the year risky. Harm may come through another person. Yet even an angular shape contains a curve: when matters reach an extreme, they can begin to resolve. Will you merely stand aside from the world’s troublesome affairs? People’s feelings can change abruptly, making their behavior hard to hold steady.

months.1: The household spirit is stirred: settle your living arrangements or secure your position in advance. Success may not match the effort invested. Boarding a boat as the sun sets is an image of poor timing, calling for caution.
months.2: Without generous conduct, you may bring trouble upon yourself. Misplaced trust in someone close can cause considerable harm. A restless mind calls for deliberate, careful decisions.
months.3: Be cautious in your affairs and avoid becoming too close to unfamiliar people. Seek stability. Joint schemes are described unfavorably, so do not expand them. Past youthful glory may now seem dreamlike; avoid dwelling on it.
months.4: Disharmony between yin and yang makes undertakings difficult to complete; restoring cooperation comes first. The southwest is unfavorable for travel. Overexpansion or a rushed conclusion brings harm, and a lack of order obstructs progress.
months.5: Belongings may be lost, so guard against theft. An unsettled mind can lead to financial loss. Rewards still require effort: diligent work may bring a household celebration, particularly involving your spouse.
months.6: An unexpected gain or a celebration involving children may reward your efforts. The text advises restrained conduct at a house of mourning and warns of illness. Benefit lies east and west, with care needed at both the beginning and completion of work.
months.7: Do not be overwhelmed by gossip; it may even lead to benefit and greater ease at home. Stay composed, since impulsive action is unfavorable. An appearance of wealth may conceal little substance within.
months.8: A bird with an injured wing finds both advance and retreat difficult, yet cannot simply give up. The traditional fire-spirit image calls for care around fire. Prepare for trouble arising from another person’s affairs.
months.9: Hurrying brings harm; gradual progress brings benefit. The wrong association may seem favorable at first and become harmful later. A joint undertaking with such people fails to progress because their intentions differ.
months.10: The moon finally emerges through the clouds, lighting a clear and beautiful landscape. Advancement in office, a birth, or another addition to the household may bring joy. Misguided attention to others’ words can turn goodwill into hostility.
months.11: An undecided mind makes it hard to know whether to advance or withdraw. Settle your intentions, since hurried efforts meet many obstacles. Financial loss is indicated in the north; neglecting to plan can also cause loss.
months.12: Do not covet profit beyond your means; the verse describes blessings as heaven’s gift. Disordered work may have a beginning but no proper ending. Guard belongings against theft and approach your affairs with a settled mind.

362.chongun: A ruler and ministers share a peaceful banquet, an image of dignity and harmony. An unexpected gain may help establish a household even without an existing occupational foundation. Body and mind are comfortable, bringing warmth and energy. A birth may be indicated; otherwise, personal peace and esteem are favored. Helpers appear in the east and west, and both the beginning and completion of an undertaking deserve attention. The wrong association brings harm, so tend your relationships carefully. Spring brings a summons marked in red, suggesting recognition and an important calling. Yet officials have left their horses along a long road, an unexplained interruption in the scene. The final image is a white-sailed boat meeting a favorable wind on a vast river.

months.1: An auspicious star shines at the door, bringing favor and blessings. A household celebration is likely to involve children, reflecting harmony at home. Affairs are described as peaceful and enjoyable.
months.2: A clear-sighted ruler extends favor throughout the country despite disorder among the ministers. Unexpected recognition may lead to success and a widely known name. Resources and influence inspire admiration.
months.3: The sun and moon shine clearly, and happy events follow one another. A clear sense of duty helps affairs proceed. Daily renewal allows resources to accumulate. Opportunities lie outside; act when a suitable one appears.
months.4: An obstacle interrupts favorable affairs, and seeking outside profit may waste effort. Yet the clouds disperse to reveal the moon, offering a fresh view. Finances are favorable, though gossip makes careful relationships important.
months.5: Spring seems to dwell in clear wine as a hundred flowers compete to bloom. An unexpected gain or a celebration is indicated; prepare during ordinary times. Resources and income accompany a steadily flourishing period.
months.6: Resources appear beyond your immediate surroundings, favoring a journey or a new attempt. A thirsty dragon finding water suggests renewed capability. Even without a celebration, advancement in office is indicated.
months.7: Growing resources fill the household with joy. Stores of grain and other goods are abundant, and even unresponsive people may offer respect. A reputation spreading widely draws admiration.
months.8: Someone’s help allows the household to flourish and develop. Meeting a benefactor can bring continuing rewards, so make an effort to build relationships. Like fish and dragons finding water, undertakings begin to open up.
months.9: The benefactor is placed in the south, where sustained work may bring a meeting and unexpected assistance. Helpers are also indicated in the east and west. Benefit can come at both the beginning and completion of a project.
months.10: Continued welcome rain brings an abundant harvest. Resources are strongly favored, easing concerns over livelihood. Remember that this abundance reflects earlier effort, and maintain the conduct that helped create it.
months.11: A flourishing household outlook points to a celebration. Resources lie in the marketplace, with rice and medicinal goods named favorably. The wrong associate may bring trouble, so take care in transactions and relationships.
months.12: A household celebration may involve a new family member. Wishes come together as intended, bringing visible delight. Comfortable, smooth conditions can encourage idleness or arrogance; guarding against these helps preserve a favorable outlook.

363.chongun: Your name appears on an honor roll or is inscribed on a pagoda, traditional images of recognition. Property and clothing are sufficient, suggesting comfort and esteem. Reputation and profit are favored, and your name may become widely known. Benefit lies away from home and can be found through travel. Advancement in office brings attention and respect. The west is favorable, particularly for finding a chance to complete an undertaking. The moon wanders through a clear autumn night. Avoid becoming entangled in worldly disputes: chasing a small gain may lead to a large mistake. The closing verse warns against approaching watersides because of the risk of an unexpected mishap.

months.1: Plants meet spring, and flourishing flowers and trees cover the mountains in green. Peace at home and distinction involving children arise from mutual understanding. As the household grows stronger, benefit develops within it.
months.2: An old dragon rises into the sky, fulfills its purpose, and sends rain far and wide. Advancement in office is indicated; if that does not occur, the verse warns of an unfavorable turn. Recognition may make your name widely known.
months.3: Resources may gather and disperse, so take care when they arrive. Misguided attention to another person’s words can leave joy and worry evenly mixed; retain your judgment. The wealth symbol also points to an unexpected gain.
months.4: A peaceful body and mind accompany a respected name and generous conduct. An unexpected gain or public recognition is indicated. Fragrant orchids in the courtyard suggest a celebration involving children and a pleasant feast.
months.5: Keep the details of your work from a person associated with the west until it is complete. People surnamed Jeong or Kim are described favorably; cultivate relationships sincerely. Westward travel and rushing a conclusion are unfavorable.
months.6: A warm spring day revives all things. Heat and cold each have their season, suggesting success through proper timing. The east is unfavorable; if you have just begun an undertaking, pause rather than forcing it forward.
months.7: Many tasks keep you busy. The Travel Horse symbol favors going elsewhere for benefit, but excessive expansion creates activity without substance. Resources are available in several places; choose your opportunities thoughtfully.
months.8: When household members share the same intention, wishes can be fulfilled. Meeting an attractive person on a moonlit night suggests a welcome connection. A growing family and expanded property bring household prosperity and happiness through others.
months.9: Harmony between yin and yang revives life like a growing forest. Resources and rewards bring visible delight. The west is favorable, including for a move or change of premises. This is also a time to complete an undertaking.
months.10: Favorable conditions grow stronger, and a benefactor may help bring a substantial gain. Treat people faithfully to build such a connection. As dust gathers into a mountain, steady small efforts can produce an achievement.
months.11: Laughter and cheerful conversation may be almost uncontainable. The verse indicates examination success; otherwise, it warns of concerns involving parents. Helpers lie west and south, favoring a strong effort followed by a decisive conclusion.
months.12: Clouds pass and rain nourishes the plants, allowing life to grow. Benefit remains possible within difficulty, and affairs can proceed. Harmony between spouses fills the household with joy, reflecting kindness and human effort.

411.chongun: A fall from a tree leaves the spirit wavering, its survival uncertain. Resources may exist without achievement, and this imbalance can eventually become unfavorable. Yin and yang are out of harmony, preventing plans from coming together. Restore cooperation first, or the long journey ahead will grow increasingly difficult. Avoid undertakings beyond your means and attend to your health throughout the year. Morning brings no light, and even the hoped-for brightness at night remains elusive. Three battles end in three defeats, leaving ruler and ministers ashamed. The final image asks who truly owns the flowers and bamboo beside the road, questioning what can securely be claimed.

months.1: An old tree meets frost, and autumn chrysanthemums meet snow. Blossoms fall without fruit, suggesting loneliness and little support. Unsettled household conditions add to concerns; attend to your health.
months.2: Seeking something far away may cause you to lose what is close at hand. Avoid empty ambition. Disputes can lead to legal trouble and gossip, while a new venture may bring financial loss. Stay within your means.
months.3: Flowers bloom together in the third month’s spring breeze. Resources lie west and may be obtained through going out; recognize the right time to finish. The north is unfavorable and can turn benefit into difficulty. Observe calmly.
months.4: A lack of aspiration may accompany concern over your physical condition. Hardship creates worry, so care for both mind and body. Do not despair over present difficulty: the verse points to eventual resources and gain.
months.5: Disordered work prevents wishes from progressing. Put your affairs in sequence. Household concerns particularly call for attention to children and descendants; otherwise, the text warns of mourning.
months.6: Plants cannot flourish in land parched for seven years; waiting has become excessive. The water-spirit image warns about boats and water. A poor association can cause harm regardless of the person’s gender.
months.7: Another person’s resources may unexpectedly reach your household after a long wait. A shared undertaking can succeed and yield benefit. The traditional verse recommends prayer to the household spirit or a Buddhist offering for peace of mind.
months.8: The water-spirit warning returns, advising distance from watersides. Unprovoked gossip may arise; watch your speech and avoid disputes. An unnecessary journey offers loss without benefit, favoring attention to home.
months.9: Plants meet autumn, bringing alternating sadness and worry as an expected change arrives. Disputes can cause gossip and financial loss. People surnamed Jeong or Kim are described as ultimately favorable; build relationships sincerely.
months.10: Avoid becoming absorbed in sexual or romantic pursuits, which the verse links to poor judgment and failed work. It warns that the resulting harm may be considerable. Starting another venture is also unfavorable for finances.
months.11: The wealth symbol approaches the door, favoring both personal energy and resources. Someone may help, but such support grows through sincere relationships over time. Recognize a favorable financial opportunity when it appears.
months.12: Good faith may exist without practical substance, leaving plans hollow. An unsettled mind can invite an unexpected setback. Do not remain trapped in worry: benefit is still possible within difficulty if you regain composure and stay within your means.

412.chongun: Riding through the capital with the spring wind, you feel the confidence of a fulfilled ambition. Warm weather fills the land with peach and plum blossoms. Clear water reflects the mountains, as peaceful as resting in a high pavilion on a moonlit night. A household celebration is indicated, though a quarrel may briefly interrupt it. Undertakings proceed favorably, yet private distress may remain. Wind disperses the clouds and reveals a moon of exceptional brightness. Welcome rain and gentle dew nourish the plants. The verse holds that wholehearted sincerity reaches heaven and helps a wish come to completion. It recommends a sincere offering to welcome the year’s fortune and encourage a joyful year without regret.

months.1: Unexpected recognition may spread your name widely. Satisfaction brings warmth and enjoyment at home. Resources appear wherever you go, allowing a long-sought result to feel complete.
months.2: The traditional verse cautions men against blindly trusting women’s words, and women against blindly trusting men’s words. It also indicates favorable finances. Household members unite, the family prospers, and accumulated resources seem as large as a mountain.
months.3: Peach and plum blossoms open at the right time in a spring garden. Bees and butterflies gather among their fragrance. Resources and rewards accompany you, like discovering a rich vein of gold.
months.4: The water-spirit image advises caution near water and warns of a water-related fright. A magpie calling from the south suggests recognition and prosperity, with a substantial undertaking. A household celebration may involve children or descendants.
months.5: Avoid quarrels, which can damage both resources and reputation. A comfortable household gives little reason to become entangled in disputes. An auspicious sign at the door points to distinction involving children or descendants.
months.6: On a long moonlit journey, old acquaintances offer comfort and help. Trouble gives way to blessing, bringing peace at home. Handle the transition carefully. Harmony across generations allows the household to develop.
months.7: An unexpected gain, a birth, or another addition to the family may bring joy. An orchid displaying spring color alone in the courtyard suggests a welcome relationship. The wealth symbol points to a substantial gain.
months.8: Helpers from the east and north may assist a planned undertaking. A wild goose arriving from far beyond the clouds brings welcome news. Marriage is indicated; otherwise, incoming resources may bring delight.
months.9: Avoid a long journey, which may bring financial loss. Home, restraint, and stability are favored over aimless outside activity. The north offers harm rather than benefit, though caution need not mean abandoning all effort.
months.10: The household spirit’s support suggests that wishes can be fulfilled. Yet difficulty remains within favorable conditions: take care with written words, speech, and conduct. Home may bring worry while outside activity brings loss, requiring thoughtful choices.
months.11: The traditional text recommends Buddhist prayer to turn difficulty toward benefit. Resources and profit favor an expanding household. Staying inside feels unsettling, while going out is favorable; a new setting or a change of surroundings may help.
months.12: Personal peace leaves little need to seek more. Stay within your means and enjoy comfortable conditions. The wrong associate can bring harm; act faithfully without deepening unnecessary relationships.

413.chongun: A thirsty dragon finds water and gains the means to care for many living beings. An auspicious star at the door points to a celebration. With little inherited foundation, you may build your own success. The verse also indicates either financial loss or concern involving your spouse. An ordinary person may gain resources, while someone in a junior position may gain authority. As you advance, another person’s help can support your intended achievement. People gather to admire a full autumn moon. Even a high position need not feel precarious, allowing you to walk confidently through the fields. A benefactor is indicated in the west. The traditional text recommends a sincere prayer at the beginning of the year to welcome good fortune.

months.1: A welcome event at the door may help you establish a household or complete an ambition. Advancement in office brings confidence and dignity. Otherwise, a birth or another addition to the family is indicated.
months.2: Advancement and income stand firmly like a mountain, allowing ease and peace. Travel in several directions offers resources. The north is favorable, with Water and Metal named as sources of gain; observe quietly and choose the timing instead of rushing.
months.3: The wealth symbol suggests an unexpected gain. Harmony at home helps a wish come together. The north is favorable, but do not expand carelessly. Consider both the start of an undertaking and what follows its completion.
months.4: Esteem and recognition may spread your name. Resources and influence make each setting feel like plants meeting a spring breeze. Traveling south or north can bring benefit while strengthening an existing undertaking.
months.5: The household meets favorable conditions and repeated happy events, like a spring garden suddenly in full bloom. Water and Metal are named as sources of benefit, especially at completion or afterward. Recognize that timing.
months.6: An upright heart is associated with blessings and longevity. The verse warns of losses in dealings involving rice and fruit, calling for care when these goods change hands. Household comfort otherwise allows affairs to feel satisfying.
months.7: Planted pines have become a forest where birds gather, an image of an established foundation. Staying home is favorable, while travel is not. Protect what you have and avoid careless associations that may cause substantial loss.
months.8: Harmony among household members brings cheerful conversation and laughter. Family circumstances improve, and affairs follow your intentions. Meeting a benefactor may make life easier and renew your gratitude.
months.9: Reputation and profit are favorable, creating a sense of sufficiency. Respected conduct and a known name draw admiration. Substantial rewards and authority suggest an ambition finally taking shape.
months.10: An auspicious star accompanies you, with further celebrations to enjoy. Wishes meet few obstacles, making your delight visible. Resources and property are well supplied, with substantial gains indicated.
months.11: Favorable conditions support recognition and a household celebration, particularly involving children. The wrong association can still bring trouble. Choose companions carefully and treat them faithfully.
months.12: Fields full of ripened grain suggest an abundant harvest. Shared purpose with another person may bring substantial resources and profit. The west favors an unexpected gain; pay attention to finishing your work properly.

421.chongun: Escaping a fox and wildcat only to tread on a tiger’s tail suggests moving from one difficulty into another. With no clear place to lean on, effort may yield little benefit and leave the mind unsettled. Unfavorable finances can make time feel wasted, while strain may affect your health. Some resources arrive, but small gains may be outweighed by larger losses. Staying home brings unease, yet going elsewhere offers little profit, making movement hard to judge. Evening smoke rises as people hurry back to their homes. Your work resembles pushing a cart uphill: twice the effort produces little achievement. The closing image is a horse being driven along a stony road.

months.1: A traveler unexpectedly reaches a steep mountainside and cannot avoid hardship. Seeking resources now may prove hollow and leave disappointment. Looking for a rabbit in the sea is the image: the goal and the setting do not match.
months.2: Personal hardship makes worldly affairs feel insubstantial. Illness in the household may unsettle your mind and make work difficult. Financial loss is indicated; be cautious even with close friends and avoid overly intimate discussions of your plans.
months.3: Unfavorable circumstances may bring a difficult encounter with an adversary. Avoid disputes and respond quietly to reduce the chance of an unexpected setback. A tiger caught in a trap cannot rely on courage alone.
months.4: Periods of smooth progress and repeated good harvests offer a more comfortable outlook. The wealth symbol indicates unexpected gains worth recognizing. Disputes can still invite gossip, so avoid unnecessary conflict.
months.5: A junior person challenges a senior one, unsettling the household. A slow, measured approach is more favorable. Rushing can entangle even promising work, and the month also calls for care against financial loss.
months.6: You have the intention but not yet the practical plan, leaving something unresolved. A turn in conditions may offer a chance for an easier livelihood. Yet the wealth symbol appears in empty space: a hollow scheme can still end in serious failure.
months.7: Work does not match your wishes, increasing worry and unease. Hard effort may bring less recognition than it deserves. Continuing illness or discomfort adds concern; settle your mind and maintain a steady effort.
months.8: Avoid disputes, which may bring difficult legal trouble. The text also warns of mourning. If financial loss does not occur, concerns involving children or descendants may arise; take care in family affairs.
months.9: The symbol of official trouble reaches the door and unsettles the household. Be careful with speech and documents. Staying home is favored, but also use judgment in outside relationships and do not reveal every private thought.
months.10: Welcome rain falls on parched land, reviving dry shoots. Resources may become available wherever you go, allowing material needs to be met. Otherwise, household unease is indicated; direct sincere effort toward a sound livelihood.
months.11: Gossip may reach you in several places and cause distress. Household dissatisfaction keeps tensions alive. Stay within your means, guard against financial loss, and retain gratitude amid unfavorable conditions.
months.12: Outside pursuits of profit offer little benefit. Sincere work may still yield a modest return, so expect a reward proportionate to effort. A move or change of surroundings may alter the pattern and is worth considering.

422.chongun: Harm comes from someone so close that you call each other brother. Unfavorable circumstances place an obstacle just as something good seems possible. Intentions are clear, but fulfillment is difficult. The sun has set behind the western hills, and you cannot tell whether to advance or retreat. Yet resources lie along the road and may be found through seeking them. A small head and weak body symbolize limited capacity for a large task. Carrying a mountain while crossing the sea proves an empty boast. Progress and recognition are obstructed, and dispersed resources may be hard to recover. A distant journey is unfavorable, so patience is advised despite frustration.

months.1: Alone far beyond the clouds, you may feel isolated. The stirred household spirit represents unsettled conditions at home. Tend your affairs carefully: although worry persists, attention can prevent more serious trouble.
months.2: Plum blossoms open with a fresh, beautiful fragrance. Benefit lies in the west, especially through careful completion of work. Becoming absorbed in sexual or romantic pursuits may bring harm and gossip; remain faithful to your commitments.
months.3: The wealth symbol appears in empty space, making resources hard to obtain. Illness in the household may disturb your peace; give yourself comfort as well as care. Even a favorable development offers only a modest gain, calling for a measured approach.
months.4: Unexpected recognition can bring widespread admiration. Financial loss remains possible, so choose associations carefully and treat people sincerely. Rewards appear in several directions, suggesting a welcome period of ease.
months.5: Avoid places that feel strange or troubling, where an unexpected mishap is feared. Yet hesitation in the name of security may also bring harm. Undertaking something against your judgment is unfavorable, and affairs are hard to direct as intended.
months.6: Take care around water and fire, as the text warns of an unexpected mishap. Protecting yourself helps work remain stable. Quarrels bring no benefit and may leave you facing more gossip than you can manage alone.
months.7: An empty reputation may spread to the east and north, creating unease. Looking in every direction reveals little family support. Avoid places associated with drinking and romantic indulgence; the verse warns that these may strain or separate an existing partnership.
months.8: Going out is unfavorable because an unexpected setback may be difficult to manage. Watch closely for financial loss. The wrong association can bring trouble; remain trustworthy while avoiding careless disclosures.
months.9: Avoid impulsive moves and stay firmly within your means. Unfavorable conditions may leave you vulnerable to another person’s actions; attend to your health. Sadness and worry alternate, yet favorable moments and days of laughter remain possible.
months.10: After much strain, benefit can finally appear through patience and endurance. A person arriving from the east is described as potentially hostile; do not be drawn into their proposal for a new undertaking. Gloomy or secluded places are unfavorable for finances.
months.11: Disharmony between yin and yang may make agreement between spouses difficult; protect goodwill at home. A small financial gain is available through seeking it. Small amounts accumulate, and the year’s pattern moves from early difficulty toward later benefit.
months.12: Even resources obtained may bring complications, so do not boast about them. The wrong association can cause loss. Without order, worldly affairs remain as insubstantial as passing clouds; organize your work before proceeding.

423.chongun: Flowers fill a spring garden, drawing bees and butterflies to play among them. Favorable conditions point to a celebration, or to an opportunity to change your occupation or begin a different line of work. Even if the opening of the year brings no profit, affairs can begin to resolve. Rash action may cause an undertaking to fail before completion, so proceed carefully. The verse indicates either a move or concern over a parent’s health; a change of setting may be useful. Small beginnings can produce a larger result and steadily improving progress. Two people united in purpose have strength compared to melting iron. Mountains and waters exchange their energies, and wholehearted sincerity is said to reach heaven. The traditional text recommends an opening-of-year prayer.

months.1: Harmony between seniors and juniors brings peace and warmth to the household. A yellow dragon playing with a wish-fulfilling pearl suggests marriage or a welcome romantic connection. Otherwise, a birth is indicated.
months.2: Trouble recedes and blessings return, allowing a peaceful, enjoyable period. Stay within your means and settle comfortably, allowing rewards to arrive. Wishes may come together as intended, with a substantial gain possible.
months.3: An unexpected gain is indicated; otherwise, marriage or a romantic connection may bring delight. The wealth symbol favors growing resources. Treating people well and sharing a relaxed drink may help reveal a useful way forward.
months.4: A small amount goes out and a larger one returns, like soil accumulating into a mountain. Assistance may help establish a new home on a firm financial foundation. The wealth symbol at the door also indicates an unexpected gain.
months.5: Clouds disperse and the moon emerges, making the way ahead clearer. Meeting a benefactor may make this brightness seem many times stronger. Harmony at home and a peaceful mind offer deep satisfaction.
months.6: Examination success is indicated; otherwise, a celebration involving children may bring joy. A traveler in darkness finds a candle and can see again. Resources and favorable developments reflect sincere effort.
months.7: Substantial rewards and authority draw praise and respect. An auspicious star at the door points to a shared household celebration. If there is no unexpected gain, children or descendants may enjoy distinction and prosperity.
months.8: Act promptly on a considered plan, since excessive delay can become unfavorable. Harm may come from a poorly chosen associate, so use judgment. Harmony between yin and yang suggests a celebration.
months.9: Heaven’s blessing is the image for undertakings coming together. Good relationships may provide the connection through which an unexpected gain arrives. Wishes can be fulfilled, allowing a peaceful view of affairs.
months.10: Keep an upright mind and cultivate generous conduct, allowing rewards to follow. Harmony with others helps resource-seeking and other efforts succeed together. Be cautious of gossip and avoid intruding into someone else’s dispute.
months.11: Like a spring garden blooming at its proper season, affairs finally open up. Resources and income point to the joy of an unexpected gain. A celebration involving children may fill the household with warmth.
months.12: The west is favorable for resources, with care needed to complete your work. A comfortable mind helps affairs proceed. Do not be diverted by others’ suggestions, which may remove the benefit from an undertaking already going well.

431.chongun: The sky collapses and affairs hang upside down. Unfavorable conditions obstruct progress, and setbacks may seem relentless. An otherwise ordinary matter may cause a needless fright. Yet as digging into the earth uncovers gold, endurance can eventually turn adversity into blessing and bring ease. A household celebration is indicated; otherwise, concerns at home may arise. A lamp without enough oil cannot shine: intention alone is insufficient when circumstances do not support completion. An elder sits at a game of Go, whose outcome no one yet knows. The traditional verse recommends temple prayer, restraint in disputes, and forgiveness. Like a modest, considerate person ultimately fulfilling an ambition, patience can help this difficult pattern give way to comfort.

months.1: The first and second months bring household concerns, including a traditional warning of mourning for a parent. If that does not apply, another setback is indicated. Resources lie in speaking and writing, while agricultural work is described unfavorably.
months.2: A distant journey may bring disappointment. Attention to existing work at home is more favorable. Guard against theft and lost possessions. Personal conditions are favorable, but finances are not; take care not to let what you own slip away.
months.3: The image of hostile spirits represents sadness entering the household. Someone who has worked closely with you may unexpectedly cause harm. Plans have a beginning but no ending, making results difficult to achieve.
months.4: Disagreement and fighting among household members unsettle your mind. Completing existing work may reveal more loss than benefit. The traditional text recommends a temple offering and prayer with a composed, clear mind to ward off adversity.
months.5: Beginning a new undertaking may bring benefit and greater ease. The pattern moves from early difficulty toward later improvement. Yet abandoning existing work midway can cause harm, and someone close may provoke a dispute. Humility helps reduce the damage.
months.6: Restless dreams in the sixth month suggest unease, with unkind people seeming more visible than upright ones. Prepare for setbacks and remain patient even when angry. Tolerance and restraint are presented as protection: today’s generous conduct becomes tomorrow’s blessing.
months.7: Pursuing wealth alone will not secure it. Obstacles accompany promising plans, like a dragon deprived of its river and unable to exercise its powers. Favorable circumstances are lacking, so avoid unnecessary travel.
months.8: The moon disappears into clouds, making east and west indistinguishable. Financial loss accompanies work before its beginning and ending can be understood. Household unrest may send members in different directions; preserve your own steadiness.
months.9: Trouble recedes and comfort returns. The south is favorable for obtaining what you seek. A person associated with Metal may become a benefactor and bring unexpected resources. This is a time to attempt a considered plan.
months.10: A new undertaking can produce resources, while peaceful conditions bring warmth and stability at home. Finish existing work fully before beginning the next venture; overlapping them introduces risk.
months.11: The wealth symbol meets emptiness, indicating potentially substantial financial loss and household distress. The traditional verse recommends an offering and prayer to the mountain spirit. Avoid excessive ambition and gains without a sound basis.
months.12: Coveting another person’s possessions may lead to hurt over money. If there is no direct disagreement, persistent gossip may arise instead. Do not casually share private household matters, since your words may be repeated.

432.chongun: The opening image recalls Yuechang of Jiaozhi bringing a white pheasant as tribute from afar. Resources and authority attract the respect of those around you. A pond fish entering the sea symbolizes growing confidence and room to act. Good relations with familiar people turn them into helpers. Wishes come together, and you have freedom to pursue your affairs. Comfort and recognition accompany abundant resources, like a large harvest stored for tomorrow. A phoenix nesting in a distinguished pavilion brings delight. The wealth spirits of the east and north assist you. Like a general mounting a newly appeared dragon-horse, a clear intention helps progress and achievement. The traditional text recommends a prayer at the start of the year to welcome its blessings.

months.1: Like fish and dragons finding water, you feel confident and at ease. Work proceeds smoothly, allowing substantial resources to accumulate. Abundance brings peace and warmth to the household, with pleasure in many encounters.
months.2: A boat traveling a great distance on a favorable wind suggests smooth business growth. Someone close may still cause harm, so avoid a shared venture with that person. The traditional verse indicates the birth of a son; otherwise, advancement in office brings joy rooted in the household.
months.3: A benefactor’s help can contribute greatly to success. Benefit and recognition together allow your name to become widely known. A household celebration brings joy; sharing what you have adds to the blessing.
months.4: A plentiful harvest across the countryside brings shared enjoyment. Finances are favorable, and resources may arrive without strenuous pursuit. Travel east is described as obstructive and may bring official trouble. Value each encounter and act sincerely.
months.5: Full stores of grain and resources bring stability and growing peace of mind. A thirsty dragon finding water suggests a continuing livelihood. Yet misplaced trust can still cause failure, so avoid acting carelessly on another person’s assurance.
months.6: A young bird has wings but cannot yet fly, creating frustration. Even in unfavorable circumstances, a woman may help bring resources and relief. Avoid quarrels: anger and impatience can expose you to more serious gossip.
months.7: Personal hardship and exhaustion make work difficult to extend. Attempts to gather resources may instead see them disperse. The month begins favorably and ends less favorably, leaving benefit and difficulty mixed.
months.8: Moving among flowers morning and evening suggests delight. A benefactor may help make life peaceful, turning difficulty toward benefit. Advancement in office raises your name and draws respect.
months.9: An unexpected blessing within adversity is like a candle lit in darkness. A difficult situation contains the seed of improvement. Resources lie in the east and may arrive unexpectedly, helping a planned undertaking succeed.
months.10: A spring breeze and fine rain make the grass vividly green. Finances and peace of mind are favored, though seeking resources may involve some obstacles or gossip. A generous outlook helps preserve a sufficient livelihood and comfortable household.
months.11: Favorable conditions bring warmth and respect from others. Good intentions in your work are linked to corresponding rewards. Generous conduct and considerate relationships help build both reputation and substantial resources.
months.12: When household members unite, good things arise from their harmony. The traditional verse recommends calm prayer in a renowned mountain setting to disperse worry. Resources, body, and mind are described as well supported, peaceful, and honored.

433.chongun: Who knows what was done while hidden beneath the bridge? A little benefit is present, but outward reputation lacks substance. Greater effort in an existing undertaking may produce only a modest gain. Like a fish deprived of water, body and mind cannot settle. Energy is low, effort yields little, and wishes are difficult to complete. Beginning work in unfavorable circumstances brings less fruit than hoped. Take care against unexpected mishaps this year. A parent may be a source of concern, and illness may disturb the household. Someone familiar may cause harm and hurt your feelings. An unsettled mind and resources that refuse to accumulate can create a private burden that others do not see.

months.1: Beginning at the wrong time exposes plans to difficulty. Seeking flowers after spring has passed brings little return for the effort. Setbacks in several places may unsettle the household.
months.2: Plans formed in private are difficult to complete. Do not trust others too readily or speak carelessly. Dependence on someone close can damage resources and reputation. Use caution across your affairs.
months.3: Avoid quarrels: a small disagreement can grow into legal trouble. Advancement in office is indicated; otherwise, gossip may intrude. Difficult relationships favor yielding where possible, like two fighting tigers whose outcome cannot be predicted.
months.4: The south is favorable for obtaining resources. Benefit enters existing work, and steady management can yield a return. The wealth symbol at the door suggests improved finances and fulfillment of something you have wanted.
months.5: Without an existing financial foundation, the desired result is difficult to obtain. Plans meet repeated obstacles, and multiple attempts may yield little. The image of a woman calling to a man suggests that a private matter may become known.
months.6: Benefit and difficulty alternate, and promising work may fail midway. Even a boldly expanded undertaking can prove hollow. The verse warns of illness or persistent gossip, so avoid overcommitting.
months.7: Unfavorable timing makes achievement difficult despite clear intentions, leaving private worry. Buying, selling, and documents may bring losses. Effort is present, but its reward may be smaller than expected.
months.8: Household dissatisfaction invites further trouble. If there is no physical distress, quarrels may become the main concern. Avoid involvement in litigation. The pattern nevertheless moves from early difficulty toward later improvement.
months.9: Seeking something small may unexpectedly yield something larger. A wish or ambition can be fulfilled, bringing peace to body and mind. Favorable finances indicate an unexpected gain; continue to cultivate sound conduct and self-discipline.
months.10: Unfavorable conditions make an undertaking difficult to bring to fruition. A joint venture may end in failure and loss. If this does not occur, persistent and unnecessary gossip may be the concern.
months.11: Do not abandon existing work to pursue a new plan, which may bring hardship. Going elsewhere is unfavorable; concentrate on current work at home. Guard belongings against theft and loss.
months.12: A shared undertaking can bring more benefit than working alone. However, a new association with an unfamiliar person is described unfavorably. Since relationships carry particular risks this year, choose collaborators with care.

441.chongun: A flock of pheasants takes flight as a great hawk spreads its wings. Acting after the right moment has passed can make work feel hollow. Avoid allowing impatience to drive rash behavior, which scatters joy and creates worry. Endure present hardship without despair: the beginning is difficult, but later conditions improve. Expanding work despite unfavorable circumstances invites further trouble. Be cautious with trust as well; someone may seem close outwardly while remaining distant within. Yet beneath the moon, a blue bird brings happy news to a spring terrace. The later part of the year can turn worry into delight, with stronger finances and a possible unexpected gain. Keep your conviction through the less favorable opening and middle periods.

months.1: Seeking fish in the mountains leaves only wasted effort. Without a settled intention, you run east and then west. An undertaking may have begun, yet circumstances make it difficult to complete or obtain a result.
months.2: A dry tree meeting autumn suggests desolation. Household conditions become unsettled, with illness possibly adding to the difficulty. Body and mind feel burdened by unresolved affairs; sincere effort to seek relief may help.
months.3: An intention has not taken root, leaving a business idea untried. Even in difficulty, avoid empty ambition and improper gains, both of which can cause loss. Following a sound and honest course is presented as the foundation of blessings.
months.4: A dispute may arise in the fourth month; otherwise, the text warns of mourning. Financial opportunities nevertheless match your wishes in several directions. A benefactor from the west or north may support an undertaking. Pursue an established intention carefully.
months.5: A setback in promising work is like an unexpected cloud covering the bright moon. Avoid improper resources or dishonest profit, which invite trouble. Greater care may prevent an undertaking from becoming hollow.
months.6: The traditional text recommends sincere temple prayer against illness in the household. A person associated with Wood is favorable for resources. The symbol of official trouble advises against distant travel, which may bring financial loss.
months.7: Fading petals meet frost, suggesting discomfort in body and mind. Existing work resembles a flower without fruit, yielding little satisfaction. A distant journey is unfavorable. Stay within your means and regain inward composure.
months.8: Disordered work is difficult to complete, but a new undertaking may be less favorable than the existing one. Apply steady effort in one direction. Even then, the eventual result may be smaller than the beginning led you to expect.
months.9: A large ambition produces a modest result, like trying to paint a tiger and drawing a dog. A visitor from the north may unexpectedly cause harm. Yet a new business undertaking is described as favorable for resources and may offer room for renewed confidence.
months.10: Losing the way home as the sun sets suggests exhaustion and uncertainty. Current undertakings may not reach completion. The text warns of financial loss or mourning, calling for care through this difficult period.
