months.11: Hardship passes and favorable conditions return, bringing resources. Harmony between yin and yang helps difficult work move toward completion. Stronger finances may ease worry and produce an unexpected gain. Direct your energy toward your purpose.
months.12: Do not assume others share your intentions; misplaced trust can cause considerable harm. Obstacles may leave effort poorly rewarded. Staying home is favorable, while traveling far away is not.

442.chongun: A lone sail meets the wind on a vast sea, suggesting isolation without a clear support. Seeking gain through improper means only adds harm. Yet forming a fresh intention and working toward it is favorable, as is contact with a person associated with Wood. Drinking and sexual indulgence may lead to regret. Success is difficult this year, like a wandering dog chasing a chicken and losing it. Illness is another concern. Something that first appears profitable may instead become harmful, particularly in the north. What benefits someone else may prove unfavorable when you pursue it, so judge opportunities by your own circumstances.

months.1: Unfavorable conditions may follow even a move elsewhere. Jealousy from someone close can obstruct your work. Household concerns may arise; otherwise, the text warns of mourning for a parent or distress over a parent’s difficulties.
months.2: Insufficient provisions make satisfaction difficult. Although you intend to achieve something, obstacles interfere with your plan. Self-reproach offers little relief. Another person may contribute to failure, so a joint undertaking is unfavorable.
months.3: Continuing worry may disturb your sleep, and illness at home unsettles the mind. Leaving to seek relief may expose you to another difficulty. Outside activity offers little benefit; attend to home and remain patient.
months.4: An undertaking begun by chance may bring resources. Seeking benefit through water proves hollow, while land-based efforts are more favorable. Even if an ambition is achieved, incoming profit may be difficult to retain.
months.5: A new business intended to escape adversity may coincide with renewed household concerns. Rushing toward a large gain yields little. Modest aims and practical substance are more helpful; otherwise, resources may disperse before regret can change the outcome.
months.6: Like the moon hidden among clouds, improvement is difficult to see. Misplaced trust can lead to jealousy, hurt feelings, and disputes over money. The traditional verse also cautions against intimate involvement with a woman and associates it with possible illness.
months.7: Approach work and relationships seriously. Careless behavior can invite gossip. Drinking and sexual indulgence may cause financial loss and regret. Patience and willingness to yield are favored, since disputes may develop into legal trouble.
months.8: People live through mutual support, but conflict with others prevents work from progressing. A person associated with Wood is described unfavorably this month. Persistent concerns lead the traditional verse to recommend Buddhist prayer in advance of trouble.
months.9: The south and north are unfavorable for fulfilling your plans. The west offers a modest financial opportunity. The text warns of household trouble and recommends visiting a renowned mountain for composed, sincere prayer.
months.10: Even concentrated effort may initially feel hollow. Financial loss or concern involving your spouse is indicated. Yet bitterness eventually gives way to sweetness: endurance can be rewarded with clearer progress.
months.11: The image of a harmful spirit calls for care around water and fire. Travel south or north offers little return. Carrying out your responsibilities properly may bring a modest gain and help you avoid further setbacks.
months.12: Green leaves cannot readily grow beneath deep snow. Intention without achievement may leave private distress. A distant journey carries a warning of unexpected mishaps. Remaining in place while wishes are unfulfilled may feel unsettling, requiring patience.

443.chongun: Resting in a high pavilion during the heat of the sixth month suggests ease and favorable conditions. Worries drift away like distant clouds. In an eastern garden, flowers open at the proper time, an image of blessings unfolding. Unexpected success may bring resources and a widely known name, delighting both body and mind. Yet if advancement and recognition do not occur, gossip or mourning may take their place, so do not assume the pattern cannot change. Jade branches and red cassia glow beautifully, while fish turn in the spring sunlight. Abundance gives room to act and to gather the results you intended. When work follows your wishes, the world feels bright and full of energy. The traditional text recommends devotion at the year’s opening.

months.1: The first month calls for a clear mind and sincere prayer, with benefit linked to the effort devoted. Illness may unsettle your living situation. The traditional verse says a woman’s advice offers no gain this month and cautions against following it.
months.2: Stay within your means and release empty ambition. Home may feel unsettled, while a move can bring something favorable. A birth is indicated; otherwise, advancement in office may raise your name. Chasing hollow pursuits brings regret.
months.3: Do not follow others’ words blindly, since the resulting harm may be considerable. Unexpected recognition can energize your work and improve household resources. Even while resources accumulate, occasional gossip may persist.
months.4: Abundant blessings create a cheerful atmosphere. A celebration involving children may fill the household with warmth and harmony. The traditional verse warns that becoming intimately involved with a woman may damage these favorable conditions, particularly your reputation.
months.5: An unsettled situation at home may make a brief outing helpful. A disagreement between spouses is indicated. The text also warns of an unexpected mishap, so respond calmly and carefully to both small and large matters.
months.6: A person associated with Earth is favorable for obtaining the gain you seek, while one associated with Wood is unfavorable. Lost possessions are possible; the traditional verse recommends prayer against this. Otherwise, separation between siblings is indicated.
months.7: Stepping back slightly offers more benefit than pressing ahead. Rewards entering the household can disperse worry and bring joy. Remain careful with familiar people, since someone you trust may cause harm.
months.8: Abundant resources offer little comfort if they are carelessly lost. Do not follow another person’s advice without judgment. Acting on the words of someone close may cause an established gain to disappear and leave regret.
months.9: An auspicious star at the door points to a celebration, and a benefactor may offer help. The north is favorable for substantial resources. The west also offers benefit, making the northwestern directions auspicious.
months.10: Favorable household conditions bring sufficient provisions and peace of mind. An unexpected gain is indicated, while documents may offer benefit with a benefactor’s help. Abundance creates a cheerful outlook.
months.11: Unity among household members is described as moving heaven, with resources and blessings arriving. Yet a distant journey may bring gossip. A smaller difficulty remains within the favorable conditions, leaving benefit and trouble mixed.
months.12: Affairs unfold as intended, leaving little need to seek more. Staying within your means and concentrating on your work may bring a benefactor’s help. Completing a wish or ambition adds harmony to the household.

451.chongun: A traveler returning to the green mountains hurries as the sun sets. The year resembles an exhausted person meeting a benefactor and finally returning home: ease follows trials. The opening is unfavorable, but a helper around the middle period may bring a happy development. Small gains accumulated over time can become a larger achievement. Avoid quarrels and retain generosity to protect your reputation. Midyear appears peaceful in body and mind, yet some difficulty remains: promising work may go awry, and blessings can be obscured like the sun behind clouds. The traditional verse recommends clearing the mind and visiting a renowned mountain for sincere prayer.

months.1: High intentions and a generous heart favor success. Gossip remains possible; the traditional text recommends prayer to the mountain spirit to avert it. The symbol of official trouble makes distant travel unfavorable.
months.2: The traditional verse cautions against intimate involvement with a woman, describing possible substantial harm. Otherwise, household concerns may unsettle your mind. It also discourages visiting a house of mourning because of a warning about illness.
months.3: Several undertakings offer little gain, so avoid expansion that ends in regret. Starting a business impulsively is unfavorable. Moving east is described as helpful, while following another person’s words may break a hoped-for plan.
months.4: Outside activity is unfavorable; concentrate on existing work at home. An unexpected setback may make a desired undertaking confusing and difficult. Household unrest can leave your thoughts scattered in many directions.
months.5: Relationships may bring some benefit and resources in the fifth month. Household adversity leads the traditional text to recommend prayer facing south. If mourning occurs, it is described as taking the place of other household troubles.
months.6: Working with people associated with Water or Fire is unfavorable. Avoid a distant journey. A dispute is possible, so understand another person’s position before asserting your own. An error in your affairs may weaken your position in the disagreement.
months.7: Like a wandering wild goose, body and mind feel burdened, lonely, and tired. Effort to obtain resources may not bring an equivalent return. The image of a harmful spirit at the door calls for settling and preparing the household in advance.
months.8: Avoid disputes, since litigation is unfavorable. One setback may cause a larger loss than expected. Be deliberate and serious in your affairs, as careless movement can bring further trouble.
months.9: You may feel as isolated as someone left alone far from home. Following the words of a close acquaintance can cause harm and regret. This verse specifically names the third and tenth months as favorable for land-related gains.
months.10: Trade is favorable for obtaining resources and improving household comfort. Avoid the south, where promising work may go wrong. If there is no financial loss, an unexpected mishap may cause a serious fright.
months.11: Stepping on a tiger’s tail is followed by joy within worry. The north is favorable for benefit and growth. Conditions begin poorly and improve later; the verse links how this mixed pattern unfolds partly to your attitude.
months.12: Affairs proceed relatively smoothly without major obstacles. A busy pace can bring joy and courage. Even while working diligently toward your intention, remain careful because the verse warns of an unexpected mishap.

452.chongun: A dream of an able assistant suggests meeting a good person whose help makes success possible. Supportive people may appear wherever you go. Favorable developments outnumber unfavorable ones this year. Minor household concerns or lost possessions may arise, but a benefactor’s assistance can ease them. A visitor from far away may cause a surprise or fright. Even so, blessings continue like rain meeting thirsty plants, and unexpected opportunities can make your efforts shine. Repeated celebrations and gains toward the year’s end bring sufficient provisions and a more comfortable household. With fewer worries, family members live harmoniously, and affairs proceed smoothly. The traditional text recommends a prayer at the year’s opening to welcome even more favorable conditions.

months.1: A clear breeze and bright moon accompany rest in a high house. Affairs proceed smoothly, though concerns involving children may remain. Be careful in the west; otherwise, gossip may become the difficulty.
months.2: Precious jade lies hidden in dust, its value unrecognized. You may be busy without knowing what truly benefits you. Household unease can cause disagreement and repeated trouble, yet a benefactor’s help may bring unexpected success.
months.3: Troubles gathered like clouds disperse, leaving a clearer outlook. Favorable developments bring pleasure and allow resources to accumulate. A benefactor at the door may help fulfill something you have wanted.
months.4: Plum blossoms in the eastern garden open at their proper time. Beginning a considered plan under favorable conditions brings benefit and delight. Avoid quarrels; otherwise, a small setback or gossip may disturb your peace.
months.5: The fifth and sixth months favor benefits gained through another person. Land-related undertakings are described positively, offering resources and fulfillment of a wish. Stronger finances help work succeed and yield an intended return.
months.6: A woman may offer useful help in fulfilling a wish. Beginning work with someone previously unfamiliar is described favorably. Accumulating small gains can support a larger ambition and substantial resources, restoring confidence.
months.7: A benefactor may help a joint plan reach its intended result. The household may also grow; the traditional verse specifically indicates the birth of a son and a celebration. Take care around water, as waterside travel carries a warning of an unexpected mishap.
months.8: Benefit and difficulty are mixed: kindness that should inspire gratitude may instead produce hostility. The traditional verse cautions against sexual involvement with a woman because of possible financial loss and gossip. The south is favorable for benefit.
months.9: This verse specifically warns of a serious fright involving water or fire in the third and tenth months. Possessions may be lost, and someone trusted may cause harm. A favorable beginning can end in difficulty, so remain observant and prepared.
months.10: Flowers fall while leaves flourish, suggesting more concern over undertakings than actual achievement. Dissatisfaction among household members adds unease. If this does not occur, a serious concern involving a sibling is indicated.
months.11: A dragon finally reaches heaven’s gate: adversity recedes and blessings return. A celebration fills the household with warmth. Completing plans and realizing an intention bring both inward satisfaction and accumulating resources.
months.12: A benefactor accompanies your efforts, helping even distant goals become achievable. Assistance arrives as you begin work, allowing plans to fit together and household resources to grow. Excessive trust in someone close can still cause harm.

453.chongun: A jade rabbit gazing at the moon fills itself with clear light. Staying within your means and giving full attention to existing work can bring a connection that supports success. The year resembles pines and cypresses holding clear dew in a spring garden, promising joy and a sense of reward. A move is indicated; otherwise, the household may gain a member. Guard against theft and unexpected loss of possessions. The traditional verse also mentions the possible birth of a son and recommends composed, sincere preparation. After the seventh and eighth months, blessings gradually become clearer and resources may arrive from several places. Happy events bring satisfaction, while a more comfortable household allows family members to share their joy. An offering at the year’s opening is traditionally recommended.

months.1: Favorable conditions bring resources and a private happiness known only to you. A welcome development is indicated, with benefit entering existing work. Peace at home brings laughter, and cooperation with others adds joy.
months.2: Resources are available through seeking them. Recognize the timing and begin a considered intention. Although early conditions are somewhat unfavorable, later ones improve, favoring a decisive attempt.
months.3: In the third and fourth months, a benefactor may help resolve household problems. A yellow dragon finding clouds traditionally indicates the birth of a son. Undertakings are described as following your intentions, bringing considerable joy.
months.4: Benefit in many places brings resources and recognition. An autumn mouse finding a storehouse suggests abundance and satisfaction. Sharing with others does not diminish the favorable pattern and may bring further benefit.
months.5: A benefactor visits the household, so treat people generously. A new family member is indicated. Favorable finances may allow expanded landholdings, while harmony and happy events help the household flourish.
months.6: Earlier good deeds are associated with a household celebration. The west is favorable for welcome events and an unexpected gain. A celebration involving children brings particular delight, as what was planted earlier returns.
months.7: Trade can succeed, making the marketplace favorable. Concerns involving your spouse or children call for attention; the traditional text recommends an offering and prayer. Even favorable circumstances can contain obstacles, so remain careful.
months.8: Avoid quarrels, since litigation is unfavorable. Abandoning current work for another venture is unlikely to yield a return. An unexpected gain is indicated; otherwise, advancement in office may be the benefit.
months.9: Growing resources ease hardship and allow a peaceful, cheerful view of the world. Several undertakings bear fruit, and work already in progress reaches a favorable conclusion. These results may draw respect from others.
months.10: Flowers give way to fruit as an undertaking yields the result you intended. Someone close may nevertheless cause harm. Be careful in relationships and guard against lost resources; transactions are less favorable because another person may cause loss.
months.11: Do not rush greedily after resources. Staying within your means and acting properly is the more favorable course. Settle your intention in one direction and allow welcome developments to arrive. A benefactor appears like someone at a moonlit window.
months.12: The west and south are favorable for resources. Strong conditions allow greater ease. One clear conviction can unite two undertakings, helping concentrated effort fulfill an intended goal.

461.chongun: Leaving for a valley to escape suspicion, you find an enemy concealing a blade. Stepping outside may mean losing the way, leaving you unsure where to go. The year is generally unfavorable. Exhaustion may tempt you to judge everything by profit, but doing so can invite accusations of ingratitude; keep your intentions clear even in hardship. Lost belongings or gossip may leave you feeling unfairly treated. Fleeing impulsively to a distant place can worsen matters. Stay within your means and do not rush into a new undertaking; a later start may produce a better result. Illness and persistent worry may trouble the household. Still, continued effort in hope of improvement is preferable to giving way to discouragement and idleness.

months.1: Resources may arrive, yet half of what is gained may be lost afterward. Money tends to flow outward rather than accumulate despite effort. A long journey is unfavorable; continue steadily with existing work at home.
months.2: An undertaking appears promising, but its expected result may prove hollow. Repeated obstacles make completion difficult. Riding a horse up a mountain only to find a dangerous return route captures the situation.
months.3: Adversity covers the day like clouds blocking the light. An unexpected mishap is possible, so avoid rushing. Disputes are also unfavorable and may invite gossip.
months.4: The symbol of official trouble is active. Reviewing a transaction may reveal terms unfavorable to you and create a sense of betrayal. Avoid the south, where a planned goal and even an existing undertaking may be disrupted.
months.5: The household and landholdings may expand, bringing celebration and stronger resources. Personal esteem and peace of mind improve. Someone else may nevertheless cause harm this month, so do not accept their words without judgment.
months.6: The fifth and sixth months contain much activity but little achievement. Soldiers losing their swords and travelers losing their way symbolize frustration. Unfulfilled wishes may seem to dissolve like bubbles, leaving worldly affairs feeling dreamlike.
months.7: Chiseling stone reveals jade, allowing earlier labor and patience to show their value. Wishes may be fulfilled and resources grow again. Take care with documents, since a careless action can create a troubling complication.
months.8: Benefit remains within difficulty, with a demanding beginning followed by improvement. Avoid quarrels, which can end badly and leave useless regret. A traveler losing the way at dusk represents possible inward confusion and distress.
months.9: This verse recommends prayer in the third and tenth months to support fulfillment of wishes. Illness involving a wife or son may cause household concern. In the east, a person associated with Metal may help. Remain careful and composed.
months.10: Following another person’s words may turn an undertaking hollow. Enthusiasm can lead you to begin work in many places, but the expected results may lack a sound beginning or ending. Respect the practical order of work and stay within your means.
months.11: Avoid distant travel in the eleventh and twelfth months. The verse warns of theft affecting the household, calling for continuing care. Acting beyond your means may bring an unexpected adversary, so proceed deliberately.
months.12: Favorable conditions are inconsistent, making affairs feel burdensome. Efforts to obtain resources may not bring them as intended. The south nevertheless offers a favorable direction in which to make a considered attempt.

462.chongun: No cloud appears across the vast distance; sea and sky are entirely blue. The year promises a similarly peaceful personal outlook. Fish and dragons playing in water suggest sufficient provisions. Work proceeds like a boat under a favorable wind, allowing a contented song. Even a road others call difficult may open smoothly, attributed in the traditional verse to spiritual protection. Avoid sexual indulgence: what begins pleasantly may later cause harm. Cultivate generous conduct and good intentions, which the text links to corresponding blessings. Existing work blooms like flowers, making the period feel like spring. Near year’s end, however, a dispute may arise, so avoid inserting yourself into others’ conversations and gossip. An opening-of-year offering is traditionally recommended.

months.1: The first and second months begin to bring financial blessings. Worry disperses and joy allows a comfortable period. Peace itself is a valuable reward, like fish and dragons moving freely in water.
months.2: The verse pictures a woman arriving with the third month’s east wind, bringing warmth to the household. Resources accompany you in abundance, as though gold filled a valley. Happy days and fewer worries are indicated.
months.3: Fine rain in a spring breeze relieves thirst, with favorable developments waiting in several places. Unexpected resources may arrive at home. Strong conditions allow gains without constant pursuit.
months.4: The traditional verse warns that careless intimate involvement with a woman may bring gossip. Harmony between yin and yang otherwise suggests joyful growth. Another person’s resources may unexpectedly bring you benefit.
months.5: Do not act as though forcing your way against the current. Ignoring proper conduct while expecting success invites trouble. Personal ease and many favorable developments otherwise support financial benefit in several places.
months.6: Honest, proper work can build a reputation for kindness. A desired undertaking comes together readily, helping fulfill a high ambition. A household celebration and welcome greetings are indicated.
months.7: Fish and dragons find water, beginning another lively period. Favorable conditions support resources in several places. The east and west are particularly promising. Letting go of arrogance helps preserve the benefit.
months.8: A person in public office may receive income, while an ordinary person gains resources. A benefactor’s help favors joining hands with others to complete work. Unexpected success may bring both money and recognition, reflecting accumulated goodwill.
months.9: Benefit in several directions creates the warmth of a spring breeze. The south is especially favorable for undertakings. The traditional verse cautions that sexual involvement with a woman may interrupt this pattern and bring gossip.
months.10: Outside activity is more favorable than staying home, including a journey to find opportunity. The east and south may bring a benefactor who supports your intention. An undertaking away from home can lead to advancement and recognition.
months.11: A celebration is indicated. If advancement and public respect do not occur, household concern may arise, particularly involving your wife’s well-being. Acting fairly and openly is described as helping preserve blessings and limiting worry.
months.12: A fish leaves a well for the sea, suggesting broader opportunity and advancement. Seeking resources and completing a plan are favored. Recognition may lead others to show respect of their own accord.

463.chongun: The jade rabbit rises in the east, offering clear moonlight to drink in. The west is favorable for welcome news. A benefactor’s help allows many undertakings to proceed smoothly this year, with happy events attributed to spiritual protection. Affairs increasingly follow your wishes, bringing more blessings. Opportunities in the south and north may draw you there. Yet favorable developments can contain obstacles, producing both substantial gains and losses. As a fourth-month southern breeze turns the barley golden, overcoming adversity leads into a more abundant period. Intention and action align, and the year may feel like a precious harmony. The traditional verse recommends wholehearted prayer at the beginning of the year to welcome smooth progress.

months.1: Playing with jade beside an eastern window in moonlight suggests delight. Financial conditions improve day by day, adding substantial resources to the household. Accumulating them like a mountain brings confidence.
months.2: Music rises from a tall house beneath the bright moon. Welcome events allow resources to gather, and going out may bring greater benefit. Otherwise, a celebration involving children or descendants is indicated.
months.3: The third and fourth months are unfavorable for distant travel. Staying home and concentrating quietly on your work is preferable to moving in search of greater blessings. The south carries a particular warning of trouble.
months.4: An oriole rests on a willow branch, creating a beautiful scene. Undertakings bring resources, making affairs appear favorable. Flowers turn to fruit, and abundant returns allow a peaceful livelihood. Welcome relatives from afar as well.
months.5: Small blessings accumulate into a mountain of benefit. Yet this month carries a warning of official or legal trouble; otherwise, gossip may arise. Association with a person linked to Water is described as potentially ruinous.
months.6: The sixth month offers little benefit. A familiar person may be less helpful than a stranger and may cause harm. Avoid watersides. The text indicates a quarrel, or otherwise legal trouble, and advises limiting travel and protecting your position.
months.7: Financial opportunities appear in several directions, with blessings compared to welcome rain and resources to a rich harvest. Illness remains a concern even while seeking gain. Excessive ambition can undermine you, so proceed carefully.
months.8: Steady, diligent work is described as moving heaven to grant benefit. The east and west are favorable. Greed for something beyond your means can invite trouble; avoid empty ambition and follow a responsible course.
months.9: Unnecessary outings may cause financial loss. White jade in a high mountain has an owner, suggesting that you may become the person who completes a difficult undertaking. This month marks a particular opening of favorable conditions within the year.
months.10: An undertaking may bring you a greater share of benefit than it brings others. Begin a considered plan promptly, since timing affects the outcome and delay can reduce the gain. The west is favorable for obtaining resources.
months.11: A thirsty dragon finds water, and a hungry person meets a plentiful harvest. Body and mind settle as hoped-for aims come together. The traditional verse indicates the possible birth of a son in the eleventh or twelfth month, bringing eager anticipation.
months.12: Unfavorable conditions turn toward blessing and fill the household with joy. An unexpected gain may arrive as fortune brightens. If there is no birth in the family, however, the traditional text warns of mourning-related trouble.

511.chongun: A paulownia and bamboo contend, and you find yourself tangled in a hemp field. Life feels tiring, yet this year mixes difficulty with good fortune, and earlier misfortune eventually turns favorable. Effort amid hardship brings a return. Mourning or gossip may intrude, so wait for the right moment and avoid rash action. Joy and anger alternate, while uncertainty about what is true makes decisions difficult. The verse speaks of mourning in the family or, alternatively, financial loss. Even within difficulty there is a favorable opening: work steadily with a settled mind. It also recommends sincere offerings at the beginning of the year as a traditional way to seek relief and fulfillment.

months.1: The first two months carry concern for parents. Avoid rash behavior or starting too much. Illness in the household may interfere with your work, so proceed carefully.
months.2: A young bird wants to fly but its wings are still weak. Resources are not yet sufficient for a major move; acting too soon may bring regret. Stay within your means and work with others, where some benefit can be found.
months.3: Keep high aims and value good conduct; good fortune and resources may follow naturally. Even if finances flourish, remain attentive to health. Avoid arguments and careless words that could draw gossip.
months.4: A southern breeze brings some leisure, but discord at home may keep worries alive. Guard your words as tightly as a sealed bottle; measured speech helps restore peace.
months.5: In the fifth and sixth months, trouble recedes and blessings return. The verse presents financial loss or concern about children as possible cautions; if neither appears, marriage is its alternative theme.
months.6: Snow fills the mountains, making a distant journey difficult to carry out. Be careful with new acquaintances and financial loss. Do not covet wealth elsewhere, or the pursuit may cost what you already have.
months.7: Much effort may bring only fatigue, with little profit or satisfaction. Turning your back on the moon leaves darkness before you. The verse warns of illness or, alternatively, gossip.
months.8: If home leaves you unsettled, spending time elsewhere may bring peace. An earlier setback can turn into a benefit. Household fortune improves, and work undertaken now is described as proceeding smoothly.
months.9: You resemble a lone pine on rock or a small boat on the open sea, searching for support. Restless dreams and an unsettled mind reflect the loneliness of this passage.
months.10: Progress is difficult. Settle your intentions and remain close to home to give plans a chance. Conflicting actions between those above and below you can still make completion hard.
months.11: Fortune begins to return, bringing gains through work. The verse pairs an unexpected gain with the alternative of trouble. Business may prosper, but avoid greed when taking your share.
months.12: Life feels comfortable and the world peaceful. The verse advises avoiding funeral visits and travel east, where it places unfavorable signs. Begin any new undertaking with care.

512.chongun: A fish in a confined pond has no clear way to survive. Avoid disputes: even a contest may reach no useful conclusion. Like a traveler walking in darkness, you cannot easily tell east from west; there is much bustle but little progress. Worldly affairs seem as elusive as passing clouds. The household-spirit imagery points to quarrels or litigation against stronger opponents. Running from place to place brings little novelty or benefit, and plans that resist your intentions invite frustration. Even when luck appears favorable, the final return may be small. The verse warns of an outsider intruding, so choose acquaintances carefully.

months.1: Energy is low, and people around you may cause trouble. Avoid disputes, especially litigation against a stronger opponent. If this does not appear, gossip is the alternative warning. Pay attention to your health.
months.2: Searching the sea for gold brings effort without reward. Obstacles follow each undertaking, and more activity may mean more loss. The verse also warns of illness and emotional strain, calling for restraint.
months.3: The verse speaks of mourning clothes or, alternatively, concern about children. New social connections offer little benefit now. Approach everything carefully to avoid an unexpected setback.
months.4: Travel north may bring a helpful person. Avoid the west, which the verse marks as unfavorable. Support is associated with the east and north, possibly arriving quietly as you begin your work.
months.5: Like a traveler who has lost the road, you find it hard to advance or retreat. Current business may bring little substance or profit. The household-location sign is active, and moving home is described as favorable.
months.6: The verse places illness involving a wife or, alternatively, disagreement between spouses in this month. Disorganized work makes completion difficult, and effort may not yet bring a return.
months.7: Large ambitions may not take shape. Staying within your means is the safer course. A helpful person could bring recognition later, although a gain may still be accompanied by a loss. Attend to your health.
months.8: Fine rain on an east wind turns the willows green. A favorable interval helps matters proceed smoothly. The image of drinking among flowers under a moonlit window cautions against romantic excess; measured conduct preserves the good opening.
months.9: An urgent matter may be resolved if you seek a response promptly. The verse warns of illness or concern about children. Seek comfort and stability at home; going elsewhere is described as less favorable.
months.10: Work finally bears fruit, like a peach tree by the river. Exchange something small for something larger, and your plans can advance. Stronger resources and personal circumstances suggest a more comfortable livelihood.
months.11: Loss comes first and gain later. The opening may be tiring, but the end improves. Travelers from the south or north are associated with harm, even if they do not intend it.
months.12: Wait for the right time to act. Small gains can be obtained and, like mountain streams reaching the sea, may grow through steady work. Protect what you have earned and stay grounded at home rather than making unnecessary moves.

513.chongun: A fish leaves its small pond for the sea and moves with confidence. Choose a suitable place to live; the verse associates relocation with lasting wellbeing. Like plants receiving rain after drought, the year revives and flourishes. An autumn rat finds a full granary, an image of abundant provisions. Long journeys are favorable. Good timing and virtuous conduct bring peace to the household, while wealth, position and recognition are prominent themes. Your circumstances expand, possibly allowing a move to a better home and a long stay there. The traditional closing recommends sincere offerings at the start of the year to welcome the favorable pattern.

months.1: An unhappy event turns into good fortune, bringing visible joy. Resources accumulate abundantly. Moving home is favorable, and a new undertaking is associated with an unexpected gain.
months.2: Unexpected resources bring a comfortable livelihood. Meeting immortals on the three sacred mountains symbolizes prosperity and widespread recognition. The verse nevertheless places concern for parents or, alternatively, misfortune involving children alongside this success.
months.3: Resources seem available wherever you go, and a distant journey may bring profit. Like an autumn rat finding a granary, provisions feel plentiful. Reputation and gain come together, drawing the respect of others.
months.4: Business is described as succeeding. Keep your intentions sound and cultivate good conduct. A helpful person arrives like clear moonlight and a fresh breeze, supporting smooth progress in your undertakings.
months.5: In the fifth and sixth months, calm action is more favorable than haste. A peaceful body and mind leave room for joy. Rash behavior carries a warning, so proceed with restraint.
months.6: Wealth is pictured as a mountain or golden valley. People associated with Fire and Metal bring benefit. Requests find a response and encounters bring help; staying within proper bounds supports abundance.
months.7: The seventh and eighth months carry a warning about gossip. Keep business details private to avoid disruption or disputes. Close involvement with friends may bring financial loss or emotional confusion.
months.8: Ambition may exceed the available scope, like a frog in a well. Protect current work instead of opening another venture that could cost you. People born in Dragon or Dog years are associated with benefit and unexpected gains.
months.9: In the ninth and tenth months, a favorable star at the door highlights marriage; the source applies this even to someone already married. Spring winds and blooming flowers symbolize opportunity. Take a good opening, with help associated with someone from the east.
months.10: Moving home is favorable this month. Plans may proceed as intended. Employees may see advancement or higher pay; the alternative theme is happy news involving children.
months.11: Financial themes are strong, with gains even from a small investment. Career prospects also favor finding work or passing an examination. A prize or other unexpected gain is another possibility, like sowing a field that yields richly.
months.12: The verse recommends sincere prayer and observance of family rites. Persistent wishes are associated with unexpected success followed by further progress. Ritual purity and devotion symbolize a path toward recognition.

521.chongun: A defeated general, troops scattered, has no means to resist the enemy and feels ashamed to return. The household is unsettled, with discord and sudden setbacks calling for care. If employed, avoid resigning without cause; a new business carries a loss warning. The household may gain a member, or writing and documents may bring income. Theft and unexpected harm are cautions for the year. Someone trusted may turn away, like the old image of a bride leaving Luoyang with another person. Blossoms open on a weak tree only to wither: both foundation and finish need support. A dragon losing its wish-granting pearl captures the difficulty of using your abilities.

months.1: Plans resist your wishes, leaving you impatient and frustrated. Work lacks a strong beginning or finish, and repeated efforts may only drain energy. The image is a boat caught in waves on a vast sea.
months.2: Someone close may become an adversary. Choose friends and acquaintances carefully. Existing worries may be joined by gossip or illness, so guard both wellbeing and exposure to unexpected trouble.
months.3: Cloud and rain obscure the sun and moon. Running from place to place may bring fatigue without much return. The verse presents mourning or, alternatively, personal illness as its caution.
months.4: Like autumn grass touched by frost, worry feels cold and persistent. The verse advises avoiding funeral visits, fearing mourning afterward, and places concern around a wife. It traditionally recommends settling body and mind and praying beforehand.
months.5: Unclear actions may leave regret. The east is marked as unfavorable, with a warning about financial loss. Be cautious about relying on close friends, lest a favorable situation turn difficult.
months.6: After considerable hardship, relief finally arrives. Where flowers have fallen, green growth returns. Financial prospects improve and others look on with respect. Like a waning moon becoming full again, affairs eventually recover.
months.7: The seventh and eighth months carry health cautions. Some favorable influence from the sixth month remains, allowing a small gain even without much effort. Current plans may be unrealistic, so do not turn toward another business.
months.8: Choose good conduct and avoid harmful behavior. If anger rises, restraint is the better course. Without a firm intention, hurried activity may fail to accomplish the plan.
months.9: A goal may be achieved, yet little profit or benefit follows. Constant activity leaves body and mind tired. Watch financial losses; someone may also leave the household.
months.10: A person who once caused harm may become helpful, leaving hope in an otherwise empty situation. Yet dependable support feels scarce, and uncertainty about whom to rely on may bring discouragement.
months.11: Travel Horse suggests a journey far from home. A long road lies before the goal. Financial losses may occur during work, while dissatisfaction with the work itself keeps you unsettled.
months.12: Success and failure alternate this month. There are several achievements, but also setbacks. Guard possessions, be careful with trust, and avoid coveting what exceeds your means; the pursuit may bring only disappointment.

522.chongun: Trouble recedes and blessings arrive, suggesting a comfortable year. Plans may find openings in many directions, though a brief unfavorable interval can bring worry and uncertainty. The east is especially associated with resources. Beginning work brings growth, like peach and plum blossoms flourishing in their season. Peace returns to the household as if spring has arrived. An unexpected position or recognition may bring support, while troubles disperse like clouds. Household resources gradually increase. As clouds part to reveal the moon, recognition may arrive late; a waning moon becoming full again symbolizes renewed joy. The verse recommends traditional offerings at the start of the year to welcome this favorable turn.

months.1: In the first two months, a long-held wish may finally be fulfilled. Work progresses and confidence returns. Home feels peaceful as spring. The south is favorable; put effort into an undertaking to obtain its benefit.
months.2: A new venture is favored, with help appearing as it begins. The verse presents an unexpected gain or advancement in office as alternatives. Examinations and financial results are also described favorably.
months.3: As spring revives the homeland, stalled work gains life. Difficulties and worries recede, making room for optimism. Personal energy and resources strengthen, supporting smooth work and a peaceful home.
months.4: Happy household news combines with financial benefit. A position or unexpected gain is highlighted, and the family may grow. Value your work and reputation, through which benefit can come.
months.5: During the fifth and sixth months, guard against lost possessions. A person arriving from the west is associated with financial loss. Preparation and preventive care may reduce this risk in the traditional reading.
months.6: Unexpected recognition spreads your name. Rain after drought symbolizes renewal, with troubles dispersing and household resources growing. Passing an examination or the birth of a son are the verse’s alternative themes.
months.7: Like spring grass refreshed by rain, you and your work gain vitality. Position and income are favorable themes. A financial-loss caution remains, so choose acquaintances carefully.
months.8: Working with others is associated with substantial benefit. Troubles pass and blessings return, with a favorable star entering the gate. The reading emphasizes smooth progress and relief from worry.
months.9: Joyful songs rise from a moonlit tower. Home feels peaceful and resources grow. Existing business is described as succeeding, while a new undertaking may also bring income.
months.10: A waning moon grows full, symbolizing recovery after a decline. Resources and happy news return, and wishes find support. Stay out of disputes, however, to avoid gossip.
months.11: Work and finances improve like plants growing in spring warmth. An unexpected gain or the birth of a son are alternative themes. Despite the money obtained, a particular intended goal may remain unfinished.
months.12: A rat enters a rice granary, an image of abundant provisions. East and west are favorable. Begin and finish new work carefully. New acquaintances are less favorable, so be restrained in exchanges or transactions.

523.chongun: Two tigers fight, unsettling those who watch. The sun sets behind the mountains and the homeward traveler hurries: disputes waste time until delayed work becomes urgent. A brief period of honor may give way to fatigue. Reaching a river without a boat symbolizes an obstacle without a ready solution. The verse places illness involving a wife or, alternatively, gossip among its warnings. Avoid disputes, guard possessions and watch for theft. An impulsive act, as if intoxicated or beside yourself, may bring regret. Yet people associated with Metal and Wood may offer help without being asked. Rather than fretting over disordered work, wait carefully for the right moment.

months.1: Clouds fill the sky but give no rain, reflecting frustrated hopes. Trying to evade a difficult task through clever shortcuts brings little result. The verse warns that romantic entanglement may lead to financial loss.
months.2: A traveler hurries home at sunset after time has been wasted. Delayed work feels urgent, but rash action brings harm. Wait for an opening; the financial image is losing half of what was gained.
months.3: Avoid disputes and gossip. Arguments bring little benefit and leave the mind unsettled. If conflict does not appear, the verse instead warns of loss or failure. Think through matters carefully.
months.4: Yin and yang are out of balance, making plans hard to complete. Attend to health and prepare for possible setbacks. Avoid arguing and act discreetly to reduce exposure to gossip.
months.5: Quarreling over possessions brings no gain and may spoil the work. Exercise restraint. Litigation is one warning; if that does not arise, illness or personal worry is the alternative.
months.6: Avoid rash behavior that could cost existing resources. The verse places illness in the household and traditionally recommends warding off harmful spirits. It describes prosperity followed by a favorable turn, yet still calls for attention to personal health.
months.7: Avoid excess in drinking and romantic pursuits, which the verse links with loss and failure. It recommends reverence and restraint as protection. Coveting resources elsewhere brings labor without useful return.
months.8: A full moon lights every direction, suggesting an unexpected chance for recognition. Yet failure and gossip may follow together. Plans have an uncertain quality, so observe the situation quietly.
months.9: An unusual blessing or lucky opportunity brings abundant provisions. New acquaintances may interfere with your work. Finances are favorable, but personal wellbeing is less so; keep health in view.
months.10: Resources in many places bring reputation and gain. A career benefit or happy news of a child are the alternatives. A distant journey is also favorable for financial opportunities.
months.11: Illness and worry are cautionary themes, so prepare thoughtfully. Protect established work rather than creating worries through a new venture. Effort without return may make everything feel burdensome.
months.12: Thunder sounds but rain does not come. The pattern is difficult to judge, so observe carefully. Desired gains may not appear and personal conditions are unfavorable. Caution in choosing acquaintances can limit losses.

531.chongun: A dragon grows horns and rises to the sky. Digging into the earth reveals gold: effort eventually finds a favorable opening. A fortunate star accompanies you, bringing advancement to those in office and smooth progress and household joy to others. Early difficulty gives way to success, sometimes unexpectedly, with recognition and resources following. The year is described as a good time to seize an opportunity and devote yourself to work. Harmony between yin and yang favors new beginnings. Under a bright southern moon, a helpful person appears; efforts to keep good support nearby bear fruit. The verse also recommends sincere offerings at the beginning of the year.

months.1: Home carries worries, while going out may bring another kind of difficulty. Digging a well only after becoming thirsty suggests preparation made too late. Plan ahead, keep honest intentions and act uprightly to invite a better result.
months.2: Work resists your intentions and leaves you tired and unsettled. Choose acquaintances carefully, as their benefit may be small. Outward abundance may conceal a weak foundation; wisdom and humility are useful.
months.3: A broad-minded approach is favorable; a narrow one is not. Choose acquaintances carefully. What looks prosperous outside may be empty within, so rely on wisdom and humility rather than appearances.
months.4: Clouds clear and the sun and moon shine. Worry recedes and a long-held wish takes shape. Searching for blossoms leads to fruit: sustained effort finally reaches a result.
months.5: A helpful person supports success. Treasure fills the house in the verse’s abundant imagery. Weariness comes first and a favorable turn later, scattering worry and making room for joy.
months.6: Even when angry, try to let the moment pass; restraint can return as a benefit. Be cautious with acquaintances and disputes. Arguments or gossip are possible, so give your words and actions weight.
months.7: Practice good conduct and avoid harmful actions. Rain after drought brings renewal. A helpful person from the east may unexpectedly support your work and make progress smoother.
months.8: Spring returns to every valley and flowers compete to bloom. Personal conditions and finances are favorable, with resources accumulating and business moving like a boat under a fair wind.
months.9: The ninth and tenth months may contain apparently empty activity, yet useful results can emerge within it. Chrysanthemums bloom at the right time, symbolizing difficult work finally improving and bringing substantial resources.
months.10: A blue dragon finds water, gaining room to act. Business is described as successful. The caution is romantic entanglement, which the verse links to financial loss; restraint protects the favorable financial pattern.
months.11: Obstacles are hidden in many matters, so do not act rashly or join litigation. Little benefit comes from pushing blindly. Meet difficulties patiently and carefully to avoid another round of hardship.
months.12: A traveler from the east may unintentionally cause harm. Be wary of persuasive words that could mislead your work. There is little obvious gain this month; clear judgment matters more than enthusiasm.

532.chongun: Food can be seen but not eaten, like a cake in a painting. A visible goal remains just beyond reach. Avoid rash words and actions, for effort may bring little credit. A boat on rough water makes it difficult to know whether you are safe. Money may come, but obtaining and retaining it are separate problems. Plans resist your wishes, and busy activity may bring a small return. Greed adds disappointment without helping progress. Like plants unable to grow in a long drought, intentions may consume energy without reaching completion. Diving into the sea to find gold captures the futility of chasing an unsuitable opportunity.

months.1: With your back to the moon, you face the dark. Observe and wait for a better opening. Avoid unnecessary involvement that could attract gossip. A gain may be followed by a loss, leaving strain behind.
months.2: The pattern resembles falling autumn leaves, with growth slow to appear. Be careful whose advice you follow. Even a favorable event may contain an unfavorable complication, calling for measured decisions.
months.3: If home leaves you restless, time elsewhere may bring ease. The verse cautions that talking about expected gains may accompany their being spent away. Guard speech and action as obstacles arise.
months.4: Plans repeatedly diverge from your wishes, leaving worry and confusion. It resembles waiting for rain during drought while a clear wind drives it away. Repeated setbacks call for patience.
months.5: The fifth and sixth months carry a warning of unexpected harm. The verse traditionally recommends sincere prayer and restraint. An initially favorable situation may turn difficult, making money hard to retain.
months.6: Remaining at home is favored over going out. Close involvement with others may create harm. Although setbacks are possible, careful choice of acquaintances may reduce their extent.
months.7: A small loss may be followed by a larger gain. A person associated with Fire is described as helpful and linked to substantial resources. Avoid greed, which the verse connects with gossip or concern about children.
months.8: The sun sets over a river. Boats and waterside visits carry caution in this verse. East is unfavorable and west favorable. Complete existing work rather than starting something new to find a benefit.
months.9: In the ninth and tenth months, distant travel brings little benefit. An unsettled mind may wander between choices. Calm observation and clear judgment are more useful than restless movement.
months.10: Attachment to an old bond may prevent a new opportunity. Yet favorable events can bring even small plans to completion, allowing joy within worry. Decisiveness is needed.
months.11: Much activity brings little return. Greed may hurt without producing results. Staying within your means may bring no new gain but helps avoid loss, like pausing before a horse is driven onto a dangerous mountain path.
months.12: A long, difficult road lies ahead. Pushing onward can resemble planting a tree on stone: exhausting work with little yield. The verse warns of unexpected trouble and advises limiting distant journeys.

533.chongun: Drawing a bow with one hand makes an accurate shot difficult. A clever plan alone may not be enough to succeed. Someone respected may fall in standing through an unexpected event, with a risk to reputation. Travel Horse reaches the gate, suggesting a distant journey. Affairs resist your wishes; moving home may help, or the work itself may change. Be careful around water and fire and in choosing acquaintances. Clouds obscure the bright midday sky, but selecting a good guide may help. An uninvited visitor from the east offers little benefit. The final image is an old angler alone in a boat on a cold river.

months.1: An unpracticed approach may bring a small gain that does not last. East and north carry financial-loss warnings. Avoid starting work you cannot finish; otherwise effort may exceed its reward.
months.2: Progress is difficult and help is scarce. Like a small bird without a nest at sunset, you may feel uncertain where to turn. Discord between generations or ranks may also unsettle the household.
months.3: A difficult interval mixes joy and sorrow in equal measure. Avoid disputes that could become repeated litigation. Trade or business travel, however, is associated with a substantial gain.
months.4: Intention alone does not make plans work. Stay faithful to current responsibilities rather than opening another venture that could cost you. East and north are unfavorable, where a good situation may reverse.
months.5: An old dragon obtains its pearl only late, leaving success uncertain despite ambition. The verse offers financial gain or, if that does not occur, the birth of a son as alternative themes.
months.6: Keep established methods to reduce waste and loss. Resources are associated with the south and may be found through deliberate effort. Official or administrative matters are less favorable this month.
months.7: Resources lie outside your usual setting, and going out may bring a good return. Worry gives way to joy like rain on spring grass. Good conduct is the verse’s way of sustaining this favorable pattern.
months.8: Do not let personal attachment prevent a needed decision. Firm, upright action and good conduct support gain. An unexpected windfall or a favorable move of home is highlighted.
months.9: Work proceeds reasonably well, with occasional good news, like timely rain on grass by a river. The verse still cautions against waterside activity and unexpected accidents. A distant journey or financial loss may occur.
months.10: Moving ahead without a clear view resembles sailing at night. Act carefully. An eastern direction is described as a possible way around the looming difficulty, though the image of a river crossing without a boat remains frustrating.
months.11: An undertaking in the wrong setting brings little benefit. Assess your surroundings and your own role clearly. Someone close may cause harm; careless assumptions about people can lead to disappointment.
months.12: A change of attitude and attention to household matters can turn misfortune around. Hardship passes and peace returns. Do not remain tied to old ways merely from hesitation; a fresh approach may be favorable.

541.chongun: Of the thirty-six strategies, retreat is the wisest here. The opening warns against movement under unfavorable conditions and recommends restraint, patience and a wider perspective. Do not force an outcome. The verse then contrasts an upsetting stay at home with gains from going out, reflecting a changeable pattern. Trouble in the household or gossip may arise, especially in the fifth and sixth months. Let events develop without excessive control and handle matters carefully. In time the favorable turn returns: rain reaches a dry sky and the sun shines brightly afterward. Difficulty passes, affairs settle, and there is room for good news and enjoyable activity.

months.1: Let go of what you cannot control and seek a settled mind. Forcing a gain before its time is unproductive. Listen selectively, since tempting or flattering words could derail work already underway.
months.2: Dark clouds obscure the moon, calling for care in all matters. A change of place may be stirring, but relying on clever schemes can invite penalties. If home is unsettling, time elsewhere is described as helpful.
months.3: An existing difficulty may be joined by another. Guard belongings against theft. Being elsewhere may offer a better experience than remaining in an upsetting home environment; proceed carefully in either case.
months.4: Direction is hard to find this month. Avoid romantic excess, which the verse marks as harmful. The north and funeral visits are also described as unfavorable.
months.5: Wealth seen in a dream does not last. Excessive ambition may bring loss. Yet the verse also places an unexpected gain within reach, so receive an opportunity without grasping for more.
months.6: The verse presents mourning or, alternatively, an additional household member. Resources may exist amid hardship but remain insufficient, like food without utensils. Staying still feels difficult, while movement may bring benefit.
months.7: Harmony across the household supports joy and smooth work. An unexpected gain or the arrival of a child is highlighted. Remaining entirely at home brings little benefit; activity elsewhere may be more productive.
months.8: Ambition is large but resolve is weak, leaving action behind desire. Avoid the west. Careful execution and completion can prevent harm. Money may come, though the net return is modest.
months.9: Personal conditions are fairly favorable, but possessions and money need protection. Attend to possible household instability. Avoid arguments and unnecessary disputes to reduce gossip.
months.10: Resources are associated with your efforts. An initial loss may precede a larger gain. Home may be upsetting while outside work succeeds. Choose new friends carefully because the verse also warns of unexpected trouble.
months.11: A favorable turn brings resources you did not seek. Official matters or happy household news proceed well. Business and assets grow, like selling an ox to purchase a field.
months.12: Home is peaceful and resources are plentiful, leaving room to enjoy yourself like birds in a green mountain forest. Avoid the east and do not add a new undertaking. Keep a steady mind and patience.

542.chongun: You may unintentionally hurt someone, then feel regret and anxiety. The verse recommends good conduct as a way through this pattern. Separation from someone close and a limited return from work are themes. Concern involving a close person, financial loss or gossip may appear as alternatives; unexpected legal or official trouble also calls for care. Though the world is wide, you may feel like a solitary traveler with nowhere to rely on. A lonely window on a quiet journey captures this mood. Do not let a harsh world make your own attitude harsh. Health and gossip are cautions, and maintaining an established course is favored over changing it.

months.1: Household discord may appear as disagreement between spouses. Work toward harmony. The verse places personal illness or concern about parents among the alternatives, with further harm possible if actions are careless.
months.2: Rash movement is unfavorable, while faithfully handling your duties within your means is favored. Choose acquaintances carefully to reduce financial losses. Drinking and romantic excess carry similar cautions.
months.3: Theft could be compounded by another setback, so guard possessions. Work may remain stationary without visible growth, like a tree planted in snow that cannot root.
months.4: Some comfort can be found even within difficulty. Avoid troublesome romantic involvement and complete current work faithfully. The west offers little benefit; observe progress before pressing onward.
months.5: During the fifth and sixth months, take care not to harm someone unintentionally. Financial prospects may gradually improve from small gains to larger ones. The verse still warns of loss and illness involving a wife.
months.6: Setbacks may occur in several places, leaving you restless when nothing follows your wishes. Take a clear look at your own approach. Joining a dispute is unfavorable.
months.7: The image is a household without rice or grain, worried about its next meal. Rushing toward a goal before conditions are ready will not complete it. Be careful with acquaintances and avoid unnecessary transactions.
months.8: Someone previously hurt may hold a grudge, causing distress. A small financial gain is still possible. Avoid disputes and gossip; close involvement with someone from the west is described as unfavorable.
months.9: A favorable star brings financial opportunity. Even if the beginning is difficult, the later part improves and plans may succeed. Drinking and romantic excess offer harm without benefit in this verse.
months.10: Financial fortune remains favorable, but personal wellbeing needs attention. Disorganized work may add strain, so consider the sequence of your actions. A distant journey is less favorable than staying close to home.
months.11: Plans need structure and sound judgment to avoid failure. Illness or concern involving children is a caution. A coworker may share your intention while acting differently, leaving appearance and reality out of step.
months.12: Discord between spouses may unsettle the household. A favorable turn arrives later, bringing substantial resources. In this particular verse, a visit near water is associated with financial opportunity.

543.chongun: Affection or loyalty is divided between two places, making it difficult to choose. This may weigh on your mind, but firm decisions and good conduct can lead to a better outcome later. Health needs care. The road is difficult, yet avoiding harmful actions may help you pass through it. A gain may be followed by a loss, bringing disappointment. Although the year is tiring, the verse does not describe it as uniformly disastrous. Resist the appeal of new possessions or ventures merely because they are new; protecting what is established is favorable. An old fisherman plays a flute in rain beside a clear river, yet urgent matters leave little time for a longer view and some efforts may bear no fruit.

months.1: In the first two months, your work may change. New responsibilities and Travel Horse make life busy and mobile. Going elsewhere is favorable, with resources associated with your efforts.
months.2: Small amounts accumulate into a larger result. Value modest gains. Choose acquaintances carefully to avoid unexpected harm. Drinking or romantic excess is associated with financial loss or gossip.
months.3: Proceed carefully and treat others with humility. You may be blamed without fault or drawn into gossip, so avoid disputes. Money can also disturb a previously good friendship.
months.4: Affairs may feel like a dream, but upright conduct can build something from little. A distant journey is favored if home is unsettling. Guard against theft or financial loss and attend to health.
months.5: An oriole singing in a willow suggests personal ease. Staying at home is favored over going out, where the verse places difficulties. Coveting another person’s resources may produce a small gain followed by a larger loss.
months.6: Gossip may be joined by legal or official trouble. A difficult road favors personal cultivation and care for the household. The west, however, is associated with substantial resources.
months.7: A previously favorable pattern gradually declines. Sadness and worry may arise during work. Ambition beyond your means can cause failure, and forced pursuit of money may bring little.
months.8: Someone may offer useful help. Personal energy and resources improve, allowing effort to produce results. A person associated with Wood is favorable, though care in choosing acquaintances remains worthwhile.
months.9: Meet difficulty with courage, patience and persistence rather than giving up. Avoid the north, which carries a financial-loss warning. New connections offer little benefit; be selective.
months.10: Plans keep slipping away, like fish hiding between rocks when the line is cast. Drinking, romantic excess and risky ventures all carry financial-loss cautions. Proceed thoughtfully.
months.11: Someone close may cause harm. Avoid arguments that could lead to gossip and limit distant travel, which is associated with loss. Do not pursue an advantage that is not fair or rightful.
months.12: Fortune begins to open and circumstances improve daily, like spring grass growing as the snow melts. Someone may seek your support or shelter. Careful management of the household can lead to unexpected success.

551.chongun: An unfavorable household atmosphere brings concern for children, with illness adding a further caution. Money may come in small amounts while spending remains high. The north is associated with benefit and a helpful person in the annual verse. Overall, slow progress may unsettle you, making personal discipline useful. Guard against theft or financial loss; concern about children is an alternative theme. A firm mind and persistence can carry the household through difficulty toward a better period. Effort may fulfill a wish, and an opportunity should not be left for someone else to take. Still, avoid reckless greed over matters whose limits are already clear.

months.1: Slow progress leaves the mind unsettled. Calm yourself and work on personal discipline. Financial loss or concern about children is highlighted, like blossoms scattered by a strong wind overnight.
months.2: A small outlay is associated with a larger return. Financial opportunity and unexpected benefit are favorable themes. The verse adds that a lack of good conduct may bring concern to the family.
months.3: Someone close may turn a good situation difficult. Helpful people are associated with the west and south. Finish work carefully and participate sincerely, but observe before pursuing a less favorable new plan.
months.4: The north is unfavorable; even a gain from that direction may carry harm. The verse also advises avoiding westward or northward travel because of health concerns. Some financial opportunity remains, though the gain may be small.
months.5: Do not let hardship alone decide your outlook. Courage and persistence can bring a later result after an exhausting start. Avoid the east and postpone a premature new venture. Illness or concern about children is the alternative caution.
months.6: Household fortune is unsettled and worry lingers. A better event may follow once the difficulty passes. Cultivate good intentions and avoid harmful behavior to support smoother work.
months.7: Official trouble or gossip may arise. The east is favorable, with a helpful person there. Household worries are part of the traditional pattern, but sincere care in each matter may help you pass through them.
months.8: Risk accompanies work, so act thoughtfully. Staying within your means may turn a difficulty into a better result. Avoid the north where possible, and keep some distance from new social involvement.
months.9: A bird in snow loses its nest at sunset, reflecting disappointed wishes. Recognizing and addressing your own gaps may open a path to resources and recognition. Gossip remains a caution alongside success.
months.10: Earlier difficulties recede and a wish may be fulfilled. The ninth and tenth months carry strong financial themes, with substantial gains and easier progress in planned work.
months.11: A solitary plum tree stands beside a snowy window, suggesting difficulty. Choose acquaintances carefully to guard against loss. A large gain may be elusive, while a small one is possible.
months.12: Wait for suitable timing and assess the situation clearly before acting. Guard against theft or lost possessions. The year’s closing may offer little novelty, but it need not leave substantial regret.

552.chongun: Worldly worries recede, leaving a more comfortable year. Visitors bring pleasant company, and prosperity and recognition are prominent themes. Peach blossoms draw bees and butterflies, symbolizing wishes finding a response. Being away from home may bring a significant opportunity, with the favorable result arriving later. A line cast into blue waves finally catches a large fish: effort may earn more than expected. An unexpected gain brings ease, while confidence grows like a fish moving freely in spring water. Recognizing capable people helps attract others who support your work as if it were their own. The verse recommends sincere offerings at the beginning of the year.

months.1: Spring wind and fine rain revive everything. Personal ease draws visitors and pleasant company. The image is enjoying a drink deep among blossoms, with few worries and a favorable personal pattern.
months.2: Conversation with visitors by a mountain window makes worldly concerns seem distant. Household harmony and progress are strong themes. Even away from home, others are described as treating you respectfully.
months.3: A peaceful mind and favorable finances suggest comfort and recognition. Fish and dragons finding water symbolize renewed activity. Advancement or the arrival of a child brings happy household news.
months.4: Money remains favorable, though a small worry may arise. A helpful person supports your work. Approach every matter sincerely and give the work proper attention.
months.5: Anticipate a possible household concern. If this does not arise, financial loss is the alternative warning. Instability at home could involve separation from a family member, so give household matters attention.
months.6: What you seek is described as becoming available. Even a difficulty may be easier to resolve under this strong pattern. Financial support adds to the sense of abundance and joy.
months.7: The verse places an unexpected gain or, at the other extreme, receiving condolences in this month. Protect established work and prioritize security to find benefit. Guard against theft and financial loss.
months.8: A distant place may bring a substantial return and a warm welcome. Worry gives way to household peace. Yet the seventh and eighth months mix favorable events with concerns, so do not act lightly.
months.9: Restraint, good conduct and honesty bring a warm atmosphere at home and favorable news. There is still a caution within comfort: be careful with official or legal matters.
months.10: People may quarrel over an immediate benefit. The verse calls for generosity, associating its absence with concern about children. A favorable turn returns later, helping matters proceed smoothly.
months.11: Show compassion and practical generosity to people with fewer resources, and share their concerns. This is described as beneficial and worthy of respect. Like spring returning to a deep valley, both small and large tasks find an opening.
months.12: Resources arrive repeatedly, easing worries. Personal circumstances and work are favorable. Going out to work brings returns, supporting joy, household harmony and a smoother close to the year.

553.chongun: A graceful figure raises a cup under clear moonlight and a fresh breeze. Harmony between spouses, flourishing descendants and respect from others are the central images. The year is described as favorable, with joy in the household and smooth progress in work. Spring returns and all things welcome it; an east wind clothes the willows in green. Business may grow steadily, but each task has its proper time, so bring it to completion promptly. An unexpected opportunity may also lead to a new plan. The traditional closing recommends sincere offerings at the beginning of the year to welcome the favorable pattern.

months.1: The household works with one purpose, supporting progress. Trouble recedes and unexpected resources may arrive. New acquaintances are less favorable, though a person associated with Water is described as helpful.
months.2: Resources are associated with the south and active effort. Work to develop the business for a return. Marriage or the arrival of a child is an alternative theme, bringing celebration to the household.
months.3: Help from several people brings continued support. Cheerful elders contribute to a bright, harmonious home and happy news. Work proceeds well, with greater recognition from others.
months.4: Harmony between spouses supports the household and children. Plans may progress and an earlier difficulty can become favorable. Official trouble is described as absent, while going out to work brings benefit.
months.5: The image is a gathering among flowers, shared with others. Personal energy and finances are strong, supporting determined plans. The west is associated with resources; steady effort helps move work forward.
months.6: A favorable situation may contain a disagreement or setback. Attend carefully to health. Poorly chosen acquaintances could bring gossip, so take time before becoming close to someone.
months.7: Chrysanthemums hold dew and seem to smile by the window. An official award is one image; good news involving descendants and growing recognition are others. Household fortune is described as especially favorable.
months.8: A helpful person supports a plan and speeds its completion. Someone nearby may still cause trouble. Friendship with a person associated with Wood is linked to unexpected success, while careful choice of acquaintances remains necessary.
months.9: Business becomes more active and obstacles ease. Personal circumstances and finances are favorable, with promotion or an unexpected gain among the possibilities. Reputation and returns grow together.
months.10: The household may welcome a child, or a distant journey may arise instead. An unexpected helper supports your plans. The month is described as comfortable, cheerful and favorable.
months.11: Personal ease and harmony between spouses support a peaceful home. Work moves smoothly, like a sail carried by a warm spring wind. The pattern favors comfort and enjoyment.
months.12: Some difficulty may occur, but a favorable event follows and its influence continues. Business improves beyond its earlier level and resources increase. Caution in choosing acquaintances helps avoid harm.

561.chongun: A northwest wind rises, and no one knows where the hat will land. Sudden problems may interrupt work or its completion. Ability is present, but timing or execution is awkward; events diverge from intention and time seems wasted. Household difficulties make frustration hard to resolve. Financial loss is a caution, so avoid impulsive movement. A sword sharpened for ten years has still not been used: a long-prepared plan may remain untested. Be especially careful about following other people’s words without judgment, as flattering advice may waste further time and bring harm.

months.1: Snow still fills the spring mountains, making a planned goal hard to reach. Involvement in empty activity wastes time. Yet organizing the work step by step may still bring a wish closer.
months.2: Unproductive work consumes time, like searching for flowers after their season. Impatience makes obstacles feel sharper. A small initial gain may be followed by financial loss, so be careful.
months.3: You and someone close may differ in intention and action, leading to separation. A small issue could become a dispute or gossip. Stay within your means and avoid waterside activity, which the verse links with a sudden fright.
months.4: Plans may remain more hope than substance. Before one unfinished task is resolved, another worry appears. Concern involving a wife is also highlighted; prepare and attend to it early.
months.5: The month is unfavorable for becoming involved in disputes or gossip. Rash behavior carries a warning of unexpected harm. A joint undertaking is also described as prone to failure, requiring particular care.
months.6: A seven-year drought leaves no green grass. When work stalls, returning to familiar ground and living within your means is favored. Do not despair at scarcity: hardship comes first, with a later gain. Budget for several expenses.
months.7: An ingenious plan may fail to land as intended. Be selective with acquaintances, whose benefit is limited in this passage. Concern about parents may arise, and the verse recommends preventive care.
months.8: Romantic involvement may bring manipulative requests or an unexpected complication. Restlessness affects both body and mind. A distant journey is not described as harmful and may offer a change of setting.
