months.9: Health deserves particular attention under this unfavorable pattern. Careless handling of matters may unsettle the household. The verse recommends seeking ways to anticipate and reduce difficulties before they arrive.
months.10: Rain clears and the moon appears. Work becomes more active and the household pattern improves. Going out may bring a return, while living calmly within your means supports resources accumulating naturally.
months.11: A peach blossom outside the window carries spring alone. Financial gain or happy news involving children is highlighted. Despite the favorable pattern, be careful with close acquaintances because a loss warning remains.
months.12: Stay settled rather than moving impulsively. Resources may decline, so guard against losses caused by others. The verse places a harmful person outside the household and favors protecting your own home and position.

562.chongun: Cinnabar is prepared in a precious cauldron, an old image of an immortal’s elixir. Metal energy accompanies you, symbolizing continued resources and growing recognition. Work may reach completion and household assets expand. The family enjoys abundant food and cheerful company. Moving home is described as favorable. A flower holds jewel-like dew while an oriole sings: prosperity leaves little else to desire. The year may begin with difficulty but becomes easier as time passes. Use the improving conditions to begin a long-considered plan. The traditional closing recommends sincere offerings at the beginning of the year to welcome smooth progress.

months.1: An oriole sings in deep green foliage. Resources are described as coming without force, and intentions may be understood without elaborate explanation. Keep honest motives and help people in need to sustain the favorable theme.
months.2: A favorable turn finally answers an old wish. Resources and household assets grow, supporting peace and repeated good news. A celebration involving someone in the younger generation is highlighted.
months.3: A clear-minded ruler and wise ministers symbolize peaceful conditions. The west is favorable for gain. An unnecessary financial loss is still possible, so do not let a small matter become a larger upset.
months.4: Someone with little property may receive an unexpected gain. Resources from the west reach the home. Circumstances become easier, and remaining comfortably within your means is favored.
months.5: Resources are pictured as mountains and granaries filled with grain. Trouble recedes, with illness described as kept at bay in the traditional verse. Be cautious with close people, who could cause significant loss; confidence in your own judgment matters.
months.6: Financial gain or a new marriage is the alternative theme. A wealth star at the gate brings resources from several places. Conditions are described as open and favorable, with work creating further benefit.
months.7: Deep mountains and thick forests shelter many birds. Avoid the south, which the verse marks as harmful. Household fortune is strong and worries recede. Use abundance wisely by setting something aside.
months.8: Even a high mountain seems easier to climb under the favorable pattern. A career reward or income from trade is highlighted. Avoid the south and act with judgment to preserve the good conditions.
months.9: An unexpected gain or distinction involving descendants brings joy. A helpful person may assist your work or resolve a private worry. Unexpected success is the month’s main theme.
months.10: Good fortune arrives like welcome rain, supporting repeated success in business. Drought-stricken grass finds water and turns green. The caution is close involvement with a person associated with Fire, which may bring a small difficulty.
months.11: Illness is a possibility in the traditional verse, but it describes a favorable response to treatment and a continuing supportive pattern. A helpful person may bring a career opportunity and wider recognition.
months.12: A plum blossom smiles with dew in the courtyard. Increased resources or happy news involving children is highlighted. Farming and official work are both described as rewarding. Helpful people are nearby, so meet each task sincerely.

563.chongun: Entering deep green mountains, you first build a shelter. This year calls for attention to health and the frustration of having intentions that do not readily become results. A bird struggling to fly without wings captures the difficulty of seeking resources without the means. Household concerns make it hard to settle your mind. The verse warns against romantic entanglements and improper conduct, which may bring harm. Avoid arguments and constant comparisons of who gains or loses; these can create discord. Under strain, treating others harshly may attract criticism and leave you isolated. The central task is to guard conduct and patience during an unsettled year.

months.1: A dragon without a plan cannot easily rise to the sky. Money may appear and bring brief joy, yet prove difficult to keep. The image is food you can see but cannot eat: available resources may not become usable benefit.
months.2: Snow on the mountain hides the expected spring light. The verse warns that romantic entanglement may damage both reputation and resources. Pursuing money may instead increase outflow; protecting what you have is itself a gain.
months.3: Even in the fourth month, the deep mountain sees no spring. The mind feels wintry rather than warmed by a breeze. Running about in search of a result brings little, leaving effort without an obvious place to claim its reward.
months.4: Concern about children is highlighted, alongside illness described as slow to respond to treatment. Repeated setbacks may make direction hard to judge. The south is favorable in this passage; waiting for better timing is also wise.
months.5: A traveler feels lonely beside a quiet mountain window. Illness involving a wife is a concern, leaving body and mind unsettled. Staying home brings little progress, while a journey may offer some relief.
months.6: Far from home, work is difficult and distress is hard to bear. Proceed carefully to avoid an unexpected setback. Frustration may bring strong homesickness; the verse holds that brighter days can follow once this difficult passage is crossed.
months.7: A dispute may escalate and cause deep hurt; the alternative in the verse is the loss of a wife. Be cautious with advice that sounds smooth but conceals harmful intentions, starting with people close to you.
months.8: Do not covet another person’s possessions, as the attempt may cost your own. A minor matter could attract gossip and repeated criticism. The pattern offers little gain, so act with deliberation.
months.9: Blocked in the east, you hurry west without much return. Fatigue and discouragement may increase. Do not force a financial gain; remain within your means and wait for timing to improve.
months.10: Stepping on a tiger’s tail symbolizes uncertainty about where danger may appear. The traditional spirit imagery adds a health warning. The verse recommends prayer as a ritual response to the unsettled pattern.
months.11: Do not rely blindly on friends, as an unnecessary entanglement may end poorly. The verse recommends visiting a sacred mountain and praying to its guardian spirit. East and south are unfavorable for travel, where even useful effort may come to little.
months.12: A night of fierce wind scatters the blossoms. Do not add a new venture when existing work already faces difficulty. Remaining steady and limiting exposure to further setbacks takes priority over movement.

611.chongun: A storm rises on level ground, leaving your hands tied. An unexpected obstacle on the road can make direction hard to find. Work may begin without reaching its finish, and many wishes bring few visible gains. Official or legal trouble is an additional caution, so handle matters carefully. The sixth and seventh months carry warnings of unexpected setbacks, while gossip needs attention throughout the year. Overlapping difficulties are pictured as flashes of a blade that leave you shaken. Do not attribute everything to unfavorable luck: a constructive attitude and continued effort may still bring some comfort within the difficult pattern.

months.1: Snow covers the landscape and no traveler can be seen. Worry may absorb so much attention that ordinary duties are forgotten. The image is a horse unable to advance on a steep, dangerous road; protect your energy.
months.2: After crossing one difficult hill, another mountain appears. A new plan may meet further obstacles, making events hard to judge. Staying within your means is favored over rash action.
months.3: A traveler laments beside a lonely window. An unexpected matter may lead to gossip, so speak carefully even with close people and avoid impulsive moves. The verse traditionally recommends prayer at a sacred mountain.
months.4: Repeated difficulty may be compounded by unexpected spending. Moving home is unfavorable in this passage; protect what is established and settle your mind. Gossip or illness is the alternative caution.
months.5: Joint work may end poorly, so independent action is favored. Rash attempts to secure a gain could bring penalties. The financial pattern begins with a gain but ends with a possible loss.
months.6: A morning gale scatters blossoms. Plans do not readily take shape and several directions feel blocked. The verse gives a particular warning against becoming involved with another person’s partner.
months.7: A favorable sign appears within the difficult pattern. Unexpected resources may ease worry. Career recognition or a windfall are the alternatives. Even in good circumstances, guard against theft.
months.8: Happy news involving children may bring a household celebration. If this does not occur, the verse instead describes continuing worry and discord. A gain may be followed by a loss, balancing the two.
months.9: This passage names the third and tenth months as times of achievement. The north is favorable for resources, especially work involving seafood. Be careful with close people, as excessive trust may lead to loss.
months.10: Moving elsewhere to escape trouble may uncover another difficulty. Live within your means and judgment rather than chasing every exit. Greed invites loss. If two people quarrel, restraint is the favorable response.
months.11: The moon rises in the east and brightens the surroundings. Work begins to open and a wish may be fulfilled. The beginning is difficult and the end favorable, with financial prospects improving as setbacks recede.
months.12: A clear river reflects the moon, refreshing the scene. A large gain may not arrive, but a small one brings peace. Drinking or romantic excess could instead cause financial loss and gossip.

612.chongun: An orchid planted in green mountains has no wish to move again. Flowers smile in the garden as bees and butterflies seek their fragrance: peaceful circumstances need not be abandoned in pursuit of more. City life is associated with recognition, while land or fields bring household resources. The verse also favors choosing a suitable new place to live, where support can continue. Existing aims and new plans both find room. Spring sunlight reaches a shaded place and flowers open, symbolizing clearer progress around you. Work to the east and west keeps you busy, with reputation and resources growing together. A golden needle catching silver fish completes the favorable imagery. Sincere offerings at the start of the year are traditionally recommended.

months.1: Plants flower in season and work flourishes. Helpful people are associated with the east and south. Going east is especially favorable for financial opportunities.
months.2: Conditions open broadly, with sufficient food and clothing and a settled mind. Household warmth and growing resources reinforce one another. Peace in body and mind makes the world seem kinder.
months.3: Household-spirit imagery suggests complaints or discontent at home. Sadness and worry may be followed by their easing and the return of joy. Concern involving children is possible; the verse recommends prayer beforehand.
months.4: The image of harmful spirits waiting beside the road makes going out unfavorable. The verse recommends Buddhist offerings as a traditional preventive rite. Concern involving a wife is also noted.
months.5: Favorable conditions gradually replace the setbacks, as naturally as the seasons change. Resources accumulate and useful opportunities appear. Sincere effort toward a goal may bring a result.
months.6: A gentle disposition is associated with resources from several directions and continuing support. Selfish competition, however, may lead to litigation. Patience and willingness to yield are favored.
months.7: A private difficulty may bring fatigue and loneliness, or concern about children may arise instead. The verse treats it as passing rather than lasting. The image is a phoenix that has lost its bamboo grove and support.
months.8: Financial conditions favor turning a small resource into something larger. Work abandoned by others may succeed through your effort. Unexpected gain is a strong theme.
months.9: Difficulty comes first and benefit later. Wait calmly and attend to the household. Illness affecting family members is a caution; the verse traditionally recommends prayer, reflecting an unsettled month in which rest may be difficult.
months.10: A frustrating problem may resolve, lightening body and mind. Welcome rain symbolizes financial relief. Household resources grow under a favorable wealth-star image.
months.11: Do not pursue improper advantage; greed may leave only disappointment. Going out in hope of a good result may be less useful than staying home. Blind trust in a friend could cause financial loss.
months.12: A noble star at the gate symbolizes unseen and practical help. Someone supportive may bring success to your work. Career recognition is highlighted; if it does not occur, financial loss is the alternative warning.

613.chongun: With the right connection, you can pluck the red cassia branch, a traditional image of achievement. Help from someone close may bring good news and advancement. At times, however, income may be small while spending is large, so consider consequences before acting. The household is harmonious, with disputes kept from spilling outside. Personal confidence resembles that of a successful examination candidate. Goals can be completed near or far, and a favorable current may make progress feel easier, like a boat crossing the sea with a fair wind even without rowing. The verse recommends sincere offerings at the start of the year.

months.1: A tortoise and dragon offer auspicious signs. Earlier good conduct is associated with growing resources and appreciation from others. Wealth from the west may reach you unexpectedly.
months.2: A helpful person may support unexpected success. If an unexpected gain does not appear, the alternative is happy news involving descendants. A household celebration also brings the regard of others.
months.3: Timely rain makes the grasses flourish, and business finds its season. A small resource may become a larger one. Some difficulty can still enter a favorable pattern, so avoid disputes.
months.4: Riding a dragon into the sky symbolizes an opening. Setbacks disperse like clouds and blessings arrive like rain. A spring garden attracts bees; resources grow, the mind settles and the household may gain a member.
months.5: With few household worries, there is room to enjoy peace. Resources are pictured as a mountain, easing impatience. A favorable personal pattern brings a springlike atmosphere wherever you turn.
months.6: Deep green growth symbolizes support and accumulating resources, even without forcing the search. Gossip remains a caution this month, so take care before words become a source of hurt.
months.7: A favorable pattern brings warm company wherever you go. The east is especially associated with a helpful connection. Travel in that direction may bring both support and benefit.
months.8: An unexpected success may spread your name. If career recognition does not appear, happy news involving children is the alternative. Greater household resources and generosity draw people toward you.
months.9: A wealth star suggests an unexpected gain. Circumstances may feel markedly better than before. A person associated with Metal is described as helpful, particularly in shared work.
months.10: Riding a dragon upward symbolizes abundant support. Opportunities may arrive without desperate pursuit, allowing work and financial aims to progress. Financial gain or the birth of a son are the alternative themes.
months.11: The united strength of a household can achieve more than any one person alone. Harmony supports repeated happy news, and outside resources are pictured as finding their way into a warm home.
months.12: Outflow is small and inflow large, favoring accumulation. Like a dragon finding its luminous pearl, household and business interests align. Personal recognition and respect from others are highlighted.

621.chongun: Three visits fail to produce a meeting, and pride or distance obstructs the connection. Home may be upsetting while going out brings little gain. Plans appear close to completion but remain unresolved. The north is unfavorable; if another setting must be sought, the south is preferable. Yet distant travel is not generally favored this year, so patience with ordinary joys and hardships is advised. Promised relief may not fully arrive before the year closes. Even so, adapting to difficulty and continuing your effort can produce some happiness within the unsettled pattern. Something useful can emerge from what looked empty, so do not lose courage.

months.1: Searching the sea for gold symbolizes effort directed toward an unsuitable goal. Plans may not reach completion. Difficulty can impair judgment, but it is no reason to seek dishonest gain.
months.2: A long drought strains both plants and people. The difficult road is already being crossed. Living in an orderly way while waiting for calmer conditions is the wise course in this passage.
months.3: The harmful-spirit image adds a health caution. Distant travel is unfavorable. Stalled work may create household clashes and reduce cooperation; willingness to yield helps restore harmony.
months.4: A boat cannot reach deep water while floating in a shallow pool. Disorganized work makes the goal difficult. Avoid the east, which the verse marks as harmful. Resources remain elusive while obstacles repeat.
months.5: Discord between siblings may lead to ongoing disputes or litigation. Unfinished plans and repeated arguments resemble seeking fish in a mountain. Greed is linked to failure.
months.6: Work begins without reaching its end. When plans are unfavorable, remain within your means and keep the household steady. If a door stays closed, taking a step back may be wiser than forcing it.
months.7: The verse warns against romantic excess and conduct that could undermine your own position. Goals may remain unfulfilled under the difficult pattern. Staying settled at home is favored over impulsive outings.
months.8: Be careful with close people. Joint work may cost resources or reputation; independent work is preferable in this passage. Even then, the seventh and eighth months are described as requiring effort through difficult conditions.
months.9: Fortune finally opens like rain reviving the land. Financial prospects strengthen and provisions accumulate, allowing the household to feel more secure. This is the clear favorable turn in the sequence.
months.10: Different intentions and mutual complaints unsettle the household. Even close acquaintances require judgment before greater involvement. Staying at home is favored.
months.11: Small gains accumulate into something larger. Early difficulty gives way to peace. Avoid arguments and narrow-minded disputes that could lead to gossip and spoil the improving pattern.
months.12: A trusted person may cause harm, so choose connections carefully. Romantic involvement carries a separate warning of unexpected difficulty. Guard possessions when out, as theft is also mentioned.

622.chongun: A fish escapes the hook only to face another trap. Snow remains and green grass cannot yet be seen. Financial conditions are difficult, and obstacles enter many undertakings. Be careful with close people: a smile may conceal a blade. Rather than aiming high and suffering a large disappointment, the verse favors modest expectations and peace. Frost falling on green summer grass captures the unfavorable timing. Do not chase fleeting wealth or behave lightly, as the consequences may be greater than expected. Avoid oversized plans and excessive desire. Living within your means and reducing exposure to harm are the immediate priorities.

months.1: No road seems open, making advance and retreat equally difficult. Plans may not work, and an attempt to escape one problem could create another. Be careful, especially with travel east or west.
months.2: The first two months are pictured as hollow and lacking direction, like a clear sky without a moon. Do not seek dishonest advantage. Upright conduct is the path the verse favors.
months.3: Walking a rainy road at night symbolizes effort that others may not see. Avoid desires beyond your means; settle yourself and choose a sound course. The third and fourth months are unfavorable for official affairs.
months.4: The verse warns of people who may cause harm, particularly someone close. Avoid waterside activity, which it associates with unexpected trouble. Careful conduct is described as a way to reduce the danger.
months.5: Obstacles may turn work into financial loss. Do not rush or overextend a business. Close involvement with friends may be unhelpful, and remaining at home is favored over going out.
months.6: A setback can reverse an apparently favorable situation. Disagreements involving others may prevent shared work from reaching its goal. Do not rely blindly on friends, as the potential loss is significant.
months.7: The seventh and eighth months carry health cautions. The verse traditionally recommends sincere prayer before a Buddhist altar. Avoid arguments and gossip; it presents conflict as the main source of further trouble.
months.8: Difficulty may send you looking for resources in the wrong place. A move elsewhere does not automatically resolve an unfinished plan. Repeated attempts may still bring little, leaving frustration rather than completion.
months.9: Disorganized work risks failure. Examine what actually benefits you and act more carefully. The south offers a possible small gain, but a financial-loss caution remains.
months.10: Avoid disputes that could become litigation, producing a small gain and a larger loss. The verse recalls that sweetness follows bitterness: patience through the current difficulty allows room for its passing.
months.11: Gentle rain helps everything grow. Trouble recedes, and a rat entering a rice store symbolizes available provisions. Wishes and practical aims may be fulfilled, leaving room to enjoy a drink in a moonlit pavilion.
months.12: A horse travels a broad, open road. Personal recognition brings respect. Even with a close friend, keep private matters confidential; disclosure could lead to a setback and regret.

623.chongun: Entering another realm, you become involved in the affairs of a high official, an image of recognition coming your way. Yet desires beyond your means or arguments can spoil work and disturb the household. Home is favorable, and going out may also bring gain. A dragon finds its luminous pearl, while an east wind encourages every spring flower to bloom: aims and reputation are supported. If making a distant journey, the east is favored. An unexpected helpful person may appear, supporting financial plans and smoother relationships. A windfall and a peaceful home are further themes. The verse recommends sincere offerings at the beginning of the year.

months.1: A kind disposition and earlier good conduct are associated with support arriving naturally. A helpful person assists you, household resources grow and peace follows. A wealth star at the gate highlights an unexpected gain.
months.2: Coveting another person’s resources may interrupt the favorable pattern. A career reward or substantial financial gain is possible, but unnecessary outings are less favorable. Do not travel impulsively.
months.3: The west and south are associated with growing resources. Abundance allows shared company and celebration. Household life becomes more comfortable and the family may gain a member.
months.4: The third and fourth months are described as comfortable and satisfying. Going out may help fulfill an aim. East and south are favorable directions, with an unexpected gain associated with travel.
months.5: Reputation and resources are both favorable. Work with others this month for benefit. Continuing to apply yourself during good conditions can add one success to another.
months.6: Do not seek another person’s possessions or set fairness aside for gain. Financial loss or damage to reputation is the warning. Be cautious with close people and accidental losses.
months.7: Fortune returns, allowing small resources to become larger, like streams entering the sea. Timely rain brings abundant crops. Help and opportunities are associated with several directions.
months.8: Career recognition or the birth of a son is highlighted. Household joy accompanies smoother affairs. The earlier difficulty gives way to a favorable period, illustrating sweetness after hardship.
months.9: Ability and judgment help you handle even an unexpected task as if it were familiar. Resources and support accumulate. Household peace and cooperation reinforce the favorable pattern.
months.10: Health requires care; intention may be strong while energy is limited. Be cautious with a person associated with Fire, whose friendly appearance may conceal an unhelpful motive. Working through a difficult period is part of the verse’s lesson.
months.11: A favorable pattern allows your success to benefit many others. The household may grow and family members prosper. Seeking an official position or career advancement is especially favored in this month.
months.12: Support is abundant and well rooted, like a long season of spring sunlight. There is little need to demand more. Avoid excessive desire; living peacefully supports continuing household harmony.

631.chongun: Cassia blossoms open and fall; wait for the next spring. A celebration or a move may occur, while household concerns may instead center on the couple. The year favors humility and waiting for a better opening. Impulsive travel or careless action can bring regret. Yet a helpful person is also indicated, making shared work and well-chosen connections more favorable than acting entirely alone. Find a sound collaborator rather than relying only on your own judgment. Honest intentions are associated with a better turn, and toward the end of the year work may unfold more as intended. The verse recommends sincere offerings at the year’s beginning.

months.1: A favorable start may become an unfavorable finish. Difficult events and frustrating details may outnumber pleasant ones, leaving you disappointed.
months.2: Cloud and mist obscure what you want to see. A blocked wish may be joined by gossip. The verse nevertheless urges approaching a new plan with the intention of creating something from little.
months.3: The third and fourth months bring limited returns. Romantic involvement is marked as unfavorable and potentially disruptive. Remember that time continues to move and difficult conditions also pass.
months.4: A favorable turn is beginning to return, but lingering setbacks still make completion difficult. A good opportunity may be visible while you feel like a traveler unable to find the road to it.
months.5: The fifth and sixth months carry concern for parents or, alternatively, children. Several difficulties may overlap. Guard possessions carefully against loss.
months.6: Staying home and concentrating on existing work is favored over distant travel. Going out may bring loss without gain. The verse particularly cautions against traveling by boat this month.
months.7: Rain finally reaches the long drought, allowing modest relief. Some financial opportunity appears, but a small worry may remain. Avoid arguments; insistence on your own view can let gossip obscure the favorable turn.
months.8: A household united around a goal finds warmth and benefit. The south offers a favorable opening. Honesty rather than deception is the condition the verse places on keeping this good fortune.
months.9: Do not covet another person’s possessions or disregard fair conduct, which could bring criticism and loss. Be cautious with someone close. Although conditions remain difficult, a better period is near enough to wait for patiently.
months.10: Concern about parents or, alternatively, children is highlighted. The month feels like one mountain beyond another, with little immediate relief. Private worries may be particularly difficult to share.
months.11: The long-awaited favorable turn arrives like rain on the crops. Household resources increase, plans reach completion and people feel more content. The family may also gain a member.
months.12: Joy may suddenly turn to sadness, leaving you like a lone pine or a small boat adrift at sea. Be cautious with close people, as familiar connections may offer little support. Examine your own position rather than only blaming others.

632.chongun: An angry company in retreat leaves damage in its wake. This year favors staying within your means and keeping a settled base; moving elsewhere may be harmful. Illness or official trouble that restricts your freedom is part of the cautionary imagery. Avoid quarrels, raised voices and insistence on your own view, which can contribute to failure. With support feeling distant and obstacles close, much may seem difficult. Yet quietly attending to your own duties without interfering in others’ affairs can bring some benefit. Resources gather and scatter; with your own problems pressing, mocking others serves no purpose. The overall pattern is busy but offers limited return.

months.1: Stepping on a tiger’s tail symbolizes a sudden fright. Work may stall while health concerns add strain. The verse recommends prayer as a traditional response and cautions that empty ambition makes hardship heavier.
months.2: Do not place excessive trust in a close person. Sincere help may not be returned with gratitude. Moving home is unfavorable; quietly protecting your present position is preferred.
months.3: A harmful spirit watching the gate symbolizes illness or another malicious influence. Be careful with people and advice, especially where official trouble is possible. The verse recommends prayer at a sacred mountain.
months.4: Take care in every matter, as the verse describes a substantial setback. Unnecessary outings carry a warning of unexpected harm. Do not dwell only on the difficulty; remember the possibility of a better period afterward.
months.5: Many plans fail to align with circumstances, creating frustration. The verse recommends prayer and places a warning in the spouse palace, suggesting disagreement at home.
months.6: Drinking or romantic excess is pictured as a net that restricts you. Be cautious with close people and avoid following advice merely in hope that it will help; unexpected trouble could leave regret.
months.7: Distant travel may not meet expectations. A small gain can be outweighed by a larger loss. Still, favorable conditions slowly emerge, allowing a modest return within the difficulty.
months.8: Launching a boat in shallow water for a long voyage brings effort without completion. Marriage or the birth of a son is a household theme. Drinking or romantic excess may damage resources and reputation; act on what you know is right.
months.9: Illness may join stalled work and add a personal burden. The verse recommends sincere prayer as a traditional effort to ward off approaching difficulties.
months.10: Discord between spouses disturbs the place that should offer the most peace. Confused efforts resemble seeking a rabbit at sea or gold in water. A close person associated with the east may cause harm.
months.11: Running east and west brings fatigue without the intended result. Do not spend all your energy lamenting the pattern. Remain within your means and attend to your own work while waiting for better conditions.
months.12: You may feel isolated and unsure where to settle. Excessive trust in someone close could cause harm. The source specifically cautions against close involvement with someone surnamed Sim.

633.chongun: Relatives quarrel, like the body’s own limbs losing their connection. Effort may not bring success under this difficult pattern. The wealth star encounters emptiness, making resources hard to obtain. Work with the circumstances available rather than reaching beyond your means. Attempts to advance may be blocked, and disputes tend to be unfavorable. Like a field flower wilting in autumn wind, intention remains stronger than present ability. Keep seeking your proper role and protect what is yours, rather than coveting another person’s place or possessions. The verse treats trying to seize what does not belong to you as a recurring cause of failure.

months.1: Autumn grass meets frost, reflecting sadness and little support. Relatives feel distant, and even an intimate companion appears cold in the old imagery. Avoid the north, which carries a loss warning, and keep a settled base.
months.2: The sun is setting while the destination remains far away. Mountains and rivers seem to follow one another without end. Repeated setbacks leave body and mind unsettled, like plants struck by frost.
months.3: Fallen leaves meet a stronger wind, scattering worries. Avoid the south. A trusted friend may cause harm or financial loss, and another person’s affairs may draw you into unexpected difficulty.
months.4: Official or legal trouble is a caution. Guard speech, avoid talking carelessly about others, and keep private matters private; words travel far. Your own effort may nevertheless attract a helpful person and open a small path.
months.5: Avoid disputes and gossip. Timing is unfavorable for a new venture or a major expansion of existing work. The verse traditionally recommends prayer for protection while proceeding carefully.
months.6: Cloud and mist fill the mountain, obscuring direction. Obstacles consume attention without producing progress, and affairs may seem insubstantial. Follow a reasonable, orderly course rather than forcing events.
months.7: Household-spirit imagery suggests disturbance, for which the verse recommends prayer. Financial loss is a possible alternative. Avoid disputes that could grow into official trouble, and pursue your plans carefully.
months.8: Plans remain difficult and worries continue. Work far from home may not reach completion, leaving you unsure when you can return. Even offered help may be difficult to receive without the right means or preparation.
months.9: Patience is the better response even when anger feels justified. A promising financial start may become a loss later. The image is a traveler reflecting on past choices beside a lonely window.
months.10: The old verse treats increased speech by women as a warning of household decline, reflecting its historical assumptions. Avoid empty ambition. A favorable turn begins within the difficulty, with career recognition or the birth of a son restoring joy. Hold to the steady resolve of an evergreen pine.
months.11: Unexpected success brings renewed business activity. Household members work together, and favorable events follow. The delayed opening finally arrives, leaving both home and outside affairs calmer, like ground strengthened after rain.
months.12: An unfavorable pattern turns favorable: difficulty comes first, relief later. The year’s central lesson is to stay within your means and keep a settled place. Avoid impulsive moves that could let the improving conditions slip away.

641.chongun: Careful thought combined with courage can support a settled life. Yet concerns affecting both older and younger household members may disturb that peace. The year calls for caution. Home may feel unsettling, but going out is not automatically better; judge the benefit and cost of each move. Plants must pass through winter before spring growth returns. In the same way, wait for a better interval before starting new work. Be cautious with close friends and shared ventures. West and south are associated with helpful connections, while east and north may turn even a good relationship into hostility and are not favored for travel.

months.1: Home seems unproductive, yet there is no clear place to go. Dwelling on unrealistic plans in a quiet room brings little. The favorable interval has not arrived yet, so practice patience.
months.2: Spouses united in purpose can achieve more together. Helpful people appear and benefits follow. Enjoy the improving conditions calmly and within your means.
months.3: Disorganized work makes plans hard to complete. Unexpected setbacks are possible, so be cautious with people close to you. A hidden source of friction may be nearer than expected.
months.4: The pattern opens like a sail catching a fair wind on the sea. Resources and provisions increase, bringing household enjoyment and confidence. East and south are favorable for gain.
months.5: Continue existing work rather than opening a new business that could bring loss. Guard against theft and similar setbacks. A practical, measured response helps the underlying favorable pattern return.
months.6: Upright conduct and care for the household ease worry. A warm spring breeze symbolizes calm. An unexpected gain or distinction involving children is highlighted; continue along a sound path.
months.7: Going out may leave regret, while staying home offers more comfort and little lost benefit. The verse also recommends a deliberate visit to a sacred mountain for prayer, with a clear and settled mind.
months.8: Difficulty enters a favorable situation like clouds and rain hiding the view. Avoid disputes that could become official trouble. Close acquaintances and financial loss are cautions.
months.9: A thirsty dragon finds water and a hungry tiger finds food. Helpful conditions may bring resources without force. Still, guard against gossip and possible litigation within the favorable period.
months.10: Guard possessions against theft. East and west are not favored for pursuing a goal this month. Better conditions are gradually approaching. Protecting your judgment matters even more than guarding the door.
months.11: Fish and dragons find water, giving ability room to act. A wealth star shines on the household, business grows and opportunities appear in several places. Home and mind become peaceful as the pattern rises like a waxing moon.
months.12: The eleventh and twelfth months carry happy news, strong resources, successful plans and useful connections. The year favors staying within your means and keeping a settled base. Treat each ending as preparation for another beginning.

642.chongun: Seeking a rabbit at sea and fish in the mountains symbolizes looking in the wrong place. This year calls for independent judgment rather than following others’ words without scrutiny. Another person’s affairs may cause losses, especially through close connections. North and south are unfavorable for starting work. The overall image is a fierce wind passing through, with little support while you search for relief. Avoid empty ambition and stay within your means; fair conduct can still uncover a small benefit within difficulty. Escaping one demanding situation only to meet another adversary captures the year’s uneven course.

months.1: Excessive desire may leave disappointment rather than gain. Loss of possessions or poor performance in outside business is the alternative caution, adding worry to body and mind. Prepare sincerely for overlapping difficulties.
months.2: Do not quarrel over resources. Willingness to yield can be more beneficial than winning a dispute. Otherwise, your own assets may pass to someone else; remain within fair boundaries.
months.3: Drinking or romantic excess is associated with substantial loss. Avoid a harmful direction before it becomes a personal concern. Work and saving are difficult, leaving frustration and repeated sighs.
months.4: Going out to begin work is unfavorable. Guard possessions against theft and be cautious with close people. Trust that initially seems useful may later prove costly; gain through another person can be outweighed by loss.
months.5: Blocked work may put pressure on daily living. The verse recommends sincere prayer and warns of concern involving children alongside scarcity. Honest conduct is associated with gradual improvement.
months.6: Do not force a major achievement by opening more work. Calm attention to the household is favored over ambition. Gossip adds to the difficult pattern, so speak carefully even with close people.
months.7: An unexpected visitor may offer help, so do not judge the whole future by the present hardship. The bitter interval can pass. Avoid starting a new venture and allow patient effort time to work.
months.8: Following another person’s instructions blindly may bring loss. Meanwhile, small improvements accumulate and the path gradually opens. People around you may offer support, helping work reach completion.
months.9: The household carries a health caution affecting family members. The verse traditionally recommends earnest prayer at a sacred mountain to seek relief. Its final image of a cloth washing away dirt emphasizes clearing what has accumulated.
months.10: Do not covet another person’s property. An early gain may be followed by losing what is yours. The mood resembles fallen flowers no longer visited by bees. The east is especially associated with financial loss.
months.11: Business grows complicated without clear progress or return. Work has a beginning but no visible end. When activity becomes frantic, slow down rather than adding more confusion.
months.12: The verse recommends prayer before difficulties arise and places illness among its cautions. Even within the unsettled pattern, help is possible: a person associated with Metal may appear unexpectedly and create a small opening.

643.chongun: A traveler in darkness unexpectedly finds a candle. Financial conditions are strongly favorable in the annual reading, though it presents a celebration or, if absent, an unfavorable event as alternatives. Generally, an unexpected gain is pictured as a mountain of resources, bringing personal ease and peace around you. Be careful with close friends, since a shared financial interest may divide a previously good relationship. Help is symbolized by an immortal from the Jade Pool, with career recognition also prominent. The verse recommends offerings at the beginning of the year. Plans and wishes are described as finding support, with resources available in many places.

months.1: Spring blossoms finally become fruit. An unexpected gain that increases household assets or the arrival of a child is highlighted. In the first two months, help from someone close supports your work.
months.2: The pattern is clear and fresh like dew on plants. A helpful person brings benefit. Resources from the west may reach you unexpectedly; manage the favorable opening well to accomplish your goal.
months.3: Trouble melts like snow in spring warmth. Resources are associated with outside work, and a person met while traveling may help. Career recognition or happy news involving children is the alternative theme.
months.4: A warm southern breeze symbolizes personal comfort. Household resources grow, relatives live with fewer complaints, and peace allows existing abundance to develop further.
months.5: Unexpected recognition brings the regard of others. Many plans are described as succeeding. Concern involving children is a caution; the verse traditionally recommends prayer in response.
months.6: Metal entering the season of spring becomes a substantial vessel in the verse’s image. Financial fortune returns and your own effort earns credit. Resources grow, while a helpful person from afar offers significant support.
months.7: Good news through documents is linked to career advancement. Reputation and opportunities grow together. The verse encourages confident pursuit of a prepared aim rather than unnecessary hesitation.
months.8: A tree in the east blooms at the right time. Marriage or the birth of a son brings happy news. Household members and land may increase, with a smoother road ahead.
months.9: Unexpected recognition spreads your name and draws respect. A wealth star supports substantial resources, while affairs feel relatively peaceful. Share some of what you have gained with others.
months.10: A dispute may arise, but patience and willingness to yield are favored even when anger feels justified. Kind conduct earns appreciation, and a helpful person may bring good news.
months.11: The favorable pattern continues: existing business grows and a new undertaking may proceed smoothly. Romantic entanglement carries a warning of unexpected harm. Staying within fair limits supports a longer-lasting benefit.
months.12: Resources and personal wellbeing are described favorably, with opportunities wherever you go. Avoid arguments, however, because a dispute could become official trouble. Protect the peaceful pattern through restraint.

651.chongun: A caged bird is released and flies into the sky. Clouds disperse and the moon reveals a different world. East and north are favorable directions. The beginning may be difficult, but the later pattern improves, so continue steadily through obstacles. Mourning or household worry is an alternative caution. Yet spring light returns twice, symbolizing renewed growth that can overcome the setbacks. A rich harvest and generally gentle seasonal winds suggest more joy than worry across the year. Personal wellbeing and resources are described favorably. The verse recommends offerings at the year’s beginning as a way to welcome the opening without missing its timing.

months.1: The moon appears after rain, refreshing the pattern. Career advancement or financial gain brings joy. Be cautious with a person associated with Earth, whose friendly appearance may conceal an unhelpful motive. Upright conduct helps avoid harm.
months.2: A helpful person gradually opens the way. Even if the beginning is difficult, patience can lead to a worthwhile result. Romantic involvement is less favorable this month.
months.3: A steady personal pattern brings respect. Work others consider fruitless may produce a return through your effort. The west holds a useful connection. Keep following your course with conviction.
months.4: Harmony between spouses creates a peaceful household. Finances are favorable, though gossip or illness may intrude. The verse traditionally recommends sincere prayer at a sacred mountain.
months.5: Household members unite, helping plans and wishes reach completion. Romantic excess is a caution, as chasing pleasure may disturb the favorable conditions.
months.6: A kind disposition and earlier good conduct are associated with growing resources. Provisions and assets accumulate, leaving room to enjoy security and recognition. Do not forget the lessons of harder times.
months.7: Clouds scatter and sunlight returns. An unexpected success adds joy to an already improving pattern. Earlier good conduct supports further happy news, but remain modest and think about the future.
months.8: The imagery is especially abundant: blessings, resources and precious goods fill the household. The family may gain a member. Work progresses and household assets continue to grow.
months.9: Plans and wishes are described as reaching completion, with happy news nearby. The remaining caution concerns people close to you, who may still cause harm within a favorable period.
months.10: A plum tree blooms in its season. Help arrives without an exhausting search. Harmony between spouses supports the household, and efforts ripen like seasonal fruit.
months.11: Spring light returns twice and happy news reaches the door. An unexpected gain or career recognition is highlighted. Concern involving a wife remains a caution; the verse recommends sincere prayer.
months.12: Substantial resources may come to the household. Close involvement with a person associated with Water could nevertheless lead to an unexpected setback. Be careful in choosing acquaintances, including those already nearby.

652.chongun: A plum blossom carries spring alone within the snow. Like a shoot receiving rain after drought, support brings new life. Difficulties may still occur without overwhelming your spirit, and a helpful person can bring recognition. The year turns an unfavorable situation toward greater ease. The imagery includes respected friends gathered around plentiful food and drink, and a person on a high place reciting a new poem: achievement becomes visible to others. Do not despair if a plan initially resists you, for the reading places completion later. The verse recommends offerings at the beginning of the year to welcome that turn.

months.1: A helpful person brings recognition and a favorable opening. Household cooperation forms a strong foundation for your work, supplying courage and support. A wish may be fulfilled; begin the year with clear intentions.
months.2: Assistance makes possible something beyond your individual ability. The verse links this support to earlier kindness and good conduct, and encourages maintaining that disposition.
months.3: Having already achieved something, do not let hesitation stop the next step. Support is available nearby. An unexpected gain or distinction involving descendants is highlighted; seek the opportunity close to home.
months.4: The image is meeting a beautiful companion in a moonlit pavilion. The source cautions against a person designated Bok-seong and also against a person associated with Metal. Choose acquaintances carefully and do not follow advice uncritically.
months.5: Welcome rain revives the crops. Personal conditions and finances improve. The benefit is associated with a distant place, where travel may help complete a plan and bring resources.
months.6: Concentrate on established work at home rather than starting more outside. An outside undertaking may lose more than it gains. Avoid waterside activity, which the verse links with a fright. Existing resources are the seed of future benefit.
months.7: Strong financial conditions support successful business and a calmer, more generous mood. Be cautious with someone close, however: the verse warns that a friendly smile may conceal an unexpected source of harm.
months.8: Clouds clear from a bright autumn sky. Household joy accompanies the completion of a long-held aim and the return from earlier work. Apply yourself fully to the harvest now available.
months.9: Active work outside is favorable for gain. Documents or writing may bring resources and recognition. Extend some of that benefit by helping others.
months.10: The image is resting in a high room and enjoying what you have built. Finances, work and recognition are favorable. The verse adds a warning of lost possessions if good conduct is neglected.
months.11: Do not let greed reverse a favorable turn. Avoid coveting another person’s resources, act carefully and remain within your means. Excess can be as unhelpful as shortage; moderation is the theme.
months.12: Rain refreshes all things. A helpful person may appear, favoring shared work over working alone. Resources support household peace, while considerate handling of family matters brings joy to children.

653.chongun: The person who brought success departs, leaving earlier achievements difficult to preserve. Good events may occur, yet recognition is not always matched by practical benefit. Moving east is associated with a possible distinction, but interpersonal disputes need particular care. Even winning an argument may bring gossip and distress. The favorable interval seems to have passed before plans were completed. An old dog wearing an official hat and a lonely traveler beside a cold inn lamp are images of an awkward, dispiriting situation. Worry may make it difficult to choose a direction or express your intentions.

months.1: East and north hold useful connections and possible completion. Do not place blind trust in someone close. Avoid quarrels and gossip, and practice the judgment needed to live and work alongside others.
months.2: A traveler loses the road as the sun sets. Trust in a friend may prove misplaced, and a setback can enter a favorable situation. Gossip and official trouble are cautions. The east is unfavorable this month.
months.3: Dark clouds hide the sun and moon. The image is being trapped in a river without ready help, while severe gossip adds to the burden. Difficulties may feel present wherever you turn.
months.4: A long drought symbolizes continuing setbacks. Concerns involving a wife and children may disturb the household. The Vermilion Bird image warns of gossip, so choose words and actions carefully. Yet a tree should not be cut down merely because some leaves have dried.
months.5: A person associated with Fire may offer a small favorable opening. At the same time, the fire-spirit image calls for care with fire at home and unexpected accidents. The verse anticipates a better interval after the difficulty.
months.6: A favorable star at the gate brings quiet support and some progress. Do not resign hastily; attend to your present work. A person associated with Wood is a caution, especially in shared work or advice involving money.
months.7: An old dragon without strength gains little by trying to rise. Advance and retreat both feel difficult. Personal illness or concern about children is the alternative warning, keeping worries active.
months.8: Repeated setbacks may bring fatigue and disappointment, but a favorable turn is gradually approaching. The north is helpful, especially through people surnamed Jeong or Kim.
months.9: Staying calmly at home is favored, with unexpected resources possible. Small amounts accumulate into something substantial. This month marks the beginning of a brighter financial pattern.
months.10: Remaining within your means brings personal ease. Yet a difficulty may enter the favorable period through household disagreement, with family members taking opposing sides.
months.11: Concern involving children may arise at home, though the verse describes it as limited rather than a major lasting problem. Be careful with a person associated with Fire and with gossip.
months.12: Illness is a caution. The verse traditionally recommends prayer at a sacred mountain. As the year closes, it describes setbacks and illness gradually receding and better events returning, with wellbeing restoring energy to daily life.

661.chongun: You are first to pluck the red cassia branch from the palace, a traditional symbol of achievement. Spring returns and everything begins anew. A helpful person can bring recognition, resources and influence. Plans and wishes may be fulfilled, with household assets and provisions growing. Harmony supports this favorable pattern. Avoid disputes, which could lead to litigation. Career benefits and the birth of a son are among the old verse’s themes. Fine clothing, plentiful food and repeated celebrations fill the household imagery. As difficulties can still enter good circumstances, offerings at the beginning of the year are traditionally recommended.

months.1: A dragon finds its luminous pearl, symbolizing recognition. Career advancement or happy news involving children is highlighted. Resources support the household. Identify what is properly yours to do and act on it.
months.2: Kindness previously shown to others returns as support. Resources and influence are favorable, giving plans room to develop and leaving less space for worry.
months.3: Good conduct is associated with happy news. The south is favorable for resources. Plans may reach completion and bring visible satisfaction.
months.4: Avoid arguments, which offer harm without benefit. A task that initially looks easy may grow difficult and fail midway. A person associated with Wood is linked to possible official trouble; restraint is useful.
months.5: Do not assume another person’s intentions match your own. Consider motives carefully. A person associated with Water carries a warning of harm or loss; keep confidence in your considered judgment.
months.6: A helpful person offers steady support. Do not accept friendly words without judgment, as another person may have a different intention. The overall pattern is favorable enough for modest care to keep the month steady.
months.7: Strong financial conditions suggest an unexpected gain and a more comfortable livelihood. A small worry may arise, however. Moving home is described as a possible way to ease that difficulty.
months.8: Staying home is favored over going out. Avoid westward or northward travel. Good circumstances may still contain a small worry, so take care in ordinary matters.
months.9: Work with patience rather than rushing for profit. Haste may disorganize the task and make it less favorable. Waterside activity is cautioned against because the verse places possible accidents nearby.
months.10: A person associated with Wood is favorable for shared work and resources in this month. A helpful connection may bring a substantial gain. Reputation and benefit grow together, with others appreciating your good conduct.
months.11: Working within your means may bring an unexpected resource. Avoid the north, which is unfavorable. Some planned work may still require effort without reaching a visible result.
months.12: Happy news is highlighted at the year’s end. A calm approach within a difficult setting supports resources. A person associated with Metal may offer unexpected benefit and help complete your plan. Value your reputation.

662.chongun: Green mountains open before you like another world. Harmony between spouses supports continued benefit. Career recognition or unexpected resources are prominent alternatives, and both reputation and finances are favored. The third and fourth months are especially associated with completing a wish. A magpie’s dawn call points toward the west, where a goal may find its opening. The annual verse also describes the seventh and eighth months as bringing wider recognition through successful work. Receive favorable circumstances without arrogance; kindness and good conduct help protect household peace. Because difficulty can still enter a good pattern, the verse recommends offerings at the year’s beginning.

months.1: A favorable star at the gate supports smooth affairs. Household harmony and accumulating resources bring joy and distinction to descendants. Sincere effort is the place where the verse locates benefit.
months.2: Resources make daily life comfortable. Going out to pursue a plan may bring a result. A career benefit is highlighted; if it does not occur, personal illness is the alternative caution.
months.3: A wish may be fulfilled and plans proceed with fewer obstacles. Bees settling on a blooming spring garden symbolize harmony. Business moves like a fish in water, with provisions and resources growing.
months.4: A thirsty dragon finds water. Devotion to the household and faithful conduct strengthen the favorable pattern. Setbacks recede and tasks reach completion, like grain ripening in the short autumn sunlight.
months.5: Difficulty comes first, followed by a larger return than the initial outlay. The image is enjoying resources and influence from a high pavilion. Recognition may draw envy, making humility useful.
months.6: Yellow chrysanthemums bloom by the window, yet appearances may conceal strain: outward prosperity can coexist with private scarcity and worry. The difficult interval is temporary in the verse, which advises patience.
months.7: Personal illness and concern about children are cautions. The verse recommends prayer as a traditional response. Be especially discerning with acquaintances, distinguishing supportive people from those who bring harm.
months.8: An ominous star image brings a mourning warning. The verse recommends sincere prayer. Career recognition is one possibility; if absent, an unfavorable event is the alternative. A visit to a sacred mountain for offerings is traditionally suggested.
months.9: An unrealistic undertaking may lead into a pit. Set aside greed and live within your means. The verse also describes rescue from grave danger within the difficulty, but still calls for particular care. An empty vessel makes a loud sound.
months.10: Sunlight rises in the east and the heavenly gate opens. Setbacks recede like drought ended by rain. Renewed life and relief restore a smile: a favorable turn follows the bitter interval.
months.11: The difficult period recedes, but conduct can still change the outcome. Preserve the opening through good actions. Avoid improper gain and disputes that could bring loss or gossip.
months.12: A continuing drought leaves plants dry and resources limited. Yet the verse judges the favorable features to outweigh the unfavorable ones. Avoid rash action, remain within your means and make steady, sincere work the priority.

663.chongun: Autumn maple leaves are finer than peonies. The year is described as favorable and relatively secure for completing work. A move of home or, alternatively, a distant journey is likely within the old verse’s pattern. A substantial unexpected gain and happy news may bring joy. Do not expand too hastily merely because conditions look good: results are placed somewhat later, making patience essential. Toward the year’s end, outside resources may arrive with little force, supporting ease and a settled mind. The verse recommends offerings at the beginning of the year because even a favorable period can contain a complication.

months.1: A difficult beginning gives way to a favorable result. The south is associated with good news and resources. Discord between spouses or concern involving a wife remains a caution.
months.2: Help from another person may complete work that has long been difficult. The overall pattern is favorable, but involvement with another person’s partner can obstruct it. Keep conduct within fair boundaries.
months.3: A hungry person meets a rich harvest, symbolizing plentiful provisions. Shared work with a helpful person can make a difficult goal achievable and benefit both sides. Cooperation is especially favored this month.
months.4: Flowers fall and leaves grow thick. The source associates a child’s arrival with the birth of a son. Illness involving a wife is a caution within the favorable period. Even with physical discomfort, work may proceed reasonably well as conditions shift.
months.5: Timing seems prepared for you, allowing plans to find a ready response. Financial prospects are strong, with resources and household assets accumulating.
months.6: The verse describes enough support to handle several tasks smoothly. Business and happy events continue, yet illness involving a wife may create household worry alongside the success.
months.7: The image is resting comfortably in a large house and enjoying what has been built. Existing resources are plentiful and further income continues. Clouds disperse, leaving a clear, refreshing breeze.
months.8: Clear skies symbolize a comfortable and satisfying livelihood. Career recognition or happy news involving children may bring congratulations and respect from others.
months.9: Several matters may reach completion together, keeping you busy gathering their benefits. What you have is sufficient. Coveting another person’s resources can disturb the favorable pattern; receive success with humility.
months.10: Financial loss or a new marriage is the alternative theme. A useful connection is associated with the south. Conditions are somewhat less favorable, but deliberate effort may still produce a modest gain.
months.11: A helpful person may bring resources you did not expect. Giving something small can be followed by a larger return. The month may be busy and tiring because several aims require your attention.
months.12: Travel Horse suggests at least one distant journey. Early difficulty gives way to smoother work, making earlier patience feel worthwhile. Do not rush into a task now; haste could bring substantial regret.

711.chongun: Seeking spring's beauty, you suddenly find flowers opening. Many people help your plans, and affairs go well without great strain. For an unmarried person, marriage and a child's birth are indicated. Personal ease leaves little more to wish for. Wealth, influence, and benefit bring peace among those above and below, like sailing with a favorable wind. Riding out on horseback, you cover a great distance in a day. Many tasks proceed smoothly, with daily progress and substantial gains. An elder's gentle manner brings harmony and comfort to the family. A benefactor's help makes money and recognition easier to obtain. Opportunities to befriend people of standing bring further benefit. Some interference may still enter favorable circumstances; the traditional text recommends an offering at the year's beginning to welcome a better course.

months.1: Welcome rain in a drought revives the plants. Likewise, a good person and opportunity arrive during difficulty, helping work resolve easily. Resources flourish, and a happy event involving your children is indicated. Heaven's help brings blessings into a favorable flow.
months.2: Seeking a rabbit, you find a deer. A modest wish yields something more satisfying than expected. Your undertaking proceeds smoothly in every part. The right timing supports success, and accumulated virtue brings a significant personal celebration.
months.3: Difficulty may arise, but many people around you can help restore prosperity. Benefit lies in your work. Diligence brings substantial gains. The month is generally favorable, and your undertaking is described as succeeding as intended.
months.4: Personal energy and resources flourish, bringing harmony and peace throughout the household. Matters involving documents are favorable and can lead to wealth. Yet illness affecting you, or adversity involving your children, is also indicated. Take particular care.
months.5: A benefactor arrives in the fifth lunar month and brings a happy event. Benefit waits outside the door, suggesting an unexpected gain. You are like someone sitting at leisure in a high pavilion and enjoying its pleasures. A concern involving your wife is the particular caution.
months.6: Flowers fall and fruit forms, an image of honor and prosperity for your descendants. An examination is described as successful; otherwise, money is indicated. Everyday good deeds and accumulated virtue bring praise and are associated with avoiding calamity.
months.7: A favorable star shines at the door, bringing a good development. For a married couple, pregnancy is indicated. Marital harmony fills the home with joy. After a brief difficulty, you fortunately meet a benefactor and your plans proceed as intended.
months.8: Body and mind are at ease, and helpers appear without being asked. Fortune resembles the warm breeze of the third spring month, allowing affairs to go well. Excessive trust in a friend may cause financial loss. With care on that point, the course is smooth.
months.9: Fortune opens, and your undertakings follow your intentions. A married couple may celebrate a child's birth, while an unmarried person may meet a spouse and marry. If illness arises, the traditional text associates a remedy connected with Wood with an easier recovery.
months.10: Something new introduces a world different from what you have known. Gossip is indicated in the tenth lunar month, so be careful when making new acquaintances. Staying home may feel unsettling. The south is favorable. Going there and concentrating on your work brings a favorable course.
months.11: Like sailing with a favorable wind, affairs proceed smoothly. The household flourishes and can enjoy lasting peace and comfort. Effort directed at a small gain brings something larger instead. Substantial benefit and relatively easy success are indicated.
months.12: Like welcome rain in midsummer heat, pleasant events arrive repeatedly. Promotion or success in an examination may bring joy; otherwise, an unexpected gain is indicated. Affairs require little strain, and strong financial prospects provide abundant sustenance.

712.chongun: This year's image is a dragon that has not yet obtained its wish-fulfilling jewel. The time has simply not arrived. Wait patiently, and good developments eventually return. Work may be difficult at times, but it can reach completion. Riding through streets full of flowers, you feel confident. A benefactor fortunately arrives to help, spreading your name in every direction. Smooth fortune favors success. If wealth and honor do not arrive, official trouble, litigation, or gossip may arise instead; apply yourself to your work. An unpleasant or difficult event may affect a relationship with someone you love, so take care. Even a small trickle eventually reaches the sea. Sincere attention to small tasks can bring a large benefit, and your talents can help your neighbors. A minor adversity may disturb your prospects; the traditional text recommends an offering at the year's beginning.

months.1: The favorable time has not yet arrived, so work does not flourish. The east is harmful and best avoided. Starting work may bring an unwelcome development. Do not readily believe others, as flattering words can deceive you and disrupt the undertaking.
months.2: You try to accomplish something without yet finding the opportunity, making the effort somewhat difficult. A benefactor appears, however, and helps bring your intention to completion. Sincere work can yield a return matching the effort invested. Keep applying yourself.
months.3: Moving house is favorable this month and can bring a good event. Going to the water and boarding a boat may bring a fright involving water; the text advises avoiding it where possible. Associations can also cause harm, so choose them carefully.
months.4: Your undertaking appears close to completion, but the timing is still premature. Endure as often and as long as you can; patience is the virtue called for here. Through it, merit accumulates, favorable events arrive, and adversity recedes.
months.5: Gaining by harming another person can cause the harm to return to you. Unexpected adversity is indicated, so avoid romantic or sexual entanglement. Like the moon entering clouds, circumstances may turn unfavorable. Take care in all matters.
months.6: Closeness to others can bring harm, making careful selection of new acquaintances advisable. Work does not follow your wishes, unsettling body and mind and leaving little attention for other affairs. A poorly chosen working partner can produce an unfavorable result.
months.7: An investment opportunity may exist, but without resources you cannot take advantage of it. Staying home feels uneasy, while going out gives your mind some freedom. An unfavorable influence remains, with harmful people nearby.
months.8: Favorable fortune finally arrives, indicating a happy event. The source also states that all property accumulated so far disappears. It then points to an unexpected gain or marriage, followed by flourishing personal and financial prospects, plentiful money, and peace at home.
months.9: Family discord in the ninth lunar month may unsettle body and mind. A child's birth brings celebration, yet may also entail financial loss, so take care. You rush busily in every direction but may find only fatigue without a corresponding achievement.
months.10: Success comes through another person, bringing recognition and benefit. Personal peace and financial gain resemble leisurely enjoyment beside a moonlit window. An unwise acquaintance may cause loss. Care with that point keeps the outlook favorable.
months.11: Without plans, affairs do not proceed as intended. A small concern at home makes staying there feel persistently uneasy. Uncertainty about whether to advance or retreat unsettles your mind and disrupts work. Thoughtfulness is advised in every matter.
months.12: Casually entering worldly affairs brings little benefit. Preserve what you already have and live steadily. Disputes may lead to gossip or litigation. If you can patiently get through that danger, favorable developments remain ahead.

713.chongun: Dragon and tiger gather as wind and clouds come together. Their powerful harmony suggests affairs following your intentions and financial prospects opening widely. Meeting a friend far from home brings joy. Wealth accompanies you, and seeking it can yield the amount sought. Your undertaking is described as successful. This year may look modest outside while being abundant within. Family harmony brings peace. A clear, warm east wind gives the willow the promise of new life. A good opportunity introduces signs of progress. Advancing one step at a time brings continuing development. Other people help your work reach completion, and financial fortune adds substantial benefit and respect. The traditional text recommends an offering at the year's beginning to welcome an even more favorable course.

months.1: Dig a well and water appears; pile up earth and it gradually becomes a mountain. Steadfast attention to your work eventually brings good developments. Sincerity makes tasks easier to complete. Like plum blossoms opening beautifully before a window in their season, the course is smooth.
months.2: Your intentions can be fulfilled, and favorable financial prospects bring money wherever you go. If no money arrives, marriage is indicated for an unmarried person. For someone with children, a celebration involving them is indicated instead.
months.3: The third lunar month favors recognition. Your name may become widely known, or substantial wealth may arrive. Heaven assists the fortunate, and undertakings prosper, with an unexpected gain possible. Authority in your words draws others' cooperation and respect.
months.4: Married couples and romantic partners enjoy harmony, with heaven and earth pictured as offering support. The household's prospects flourish and adversity recedes. Wealth is associated with the east, where travel is described as bringing a substantial gain.
months.5: The fifth and sixth lunar months allow affairs to proceed as intended. Personal vitality brings a peaceful course. Bees and butterflies seek the fragrance of spring flowers, an image of favorable romantic developments. Unexpected success may bring considerable recognition.
months.6: A harmonious, peaceful home naturally attracts resources and blessings. Wealth flourishes in the east, where an unexpected gain may be found. A new undertaking can be profitable. The west and south are also described as beneficial, with diligent work producing substantial returns.
months.7: Someone associated with the west is unfavorable; working together may cause financial loss. Choose acquaintances carefully to avoid it. Illness may affect a parent, and the traditional text pictures devoted care from the children helping that parent recover.
months.8: Financial prospects are favorable, but worries may arise for you or those around you. A good development through someone senior leads to a favorable outcome later. If there is no promotion or examination success, your descendants may receive an honor that brings joy.
months.9: A benefactor from the east offers unexpected help. The south is favorable and worth pursuing. Diligent management helps the undertaking flourish and produce gains. Money may arrive in abundance at first, but loss is also indicated, leaving gain and loss balanced.
months.10: Good fortune finally arrives, indicating a celebration. A distant journey is favorable, with no particular harm described in any direction. Entering a dispute can still provoke gossip. Observe that caution, and good developments are indicated.
months.11: The eleventh and twelfth lunar months bring favorable events. Trading goods at sea may yield unexpected money. Even when matters are difficult or fail to work out at first, sincere attention to your responsibilities eventually brings a good result. Be patient and keep working.
months.12: An ox finds grass to eat, suggesting abundant sustenance. Affairs follow your intentions and financial prospects flourish, like beautiful green growth in the third month's spring breeze. Dragon and tiger come together in harmony, an image of work reaching its intended result.

721.chongun: Yin and yang unite, giving life to all things. A married couple may celebrate the birth of a cherished child. A respected name and influence bring steadily improving prospects. A benefactor's continuing help opens financial fortune and provides substantial resources. The traveling-horse sign reaches the door, making going out favorable for success. Personal and financial prospects flourish, and work proceeds smoothly with peace of mind. Cultivating virtue and sharing it with others draws respect and allows blessings to arrive naturally. A crane calls from a deep marsh, and its voice reaches heaven. Even difficulties can resolve easily with the heavenly help pictured in the text. A hungry person finds food and a dry tree meets spring: wealth and personal strength revive, bringing peace. Sincere devotion at the year's beginning is traditionally recommended.

months.1: Yin and yang unite, allowing affairs to follow your intentions. Plans proceed smoothly, bringing confidence, peace, and family harmony. Influence and financial fortune accompany you. What you seek can be obtained.
months.2: Official prospects are favorable, suggesting a job or promotion. Money follows, filling the home with harmonious energy. If a financial gain does not arrive, a child's birth is indicated. Pleasure gradually follows hardship, and affairs improve.
months.3: Working with another person may prove empty and fail to reach completion. Your wishes may encounter setbacks, so approach every matter carefully. Financial loss is a concern. Exercise care in your conduct.
months.4: A favorable star shines at the door, indicating success. Financial fortune turns the pursuit of a small gain into something larger. Small particles accumulate into a mountain. Valuing and conserving even modest resources can make your wealth more abundant.
months.5: Like a sail in a favorable wind or a bird flying swiftly, progress is quick. Do not delay what you intend to do, since waiting too long is unfavorable. Personal and financial prospects can flourish like a golden bird singing among green branches.
months.6: Travel brings harm rather than benefit, and illness is a concern. Alongside this caution, your undertakings are described as successful and prosperous, like a field filled with abundant grain at harvest. Financial fortune also accompanies them.
months.7: Fortune is very favorable, with blessings pictured as coming from heaven. A comfortable home brings a peaceful course. A wealth star accompanies you, and seeking benefit can produce it. As your intentions are fulfilled, worries recede and affairs proceed smoothly.
