months.8: Financial prospects flourish, and even a chance opportunity may bring money. The west is unfavorable; someone arriving from that direction may unexpectedly cause harm. Beyond that caution, little particular difficulty is indicated. Still, you may find yourself busy on your own without help.
months.9: Spring returns to an empty valley. Difficult matters resolve and begin to proceed smoothly. A person associated with Wood can offer substantial help and restore energy to daily life. The east is unfavorable, however, with an unexpected embarrassment indicated. Take care.
months.10: A pine on a high mountain remains green, suggesting flourishing work. Welcome rain in midsummer heat brings joy to many affairs. A concern involving your wife or children may arise, but is described as resolving naturally. Avoid unnecessary distress.
months.11: The sun shines high in the sky, making heaven and earth bright. Affairs are smooth and peaceful. The family and its property grow, steadily improving household prospects. Loss of belongings is indicated, so guard particularly against theft to keep the course favorable.
months.12: Personal worries are absent and life is comfortable, like that of an immortal. Money may arrive, but there are many uses for it, so attend to spending. Planning your work helps each undertaking proceed as intended.

722.chongun: Affairs remain unresolved, and good developments meet interference before they can succeed. This year's outlook is unfavorable, with difficulty even amid favorable circumstances. Little money comes in and much is lost. Be content with modest gains rather than becoming greedy. Your intentions are honest, but fortune offers few helpers, leaving you to work and struggle alone. Effort may not bring recognition or results. Trouble at home also prevents your mind from settling. Another undertaking is unfavorable and best avoided. A distant place may offer something good, but you cannot remain there long. A cold lamp lights an inn where a traveler has nowhere to go and feels restless.

months.1: You wish to act, but the work does not reach completion. Effort may pass without achievement, and affairs do not follow your intentions. Trusting someone close too much can bring an unexpected difficulty. Take care.
months.2: Finding a quiet place to live helps avoid turmoil. The traditional text connects a clear body and mind, together with sincere wishes for success, with achievement. A change of job or work is indicated; otherwise, a distant journey may occur. A benefactor met on the road offers help.
months.3: Hiding to escape a small difficulty, you encounter a larger one instead. Excessive trust in someone nearby may expose you to flattering words and harm. A person associated with Water, however, is described as beneficial rather than harmful.
months.4: This month is busy, leaving little leisure or attention for other affairs. Seeking something small may cost something larger, described in the text as the course of fate. It also associates visits to a house in mourning with illness and advises care.
months.5: People working together have different intentions, making the desired result difficult. The north is unfavorable and best avoided. Adversity and illness may recede, yet the undertaking you planned may still fail to reach completion.
months.6: A happy event alternates with a sad one, balancing joy and sorrow. An unexpected gain is possible; otherwise, a child's birth is indicated. Careless associations can bring loss or gossip, so act thoughtfully in every matter.
months.7: Avoid spending the seventh lunar month drinking in taverns, which the reading associates with financial loss. Affairs may fail to reach completion and losses appear in many places. Someone associated with the west is unfavorable and may seriously disrupt your work.
months.8: Unexpected money enters the household. You rush busily in many directions this month. Take particular care not to enter disputes, as gossip may be difficult to escape. With that caution observed, the outlook is favorable.
months.9: Small grass meets spring and a lotus meets autumn. The text describes everything finding its proper time and work proceeding smoothly. If there is no celebration, substantial profit is indicated. Some discomfort remains because a matter is still unresolved.
months.10: A mountain bird loses its nest and flies aimlessly in the sky. Likewise, stalled affairs can leave you distressed, wandering and wasting time. Unease at home brings further turbulence. Careless associations may cause financial loss and gossip.
months.11: Going out brings unfavorable events, making staying home preferable. Unnecessary involvement in litigation leads to loss without benefit. Avoid it. Unexpected illness or misplaced belongings are also concerns.
months.12: Leaving the old and decisively pursuing the new is described as favorable. An active approach brings more benefit than passivity. Great wealth may remain difficult to obtain, but modest gains are readily available. Do not let hollow pursuits distract you.

723.chongun: Having crossed one stretch of blue waves, you face another crossing. Hardship follows hardship, making progress exhausting. Daily life grows more difficult, and unfinished work adds to your worries. Yet sincere effort can bring a kind person whose help averts a greater calamity. Affairs may go so poorly that body and mind are weary, but a benefactor fortunately appears. Pain and hardship remain, though a helpful person arrives eventually. Like round drops of dew rolling gently on a lotus leaf, work can then resolve easily. That ease may be brief: matters again fail to follow your intentions, and wealth and blessings do not readily arrive.

months.1: Personal vitality is associated with the east and wealth with the south. Participating in an undertaking can bring considerable benefit. A benefactor's help strengthens financial prospects. Favorable signs remain within adversity: something lost now may later prove useful.
months.2: Cutting stone reveals jade, and digging a well produces water. Work sincerely, and something can eventually be gained. Otherwise, financial loss is indicated. Missing a good opportunity brings considerable regret, so recognize the timing.
months.3: Joy and concern are mixed in the third and fourth lunar months. Trouble may affect your children; otherwise, another person may bring unexpected money. Approaching disputes can lead to official difficulties. Take particular care.
months.4: A concern amid happiness may bring tears. For a woman who has been in a romantic relationship, a good event is indicated. Disputes or gossip remain possible, but avoiding arguments with others can avert much of the difficulty.
months.5: Closeness to someone associated with the west may lead to mutual hurt over money. Otherwise, gossip is indicated. Handle every matter thoughtfully. Unexpected help from a benefactor in the east offers a favorable counterpoint.
months.6: Set aside empty desire and live within your circumstances. Otherwise, legal trouble is a concern. Careless associations can expose you to criticism. The south is unfavorable, with an unexpected accident indicated. Take care.
months.7: Meeting a benefactor may bring unexpected success. Yet other associations are described as harmful, so judge them carefully and act calmly. Financial loss is a concern. You want to make a firm decision but cannot, causing unnecessary distress.
months.8: Affairs resolve smoothly and prosper in the eighth lunar month, like the beautiful fragrance of orchids before a house. Resources and benefits remain available, and your name spreads widely. Abundant money and personal ease leave little more to wish for.
months.9: Without a benefactor, there is no helper to bring the work to completion, leaving it unresolved. The west is unfavorable and financial loss a concern. You try to decide firmly but remain unable to do so, adding distress without benefit.
months.10: A concern may affect your wife, though no particular personal harm is indicated. Once the worry passes, a family celebration follows, associated with a child's birth. Indulgence in drink or sexual affairs may invite unexpected adversity; that is the caution to observe.
months.11: Pines and cypresses in green mountains keep their integrity. Similarly, resist the temptation to abandon your work for something new. Sincere, diligent attention to your existing responsibilities brings success. Illness may arise, but care beforehand can help you pass through the adverse period.
months.12: Even severe hardship can give way to smooth fortune through sincere effort. You meet a kind person, and work can follow your intentions. Yet this year's overall reading is unfavorable for commerce. Waiting and settling your mind is the course advised.

731.chongun: Visiting every city, you find a thousand gates opening together. The road ahead is clear, and your undertaking proceeds as intended. A favorable star accompanies you, suggesting employment or success in an examination. Unexpected achievement draws praise. This year's reading strengthens official standing, bringing wealth, honor, and blessings of their own accord. Warm spring breezes invite every flower to bloom. Fortune flows smoothly and affairs follow your wishes, with peace and ease throughout. Exchanging something small for something large brings considerable benefit. A chance journey west may yield an unexpected gain, like the warm, silken light of spring in the capital. The traditional text recommends an offering at the year's beginning so that favorable fortune does not pass you by.

months.1: A good opportunity returns, bringing life and prosperity to your work. Financial prospects flourish, resources are plentiful, and affairs proceed smoothly. Favorable circumstances and comfort bring a family celebration. Your wish can be fulfilled as intended.
months.2: A favorable star accompanies you, making recognition easier to obtain. Helpers arrive from the east and south, supporting your undertakings. Heaven and the spirits are pictured as helping, bringing a happy event and naturally arriving resources. These are described as the fruit of accumulated virtue, which you may enjoy.
months.3: Official advancement is indicated, or money gained on a trading journey. Financial prospects flow smoothly and yield increasing benefits. Recognition may arrive suddenly and spread your name widely, filling the household with prosperity and honor.
months.4: Keep body and mind clear, cultivate virtue, and move thoughtfully to avoid fault. If a financial gain does not arrive, an unfavorable event may occur instead. Poorly chosen associations can cause substantial loss. Take care in all matters.
months.5: Staying home is favorable and distant travel unfavorable, especially toward the east or south. Avoid starting something new or casually joining another undertaking. Meeting a benefactor, however, may bring a good event.
months.6: As every stream flows toward the sea, carefully gathering small things can produce a large achievement. An unexpected benefactor comes to help. This is described as a favorable time to start new work. Otherwise, a period of difficulty and distress may arise.
months.7: You look but fail to see. An unfavorable event enters a good situation and disrupts the work. Two people argue fiercely over profit, with no clear winner. A matter requiring secrecy arises, and the text describes that secrecy as continuing undetected.
months.8: Romantic entanglement may lead to unavoidable gossip, so take care. If there is no new job or promotion, a child's birth may bring celebration. Be especially careful in making new acquaintances, as harm may otherwise follow. Remember that only those who sow can reap.
months.9: Flowers have fallen and spring is absent, so bees and butterflies do not visit. Affairs do not follow your wishes, and what you seek remains out of reach. Restraint and setting desire aside are the most favorable course. Rash behavior brings regret without benefit.
months.10: Flowers fall without fruit, like a form without a shadow. Yet an unfavorable beginning gives way to a favorable end, with resources arriving naturally. Moving house is indicated, or otherwise a distant journey. Such movement is described as favorable.
months.11: Unexpected money enters the household. Trade is favorable, with substantial profit and a possible chance gain. Gossip or official trouble remains a concern. Avoid entering disputes.
months.12: Personal circumstances may be precarious, so act thoughtfully. Trust in someone close can turn a favor into resentment. Avoid the west, where you may unexpectedly meet an enemy or encounter harm.

732.chongun: Thunder sounds once at the gate and startles everyone. You establish yourself and gain recognition through character and talent. A wealth star offers help, bringing abundant resources. Wisdom and planning work together, allowing your intentions to be fulfilled. This year's reading points to recognition, wealth, comfort, and a name known widely enough to earn respect. Your descendants may receive honors, and resources continue without interruption. Shooting at a tiger on the southern mountain, you strike it five times in succession. Someone whose ability has long remained hidden finally steps into the world. Affairs proceed as intended, and praise follows. Personal and financial prospects both flourish. The traditional text recommends sincere devotion at the year's beginning to support a smooth course.

months.1: Worries pass and blessings arrive, allowing affairs to proceed smoothly at last. Set your intentions straight and put sincerity into your work; adversity can then recede. Someone from the south offers unexpected help.
months.2: The second lunar month carries the prospect of a house move, which is described as favorable. Avoid improper gain and act uprightly. Substantial wealth may follow, or otherwise a destined romantic connection brings a happy event.
months.3: Joint plans are unfavorable, so avoid devising work with another person. Be cautious of ill-intentioned people. Clashes between those above and below may bring an unwelcome event. Wealth is associated with the west, though the gain is modest.
months.4: Careless words can damage a good situation. Speak and act with composure. The north carries a risk of financial loss and is best avoided. A child's birth is indicated, or marriage with a cherished connection from the past. Move quietly, like a river flowing without sound.
months.5: A major difficulty at home is indicated. Clear your mind and attend to prevention beforehand. Litigation or gossip may arise, so avoid disputes. Be alert even with people close to you, as an unfavorable event can enter favorable circumstances.
months.6: Careless new associations may cause harm, making distance advisable. Rash movement can turn your plans unfavorable. Proceed thoughtfully. Trying to hurry things does not produce the desired result and may only add frustration.
months.7: Adversity passes and blessings arrive in the seventh lunar month, bringing harmony and peace at home. Your wish can be fulfilled. Jade hidden beneath water finally appears in the world. Staying home brings no gain; go out and seek the opportunity.
months.8: Unselective new associations are unfavorable, so limit them where possible. Unexpected adversity is a concern. Unfavorable signs outweigh favorable ones this month. Remain still if you can, observing the circumstances calmly before deciding.
months.9: Plants in a drought joyfully receive welcome rain. Favorable fortune brings both recognition and benefit. A skilled craftsperson shapes jade into a beautiful vessel. Seeking something small yields something larger, filling your surroundings with happiness.
months.10: Good fortune accompanies you, and a benefactor helps you gain recognition. Employment is indicated, or otherwise substantial wealth. Money lies along the road. Going out and working diligently can make the desired gain easier to obtain.
months.11: Preserve what you already have and live steadily. Rash action may lead to failure. Gossip or official trouble is a concern. Yet loss comes first and gain later, leaving some stability within the undertaking.
months.12: Affairs follow your intentions, and pleasure comes after hardship. Closeness to a familiar person can nevertheless turn a favor into resentment and hurt both parties. Romantic or sexual entanglement is also associated with financial loss. Take care in all matters.

733.chongun: A fish transforms into a dragon, a change beyond easy measure. Long study brings recognition, or sustained cultivation of virtue leads to wealth. A happy event is indicated, and your wish can be fulfilled. Clear water fills the river, and fish swim in its depths. Sustenance and resources are abundant, leaving little concern. Working with another person, however, may cause many parts of the undertaking to diverge from your intention. Keep that caution in mind. Flowers bloom along the city wall in the warm breeze of the third spring month. Small tasks and large tasks alike can reach their intended result, bringing peace. The traditional text recommends an offering at the year's beginning to welcome favorable personal fortune.

months.1: A blue dragon finds clouds and rises to heaven, indicating a major celebration. Passing a difficult examination or receiving a high promotion may place you in a position of authority. The image of laurel flowers worn on your head points to entry into official circles.
months.2: Personal fortune is very favorable, and financial prospects flourish. Your undertakings proceed smoothly. As flowers fall and fruit forms, a child's birth is indicated. A benefactor's continuing help supports prosperous work and gains that accumulate like a mountain.
months.3: Unexpected success brings harmony throughout the household and strengthens its prospects. Wealth and honor are indicated, or otherwise a substantial financial gain. High virtue and a respected name bring benefit, spreading your reputation and giving you reason for joy.
months.4: Displaying your authority in every place and task can provoke resentment even at a distance. Arguments that become litigation may leave you disadvantaged through gossip. Unselective associations are also unfavorable. Exercise care about whom you draw close to.
months.5: Balsam flowers in the eastern garden welcome spring, an image of a good event. Like storehouses filled with grain, provisions are abundant. A wealth star accompanies you, allowing your undertaking to proceed as intended and produce substantial benefit.
months.6: Fish and dragons find water, bringing confidence and a celebration. Family members live harmoniously and a wish is fulfilled. Personal vitality and smooth fortune allow affairs to reach their intended result, creating considerable joy.
months.7: Heaven's help brings continuing blessings. Wealth is associated with the south and benefit with your workplace. Active participation in managing the work can yield a substantial gain. Happy events are indicated in the east and west, and beginning something new is favorable.
months.8: Wealth, influence, and benefit surround you like warm spring breezes. A fish leaves a well for the sea, bringing confidence and renewed energy to work. Personal fortune is very favorable, though a concern involving your wife may arise. Attend to that caution.
months.9: If there is no examination success or employment, an honor involving your children is indicated. A benefactor's help can also bring recognition and standing to the household. If none of these occurs, the traditional text warns of mourning and calls for care.
months.10: Like grain bearing fruit in a good field, a well-timed opportunity produces substantial benefit. This is a period of establishing yourself and gaining recognition. Affairs follow your intentions, your energy is strong, and your reputation draws widespread praise and respect.
months.11: Work connected with fish or seafood is described as bringing substantial wealth. Missing the timing can instead cause loss, so recognize the opportunity. A wealth star meets favorable conditions, strengthening personal and financial prospects and making a large gain easier to obtain.
months.12: Red flowers before a window find their season and bloom fully. Long hardship passes, and favorable fortune finally brings wealth and honor. Financial prospects flourish, resources accumulate like a mountain, and an honor for your descendants fills the household with joy.

741.chongun: Six horses run together, an image of a person fulfilling an ambition. Persistent effort through hardship brings recognition. Yet a celebration is followed by a concern. Staying home may unsettle your mind, while being elsewhere may change your feelings. Conduct yourself with composure. An ox finds abundant grass beside a green river. Personal and financial prospects flourish, bringing energy, prosperous work, and substantial gains. Employment or examination success may also occur. Still, the sun descends after reaching its height, and the full moon begins to wane. Favorable fortune gradually diminishes. The traditional text recommends an offering at the year's beginning for a smoother course throughout the year.

months.1: Peach blossoms seem ready to smile in the spring breeze and fine rain. As warmth revives all things, a good opportunity helps your work proceed smoothly. Fortunately meeting a benefactor may bring enough money to fill the home.
months.2: Flowers bloom and play with spring, suggesting recognition and a widely known name. Employment or promotion is indicated, or otherwise a celebration involving your children. With joy already in your grasp, a meaningful connection brings further happiness.
months.3: Good rain knows when to fall, allowing plants to flourish. Difficulty may arise, but enduring it and working sincerely can lead to success through an unexpected opportunity. Wealth is associated with the west and can be obtained by seeking it. Finishing work well is favorable.
months.4: A thirsty dragon drinks water. The difficult period passes, worries recede, and happy events arrive repeatedly. Home life is comfortable and resources flourish. Peace and celebrations throughout the household point to a child's birth or another addition to the family.
months.5: Personal fortune is very favorable in the fifth lunar month. Heaven's help is associated with employment or promotion. The household's prospects open widely, allowing work to proceed smoothly. A kind intention in every matter is described as leading to success.
months.6: Heaven and the spirits are pictured as helping your work reach completion. A boat follows the current with its sail raised. Plans proceed smoothly, and prompt action is favorable. Unnecessary hesitation and delay can be disadvantageous.
months.7: A phoenix leads its young, their calls warm and joyful. Employment or promotion is indicated, or prosperity and honor for your descendants. Family harmony and repeated celebrations draw others' admiration.
months.8: Good deeds toward people in need and virtue cultivated within draw substantial blessings naturally. Wealth and honor arrive together, and your name spreads widely. Financial fortune provides abundant resources and many happy events.
months.9: You open the door wide to welcome blessings, with a further celebration through a substantial reward for good conduct. The east and south are especially favorable and may bring unexpected money and benefit. Good deeds and avoidance of wrongdoing are associated with continuing blessings and resources.
months.10: A golden crown and jade belt represent the ruler's favor. An examination is described as yielding a high score and a pass. Resources and benefit appear wherever you go. Character and reputation gain wide recognition. Very favorable personal fortune increases your standing.
months.11: Benefactors help one another in the eleventh and twelfth lunar months, making your work easier to complete. The undertaking depends on people. Wait with a relaxed mind, and achievement comes later. You stand among flowers as butterflies seek their fragrance.
months.12: Timely rain brings a plentiful grain harvest. Seizing a good opportunity allows your intention to be fulfilled. Yet a sad event alternates with a celebration, balancing sorrow and joy. Another person helps bring your work to completion.

742.chongun: Judge the road ahead early and recognize that honor and advancement each have their time. Seeking fish in a river eventually yields many fish. Digging earth to find gold requires hardship at first, but patience brings good developments and smoother affairs in the end. Peach blossoms in spring and yellow chrysanthemums in the ninth lunar month each meet their proper season. Wealth and honor do not come easily; the text attributes them to heaven's timing and advises waiting for the right moment to act. Blessings arise naturally this year. Siblings live harmoniously, descendants are plentiful, and blessings continue. The proper time for honor has arrived, making success less difficult. A good opportunity lets affairs follow your intentions. The traditional text recommends an offering at the year's beginning for an even smoother course.

months.1: A favorable star accompanies you and brings a benefactor's help. Personal fortune is very favorable and resources flourish. The west and south are favorable for wealth. Finishing well and working to develop your undertaking can bring considerable joy.
months.2: In a month of warm spring breezes, good events appear wherever you go. Employment or promotion brings benefit, and something small develops into something large. Resources resemble a full storehouse, bringing peace, money, and gain.
months.3: Heaven's help is associated with personal honor and distinction. Flowers seem to smile in the garden as bees and butterflies arrive. Work goes well, money comes in, and life is comfortable. Gossip remains a concern; some caution with close acquaintances is beneficial.
months.4: A wealth star helps you obtain substantial money and benefit. Illness or gossip may arise, but the traditional text associates care and devotional offerings beforehand with averting them. A good opportunity returns. Recognize and use it to receive the indicated gain.
months.5: Honor shines brightly on you and raises your reputation. The south is favorable and associated with substantial wealth. The time for advancement has arrived, making success less difficult. Favorable opportunities allow affairs to follow your intentions.
months.6: Illness is a concern, and the reading calls for care beforehand. Avoid indulgence in drink or sexual affairs, which may cost money and reputation. Unselective associations can also bring loss and a sudden fright. Proceed carefully.
months.7: Benefactors support one another, allowing your work to proceed smoothly. Money arrives daily and accumulates like a mountain. Affairs follow your intentions and financial prospects are abundant. A household that has done good is described as receiving favorable events and celebrations.
months.8: A blue dragon rises to heaven, opening many possibilities. Honor and wealth come together, and very favorable fortune makes success easier. Affairs proceed smoothly, leaving little more to wish for. Resources and blessings accompany you, bringing peace to daily life.
months.9: A gentle character and accumulated virtue are recognized by heaven and rewarded with blessings. Wholehearted effort in your work can bring money. The west is favorable for seeking a gain. A major celebration may not occur, but resources and blessings can be enjoyed smoothly.
months.10: A dragon obtains a clear jewel, allowing affairs to follow your intentions. Choose acquaintances thoughtfully. A poor connection can bring loss without benefit. Readily believing someone else's flattering words may disrupt your work. Take care.
months.11: Marriage is indicated for an unmarried person, and a cherished child's birth for a married couple. Desiring wealth beyond your sphere brings no benefit and may prove empty. Restraint is the best course. Loss of belongings is indicated, so guard against theft.
months.12: Other people help your work reach completion and bring money and benefit. Changing your current work may make a new role difficult to obtain. Continuing what you already do is preferable. Poorly chosen associations can lead to failure.

743.chongun: A traveler sets out at dawn wearing a woman's clothes. In the text's image of disguise, an attempt to deceive another person fails and brings harm back to the deceiver. Gossip or concern at home is indicated. Yet a wealth star meets favorable conditions, allowing outside money to enter the household. Financial prospects are strong this year. Apart from that, few good events are described: helpers are absent, work is difficult to complete, and the mind remains uneasy. Spring thunder brings rain and turns the plants green. Money has no particular flaw in its outlook, but some personal adversity may arise, calling for care beforehand. The reading closes with a contrasting image: three months of drought leave the ground dry and the fields without green grass.

months.1: A traveler returning to green mountains loses the way and wanders. Work fails to progress or follow your intentions, leaving you uncertain where to turn. Illness involving a descendant may unsettle your mind. Legal trouble or gossip is a concern, so avoid disputes.
months.2: The road ahead looks dark, making hope difficult and leaving your mind troubled. Fortune is unfavorable. Preserve what you have and wait steadily for a good opportunity. Hurrying does not complete the work and may instead lead to failure.
months.3: Disclosing something that should remain private can cause an unfavorable development. Keep your words and actions measured. Discontent at home may send family members in different directions, adding unease. Seeking new associations may prove fruitless.
months.4: You are away from home without knowing when you will return. Affairs do not follow your intentions, making daily life burdensome. Failing to act within your circumstances may invite harm. Yet financial prospects remain, and a gain eventually arrives.
months.5: Following someone else's words can make loss difficult to avoid. Keep a cool judgment. Personal fortune is unfavorable, with a major adversity a concern. Taking everything lightly or letting your guard down can invite difficulty. Act thoughtfully in all matters.
months.6: Abandoning what is nearby to greedily pursue something distant may cost the former without fulfilling the latter. Remain within your circumstances. Financial loss or trouble involving your spouse is indicated. The traditional text associates good deeds and accumulated virtue with averting this difficulty.
months.7: The west and north offer harm without benefit and are best avoided. Seeking fish on a mountain represents effort without achievement, leaving only fatigue. The east and south are favorable, and beginning new work is described as beneficial.
months.8: Household trouble may bring sadness in the eighth lunar month, or financial loss may occur instead. Guard against theft. Crossing a river is associated with an accident, and the text advises avoiding the riverside. Affairs fail to reach completion, leaving worry on your face.
months.9: Without heaven's help, work is difficult to complete. Human helpers are absent too, leaving you uneasy as though alone between heaven and earth. An unfavorable sign at home points to concern involving your children. A scattered mind leaves little attention for other affairs and sends you rushing uncertainly.
months.10: The sun sets in the west and a mountain bird loses its way. Unfavorable fortune blocks work, leaving you to struggle alone and tire body and mind. Belongings may be lost, so guard against theft. Movement is harmful; staying home is preferable.
months.11: Unfavorable fortune brings continuing difficulty and hardship. New acquaintances offer little benefit, and seeking a gain through them may instead cause harm. Even someone close can unexpectedly hurt your interests. Take care.
months.12: Upright conduct, cultivated virtue, and sound care of the household can turn adversity into a blessing. Building a house is very unfavorable and best avoided. A new acquaintance may cause unexpected harm, so choose people carefully.

751.chongun: Life moves so quickly that you must cover three days' road in one. With many undertakings already begun, completion seems distant. Empty desire can lead you beyond your strength, making the intended result difficult. A benefactor's help, however, can allow your plans to proceed smoothly. Spring returns to an empty valley, bringing life where hope seemed exhausted. Daily life is difficult at first, then improves somewhat later. This year involves much rushing about. Take care not to become caught in the consequences of someone else's sudden accident. A bird once wounded by an arrow is startled even by a curved branch. One harmful experience may leave you afraid of unrelated matters. A small gain paired with a larger loss brings no real benefit.

months.1: Haste prevents your intention from being fulfilled, like arriving at a ferry crossing with no boat. Acting beyond your circumstances is unfavorable. Set excessive desire aside and keep to your limits. The work seems close to completion but remains unfinished, causing frustration.
months.2: Affairs do not follow your intentions, and money sought may remain unavailable. The east and south are unfavorable and best avoided. New work is also unfavorable; watch for a better opportunity. The west is favorable for seeking money and can bring a gain.
months.3: Take particular care with speech and conduct in the third lunar month. Letting words slip casually can cause harm. Avoid disputes, as official difficulties are a concern. An unwise association can cost money. Choose carefully.
months.4: Like fish finding water, you gain confidence and encounter a good development. Employment or promotion is indicated, or otherwise an unexpected gain. Favorable fortune has finally arrived, allowing affairs to follow your intentions. The west is beneficial.
months.5: Personal fortune is very favorable, with happy events accumulating. Recognition spreads your name widely. A married couple may celebrate the birth of a cherished child. Living within your circumstances adds leisure and makes daily life more peaceful.
months.6: In the sixth lunar month, affairs fail to follow your intentions, leaving little achievement and much lament. Busyness sends you in every direction, tiring the body without much income. Romantic entanglement can make your work unfavorable. Take care.
months.7: The road is long, and each stretch brings another mountain. Continuing difficulties tire body and mind. Even while doing good and avoiding wrongdoing, personal concern may arise. Yet standing up again with renewed resolve can bring fulfillment, even if late.
months.8: Indulgence in drink or sexual affairs offers no financial benefit and is best restrained. Time flows like water. Plan and carry out your work promptly to obtain benefit. Wealth is associated with the south, where seeking it can bring a gain.
months.9: Affairs proceed smoothly, and both personal and financial prospects flourish. The west is favorable for benefit. A concern involving your wife may arise, though care beforehand is described as averting it. Warm spring breezes seem to reach everywhere, bringing peace.
months.10: If there is no employment or promotion, increased property fills the household with joy. A benefactor appears and offers help, bringing abundant resources and substantial benefit. Decisively leaving the old and following the new allows something small to become a large achievement.
months.11: After enduring pain and difficulty, good fortune finally returns and brings unexpected success. Empty desire and reaching beyond your circumstances are unfavorable, so exercise restraint. Distant travel is unfavorable; staying home where possible is favorable.
months.12: Adversity and hardship finally recede in the twelfth lunar month, making room for blessings. The household is harmonious and comfortable, with abundant resources. Personal vitality and wealth bring pleasant events naturally. Indulgence in drink or sexual affairs may still cause financial loss.

752.chongun: Heaven's intention and moonlight shine straight across a great distance. Fortune opens widely, and your undertaking follows your wishes. Everyday cultivation of virtue bears fruit in many achievements. A concern involving your children may arise, but humble conduct is described as helping avert it. If there is no celebration through a child's birth, occasional worries may appear at home. This year's overall fortune is very favorable, supporting a wish held in your heart. A benefactor helps your work succeed, while strong financial prospects bring substantial wealth. Poverty comes first and abundance later, broadening the mind and nourishing the body. Recognizing and acting on a good opportunity doubles the return on effort. A helper's support adds to the gain. The traditional text recommends sincere devotion at the year's beginning to welcome this favorable fortune.

months.1: Fortune is very favorable, allowing affairs to proceed smoothly as intended. Employment or promotion is indicated, or otherwise a celebration through the birth of a cherished child. A wealth star accompanies you, helping financial aims be fulfilled.
months.2: Harmony between those above and below allows good developments to arise naturally. Personal and financial prospects are favorable, supporting success in business and abundant benefit. The outlook is broadly favorable; fire is the specific caution to observe.
months.3: Trouble at home may involve a concern about your children. Good deeds and cultivated virtue are traditionally associated with averting it. If choosing someone to keep close, the text names a person associated with Metal as the most favorable.
months.4: Spring returns to the fields, restoring life to the plants. Difficult days pass, and a good opportunity lets you put energy into work and regain vitality. The north is unfavorable and carries a concern about financial loss. Avoid it.
months.5: Unexpected recognition spreads your name widely. Distant places are favorable, and traveling far can bring money. Your undertaking proceeds as intended, financial prospects flourish, and abundance draws respect and admiration.
months.6: Time may appear to have passed without purpose, yet benefit and income lie within it, making resources plentiful. A benefactor's help allows your undertaking to succeed as intended. Rushing to plan or act, however, can bring harm instead.
months.7: Fortune opens widely and affairs follow your intentions. Financial prospects bring benefit wherever you go and abundant resources. If there is no employment or promotion, an honor for your descendants may brighten the household.
months.8: The south is favorable and may bring a good event. Your plans can reach completion quickly. Unexpected recognition provides influence and benefit, earning respect. The east is also favorable, allowing your activities to stand out and produce gains.
months.9: Your words carry authority, and a golden belt represents a high position. Your name becomes known in every direction. Like a fish swimming in the blue sea, you feel confident. Favorable fortune allows your undertakings to follow your intentions.
months.10: You rise to a high position with a friend and receive widespread praise. Work follows your intentions, and very favorable personal prospects bring repeated good events. Flowers bloom and the moon shines, an image of continuing blessings.
months.11: A fierce morning wind brings many flowers down. A sudden reversal in the eleventh lunar month may cause numerous losses. Trouble involving your children calls for care beforehand. Someone close may also contribute to a failure, so remain alert.
months.12: Happy news brings a favorable event. Wealth lies away from home and can be obtained by going out and working for it. Gains may be modest while expenses are numerous. Though good developments occur this month, thrift is advisable.

753.chongun: You cross a long river that is neither shallow nor deep. This year balances good and bad events. Warm family harmony brings a celebration and fills the home with joy. A married couple may welcome a cherished child. Gossip is the particular caution. Wealth flourishes in the south, and trade there may bring substantial money. Yet losses accompany gains this year, so take care. Building a house brings little benefit and is better postponed. As the moon wanes after becoming full, abundance naturally gives way to reduction. A flying goose holds a reed and turns from darkness toward light. The text describes wealth and honor as heaven's will and recommends an offering at the year's beginning to support your intentions.

months.1: A happy event is followed by a sad one, balancing joy and sorrow. Choose acquaintances carefully, since a poor connection can cause loss. Keep your words and conduct measured and avoid entering disputes. Gossip is a concern.
months.2: The rough road is already behind you. Worries recede and the way ahead becomes smoother. Fatigue may remain, but your undertaking can succeed. Fortunately, a benefactor helps your work proceed smoothly and may bring substantial wealth.
months.3: Thoughtless behavior invites gossip, so speak and act carefully. Following others' words may turn a favorable situation unfavorable. Observe that caution, and other affairs can follow your intentions, leaving your mind at ease.
months.4: Work reaches the result you intend. Wealth is associated with the south and can be obtained there readily. Flowers open in a garden and bees and butterflies seek their fragrance. Strong personal and financial prospects make active involvement in the undertaking beneficial.
months.5: Gains are accompanied by losses, causing distress. Discussing money with another person may begin favorably but end badly, so take care. Body and mind are unsettled, and gossip may also arise.
months.6: Staying home is favorable, while going out brings harm. A married couple may celebrate a child's birth. Yet the reading also indicates gaining first and losing later, calling for care in every matter. The east is unfavorable and best avoided.
months.7: Greed for outside wealth may instead cause financial loss. Live within your circumstances. Financial prospects flourish in the north, where a gain is possible. The west is favorable for work. Building a house is unfavorable and should be avoided in this reading.
months.8: Illness may arise but is described as passing quickly, leaving little major concern on that point. Household trouble may nevertheless affect a spouse or children. Be cautious about someone associated with the west, whose pleasing appearance may lack substance.
months.9: The right time finally arrives and favorable fortune returns, allowing work to follow your intentions. Empty desire for another person's possessions is financially unfavorable. The west, however, is favorable for seeking money and can bring a gain.
months.10: A trading journey is favorable and brings money that is likely to be needed. A good development at work may occur, making resignation inadvisable in this reading. Remaining inactive offers little benefit, while movement can bring substantial gains.
months.11: A difficult road may prevent progress despite your wish to advance. Be as thoughtful as possible in all matters to avoid an unfavorable event. Money may be gained, but illness is also indicated. Attend to your condition.
months.12: An old tree meets spring and produces flowers and thick leaves. Difficulties pass, and your work becomes smoother. Someone arriving from the west is favorable; a well-cultivated relationship can bring benefit. Financial fortune opens, revealing good within adversity.

761.chongun: One person's harm spreads to several others, leaving little place to turn with the grievance. Without care in every matter, adversity is difficult to avoid. Belongings may be lost, so guard against theft. Work appears to progress outwardly but may prove empty in substance, bringing regret without benefit. Plans and measures exist, yet do not fit the situation, causing distress. Restrained conduct and a careful, cool judgment are needed to avoid later trouble. Stirring up gulls and egrets scatters the mandarin ducks. Harm done to another person can return to you. Romantic entanglement is also described as unfavorable for your personal condition.

months.1: Your intention remains unfulfilled, leaving you distressed and unsettled. A poorly chosen association can bring harm, so select people carefully. Trouble at home points to a major difficulty or, otherwise, adversity involving your descendants.
months.2: Family discord creates turmoil at home. Going to the water is associated with financial loss and is best avoided. You may find work during this difficult period, but it does not fit your circumstances and offers little benefit.
months.3: The month is unfavorable. Work tires your body without a matching gain or achievement. Harmful schemes can bring the harm back to you. Another person may also cause difficulty. The north, however, is described as beneficial.
months.4: The year's overall outlook is unfavorable, but putting body and mind in order, cultivating virtue, and exercising restraint are favorable. Careless speech is disadvantageous. Even when something feels unjust, patience can bring a later return from that restraint.
months.5: Without moving house, concern and distress are described as difficult to avoid; a move is favorable. Choosing a good place to live allows resources to arrive naturally. Cultivating virtue, doing good, and avoiding wrongdoing eventually open a smoother course.
months.6: Work feels ill matched and does not proceed smoothly in the sixth lunar month, leaving persistent worry. Yet a fortunate star at the door offers ease within a precarious situation. Loss and distress come first, followed by a gain described as unexpected.
months.7: Travel carries a concern about illness, so attend carefully to health. A concern involving your wife calls for devotion to the household. Trusting another person may lead to sudden adversity. Handle every matter carefully.
months.8: Work is spread across two places, creating doubt, indecision, and worry. Restrained conduct and stability can nevertheless lead to success. Do not be impatient. Favorable prospects lie within a slower course, so act calmly.
months.9: Joint plans with another person can cause considerable harm. The south is favorable and may bring benefit. The traditional text associates visiting a house in mourning with illness and unfavorable events, advising distance from such visits.
months.10: Financial loss is a concern, so guard against theft. Care in every matter is needed to avert adversity this month. Even someone close may be unfavorable. Poorly chosen associations can bring unexpected harm.
months.11: You are like someone constantly on the road, facing hardship and pain that are difficult to endure. Associating with nearby acquaintances may be unfavorable and cause loss. Good fortune has not yet arrived, so new plans are disadvantageous. Observe calmly.
months.12: Careless words can entangle you in gossip. The south and north are favorable for work. Happy and sad events coexist, balancing joy and concern. Money may be lost and someone may depart, making affairs painful and difficult.

762.chongun: Responding to circumstances at the right time brings honor wherever you go. Meeting a benefactor can spread your recognition far and wide. Following another person on a distant journey is favorable in many places. A high position brings personal ease, honor, influence, and benefit, set against an image of peace in the country. Romantic or sexual involvement, however, is associated with illness. Indecision may send you wandering without a clear course. Decide firmly what you should do and move toward it. A golden crown represents official standing. Wealth and honor come with a higher position and service to someone of rank. Heaven helps the fortunate, and affairs flourish like living things under timely rain and gentle winds. The traditional text recommends an offering at the year's beginning for a favorable course.

months.1: Wealth appears wherever you go. Resources accompany you, work proceeds smoothly, and benefit follows. Recognition and official advancement can raise your position. A wealth star meets favorable conditions, suggesting abundant money.
months.2: Reputation and profit are both favorable, spreading your name and bringing substantial wealth. Fortunately meeting a good person helps your property grow. Good friends fill the home and food and drink are plentiful, an image of comfort.
months.3: A high position brings demanding work. Consider the benefit of those who work below you. Personal honor allows a wish to be fulfilled. The west and north are favorable, with flourishing financial prospects; seeking resources there can yield a gain.
months.4: Red peach blossoms in the eastern garden fall and set fruit, suggesting a celebration through a cherished child's birth or another household addition. Remain within your circumstances. Avoid insubstantial schemes.
months.5: No particular wound or injury is indicated, though considerable effort leaves the body tired. The hardship has a worthwhile return, so do not lament it. An unfavorable beginning becomes favorable later. A benefactor from the west offers unexpected help and benefit.
months.6: Gossip is plentiful in the sixth lunar month, and official trouble is a concern. Avoid disputes and arguments. The traditional text also associates romantic or sexual involvement with illness. An event may draw widespread praise while providing a name without substance.
months.7: Resources flourish and fill the household. Daily life is difficult at first, but later matters open smoothly and money arrives. Illness remains a concern, making particular attention to your health worthwhile.
months.8: A fish leaves its pond for the sea, bringing confidence and flourishing personal and financial prospects. Employment or a higher position is indicated, or otherwise a financial gain. Abundance fills the home and supports family harmony and peace.
months.9: Personal fortune opens widely, allowing affairs to follow your intentions and bringing money wherever you go. Abundant resources also strengthen the household's prospects. A wealth star accompanies you, placing substantial money in your hands and bringing joy.
months.10: With no particular personal worry, you can live peacefully in a comfortable place. Yet dealings with authorities are unfavorable, and going out may bring harm. Drinking establishments are also best avoided, as unexpected adversity is indicated there.
months.11: The spring breeze restores life to everything it touches. Good fortune returns, bringing a steadier course to work and home. Employment is indicated, or otherwise a child's birth. A move to another place is also possible.
months.12: A favorable event arises within adversity, turning a bad situation into a blessing. A poorly chosen association can still cause difficulty. The south is harmful and best avoided. New acquaintances may cause harm, so take care in all matters.

763.chongun: A flying dragon is in the sky, making it favorable to meet a person of importance. You rise to a high position and serve someone of rank. A benefactor brings personal ease. Life is comfortable, and a married couple may welcome a cherished child. Good opportunities arrive in the seventh and eighth lunar months; recognize and use them before they pass. A family celebration or a house move is indicated. Deep among flowering trees, a beautiful person calls for a companion. A destined relationship develops and brings a happy event. A favorable star helps spread your name. New leaves grow from dry wood and a decaying stump, an image of renewed life. A discerning person recognizes the time, making action favorable. The traditional text recommends sincere devotion at the year's beginning to welcome this course.

months.1: Working in a position of responsibility brings money, while trade brings profit. A benefactor arrives unexpectedly and helps work proceed smoothly, adding a financial gain. Wealth is particularly associated with the west, where seeking it can be productive.
months.2: Abundant resources bring honor to the household, and harmony makes it comfortable. Sincere effort earns support from a senior person and raises your position. Money continues to arrive, supporting personal ease and a peaceful course.
months.3: Financial prospects flourish. Do not miss this opportunity for substantial money to arrive. A good event and considerable benefit can follow. Resources fill the household alongside joy. An unexpected gain or an honor involving your children is indicated.
months.4: Wealth, influence, and benefit draw others' respect. Money is associated with the south, where seeking it can yield a substantial gain. Distant travel is beneficial. Connections with people surnamed Park and Kim are favorable and may bring good events.
months.5: The household's prospects flourish, bringing one happy event after another. Everyday cultivation of virtue and many good deeds are described as leading to further celebration. A warm, compassionate nature draws a benefactor's help naturally.
months.6: Timely rain makes every grain crop abundant. A good opportunity can bring considerable benefit if recognized and used. Yet a concern may affect you or your wife, while adversity may also involve siblings. Take particular care.
months.7: A high position and a respected name draw admiration. A benefactor from the east offers help through a chance opportunity, bringing personal peace. Staying home may feel unsettling, while going elsewhere eases your mind and brings comfort.
months.8: Your undertaking proceeds as intended and money sought can be obtained, like sailing with a favorable wind. Documents are beneficial and may bring a gain. An unexpected benefactor helps fulfill your wish. The image is of the sun high in the sky, lighting all things.
months.9: Wealth exists but is difficult to obtain. Restrained conduct and stability are favorable. The east and south are not beneficial and are best avoided. Do not start new work or join another undertaking; otherwise, concern involving your children is indicated.
months.10: Money comes first and is lost later in the tenth lunar month. Yet fortune gradually returns, and going out brings benefit. Planning and carrying out work with another person can provide a considerable gain under favorable conditions.
months.11: Your authority becomes widely known, and a higher position brings money and benefit. A wealth star accompanies you and supports financial gains. Keeping body and mind clear, cultivating virtue, doing good, and avoiding wrongdoing are associated with further celebrations.
months.12: Your name is widely respected and financial prospects flourish, drawing admiration. Personal honor and wealth leave little in the world to envy and bring peace. Failing to exercise care with someone close can nevertheless make your work unfavorable. Stay attentive in every matter.

811.chongun: The sun and moon shine brightly across the vast sky. Bees and butterflies rejoice among peach blossoms: fortune is favorable and life runs smoothly. This year resembles a country governed by a virtuous ruler and faithful ministers, bringing honor and prosperity. Your household may grow; otherwise your reputation rises and others look up to you. Trouble retreats and blessings arrive, allowing long-held wishes to take shape. Wealth accumulates and the household becomes comfortable. East and west are favorable, but south offers the strongest prospects for putting your plans into action. Your resources may rise as high as a mountain. The traditional text recommends sincere prayer at the beginning of the year for a smooth course.

months.1: Plans come together readily, bringing profit and substantial resources. Good fortune for your descendants brings harmony to the home and peaceful days for the family. Trouble leaves and blessings remain, giving you reason to rejoice.
months.2: A dragon holds a clear pearl in its mouth, an image of beautiful harmony. Wealth comes readily under favorable circumstances. Good developments and a stable livelihood may arrive without anxious scheming. Like a well that replenishes as water is drawn, putting your resources to use is favorable.
months.3: Like a yellow dragon playing in water, your efforts meet favorable conditions. Unexpected developments bring honor and happiness. A venture you have been preparing gradually finds its footing, with visible gains lifting your spirits.
months.4: Plans go well and your reputation spreads. Helping hands appear wherever you go, bringing prosperity with each step. A modest undertaking begun humbly may produce unexpectedly large rewards. Pursue your intentions carefully.
months.5: Homes appear in both east and west; the old text interprets this as acquiring a concubine. Household resources and business expand, and greater stability may turn your attention toward entertainment. Beware of a person associated with Wood, described as intending harm.
months.6: Strong fortune supports your undertakings. Even a task others consider impossible may go smoothly when you try it, as unexpectedly as finding a rabbit by the water. This is a month of bringing matters to completion and enjoying peace.
months.7: Exercising influence in many places makes you busy with numerous plans. Activity brings returns in proportion to effort this month. Sitting still and waiting for wealth would leave you regretting wasted time.
months.8: The text foretells either the birth of a son or an unexpected financial gain. Favorable connections lie especially to the north. Yet following another person’s advice, particularly that of someone close, may bring a loss.
months.9: Wealth is pictured along the road, so going out brings opportunities. Matters unfold like plants receiving rain, and results come readily. Joy appears in many places, and people welcome you wherever you go.
months.10: Wealth lies to the north. An unexpected supporter may help you gain much and fulfill a wish. The old text also advises avoiding funeral visits this month, linking the return journey to misfortune.
months.11: A fish leaves a well for the open sea and moves freely: your circumstances broaden. Divine help is pictured as making plans go smoothly. Still, take care around people close to you; an unexpected matter may lead to gossip.
months.12: A happy occasion is expected. If no such event occurs, strong financial fortune may bring a planned success or an unexpected gain. Long journeys are unfavorable, so the text advises restraint in travel.

812.chongun: Entering water without drowning and fire without injury symbolizes protection. Favorable opportunities arise through going out, with a wealth star suggesting an unexpected gain. A venture that existed only in tentative plans finally meets its moment, like rain ending a long drought. This is a fruitful year for putting plans into action. However, the text warns that romantic entanglements may bring harm. Diligence brings returns matching your effort; laziness, shortcuts and chasing empty prospects may turn a rare opportunity into trouble. Keep your intentions and conduct upright. The year’s end holds an equal mix of favorable and unfavorable influences. Sincere prayer at the start of the year is traditionally recommended for fulfilling wishes.

months.1: Nothing harmful is pictured in your path, allowing you to work in safety. An unfavorable beginning turns favorable later. Do not dwell on present difficulties: good developments follow, just as light comes after darkness.
months.2: An east wind brings abundant growth. With body and mind at ease, you finish a venture you have been developing. Unexpectedly large gains bring both a windfall and a substantial harvest from your work.
months.3: Many people are ready to help, allowing plans to reach completion. Supporters appear even where a task is too difficult alone. Set aside hesitation and carry out what you have planned; the reading favors success.
months.4: Heaven and earth are pictured as supporting your work, so matters proceed freely. However, someone close may cause significant harm if you are careless. An unexpected gain draws admiration, and earlier efforts begin to bear fruit.
months.5: A favorable period has passed and trouble approaches. Waiting for flowers after the spring wind has gone is the image of expecting an opportunity too late. The text warns of mourning or another misfortune and recommends sincere prayer for protection.
months.6: Your attention scatters and you move uncertainly without knowing what to pursue. Unfocused activity achieves little. Someone who once helped may instead cause harm, while unfavorable developments at home add to the strain. Proceed with particular care.
months.7: Drought arrives when you are already thirsty and exhausted, leaving you unsure where to turn. The traditional passage recommends prayer before the Buddha, describing sincere devotion as a way to avert trouble and obtain a small amount of relief and resources.
months.8: Trade and transactions can bring a profit. A helpful person may appear in an existing venture and lead to an unexpected gain. Starting something entirely new brings less than hoped, so favor established work.
months.9: Remaining at home offers little benefit, while going elsewhere may bring an opportunity. A short change of setting is favorable. A happy family event is interpreted in the old text as the birth of a son. Mountains and water are favorable settings for pursuing your plans.
months.10: You are busy in east and west at once, starting some tasks while finishing others. Gains and losses are evenly balanced, so avoid expecting too much. The text describes illness through the traditional image of a troublesome spirit; moderation and sound judgment are advised.
months.11: Home life is peaceful and comfortable. Business may be less successful because a useful idea is hard to find. Take care with someone you trust, since an accidental development could cause considerable loss.
months.12: Restraint and staying within your means bring benefits. Upright conduct and attention to the home foster warmth and family harmony. Descendants receive particular honor, and a small financial gain brings happiness.

813.chongun: Avoid what is unfavorable and follow what is favorable. Planting bamboo as a fence symbolizes a peaceful livelihood. The year pictures stores full of grain and resources, with relatively few difficulties. Work in every direction feels like spring, allowing plans to develop without major worries. North is favorable for seeking resources. Moving home is preferred to simply maintaining the old situation. A helpful person can resolve a difficult matter and support substantial gains. Do not become complacent: the text warns that neglect could be followed by mourning. A sincere offering or prayer at the start of the year is traditionally recommended for a smooth course.

months.1: Conditions are somewhat unfavorable. Even when you treat others kindly, someone nearby may intend harm. Avoid rushing into plans; take a step back and quietly wait for a more favorable time.
months.2: West is favorable for finding the resources and happiness you seek. A good relationship with a person associated with Fire may help your work. Cultivate harmonious connections and avoid excessive ambition. Stay within your means and aim as directly as an arrow toward its target.
months.3: Starting something new is favorable for resources and recognition. Even a modest gain may be accompanied by gossip and considerable distress. Avoid gambling in particular; the text portrays it as a pointless source of worry.
months.4: A blue dragon rises into the sky, but good conditions still require diligent effort. Idleness could instead invite trouble. Do not change occupations or pursue a different enterprise now: it may fall short of expectations or fail.
months.5: Changing occupations is discouraged. A visible short-term benefit may conceal disappointment and regret. Be cautious in all affairs, especially with money, so resources you have worked to accumulate are not scattered.
months.6: Using wealth and influence with kindness earns your neighbors’ respect. A successful outcome is possible, but it requires waiting for the right time. Rushing in may turn the opportunity into trouble.
months.7: A move is indicated. Relocating to a favorable place may bring blessings. Harmony at home helps other matters proceed smoothly. East is a favorable direction.
months.8: The old text warns of trouble for a wife if the household does not move, and therefore favors relocation. The seventh and eighth lunar months begin with difficulties and repeated worries, but become calmer later. Patience allows the right moment for progress to arrive.
months.9: A helpful person supports your work, and household resources grow. A person associated with Wood is unfavorable, while one associated with Fire is favorable for working together. Existing business proceeds relatively smoothly.
months.10: Avoid pursuing plans in the east or south. With that caution observed, a helpful person may bring favorable opportunities. Visits to drinking establishments are discouraged, as the text sees loss rather than benefit there.
months.11: You reach a river crossing but have no boat. Trying to complete everything alone feels difficult and lonely, with little progress. Endure and wait: a brighter time will come, just as spring rain melts thick river ice.
months.12: Your reputation rises and others treat you with respect, making daily life pleasant. Yet the text warns strongly against romantic entanglements that could damage your household and work. An unexpected helper may keep practical matters moving reasonably well.

821.chongun: Riding both a dragon and a tiger symbolizes constant change. Digging a well and finding water suggests benefit after hard work. The passage first describes an unfavorable year with sharp fluctuations, then pictures a bamboo fence, peaceful living and stores full of grain and resources. These mixed images are both present in the source. Work in many directions brings the joy of spring, and a helpful person may resolve difficult matters. The latter half of the year is especially favorable for honor or office. However, alcohol and sexual indulgence may undo hard-won achievements. Protect your home and act with integrity. The traditional text recommends sincere observance at the year’s beginning to welcome favorable fortune.

months.1: With grain abundant, others share in your prosperity. Family harmony makes even difficult tasks possible. A helpful person may appear in the first lunar month, making this a relatively favorable period. Be generous in sharing what you have.
months.2: A passing blessing unexpectedly settles on your home. Resources arrive from several places, allowing comfort and peace of mind. Your surroundings feel as bright as a flower garden in a warm breeze.
months.3: Honor long awaited finally arrives. Your standing rises and others look up to you. The traditional image is of receiving an official position and authority over many people.
months.4: Fortune is fairly good, but coveting what belongs to others brings no benefit. Your own resources can provide enough comfort. Legal or official difficulties are indicated, so avoid quarrels and check even apparently safe situations carefully.
months.5: Conditions turn unfavorable, and tasks that seem close to resolution are repeatedly delayed. Private worries drive you out of the house, yet no destination offers relief. Closeness to others may bring harm; quietly weathering the difficult period is favored.
months.6: Long-awaited blessings arrive. Favorable developments bring distinction to your children or honor and recognition to you. Like a fish in the open sea, you feel free and confident. Timely rain makes the forest flourish.
months.7: You reach a ferry crossing without a boat and feel frustrated by your circumstances. Be careful around people close to you. Moving home is favored; if that is impractical, the text suggests a temporary journey farther away. Blessings are pictured outside your usual surroundings.
months.8: The text warns of illness or worry involving a sibling or the household. If not there, concern may involve your mother. It describes a particularly unfavorable month, with mourning also mentioned as a possibility.
months.9: Trouble retreats and a freer, more favorable period begins. A person associated with Metal may become a helpful partner, supporting your work and increasing household resources. The family may also gain a new member.
months.10: Your existing undertaking is expected to succeed, so avoid changing occupations or abandoning it halfway through. Substantial gains may come soon. Going out is favorable, especially toward the east, where a useful connection is indicated.
months.11: A change of occupation or a new venture may bring greater resources. A dragon flies in the sky as clouds of trouble disperse and rain-like blessings arrive. Look toward a larger outcome while maintaining restraint.
months.12: Staying home without action brings little benefit. Going out and working diligently helps you obtain what you seek. However, alcohol and romantic entanglements may waste earlier efforts and disrupt a rare favorable opportunity.

822.chongun: As three rising yang energies gradually gather, living things flourish. Clouds part to reveal the moon, bringing happiness. A small loss is followed by a larger gain, so an unfavorable beginning turns favorable. Abundant grain and a comfortable household ease worries. This is described as a year of accumulating resources: make use of timely opportunities. More undertakings succeed than fail. Yet greater resources also bring expenses and opportunities to help others. Give generously rather than begrudging what is spent. Kindness offered to others is pictured as returning severalfold in time. The traditional text recommends sincere prayer at the start of the year for a smooth course.

months.1: Very favorable conditions allow plans to proceed smoothly. The image is of holding great wealth in your hands and succeeding in your undertakings. Harmony between those above and below you brings peace. If financial gain is not the outcome, personal honor is favored instead.
months.2: Honest intentions and sincere effort bring results. You humbly seek a small gain but may achieve something much larger, accumulating resources and joy. The household may gain a member. One seed produces many fruits.
months.3: A helpful person makes a difficult undertaking easier to complete. Working with someone associated with Wood is favorable for substantial gains and prosperity. Good developments involving your children add to your happiness and resources.
months.4: Household fortune is favorable, and matters come together naturally. South is the direction associated with resources. Going there may increase the household’s means and deepen its sense of peace and warmth.
months.5: Finding green woodland on a snow-covered mountain symbolizes an unexpected blessing. Your affairs flourish, and even generous giving leaves enough for you. The traditional text attributes this to divine assistance and recommends grateful prayer.
months.6: Spring blossoms and autumn fruit each find their season. Several undertakings can succeed at once and bring benefits, so the reading encourages action. Honor or office may arrive; otherwise a descendant has good news. Put your plans forward without fear.
months.7: Your name becomes widely known, and good health supports efforts to obtain resources in several places. Yin and yang harmonize, with blessings pictured as arriving from all directions even while you rest. Cultivating kindness helps this favorable period endure.
months.8: Working ordinary sand into gold and jewels symbolizes valuable returns from a small task. Smooth progress brings harmony and a happy occasion at home. If no family celebration occurs, however, the text warns of gossip instead.
months.9: Resources arrive like a gift from heaven, leaving the household content and living together without quarrels. Remain humble rather than proud or overexcited. The reading also advises against readily following others’ words.
months.10: Life is peaceful and resources come readily. You offer something small expecting a small exchange, but receive something larger. Plans reach completion and a long-held wish may be fulfilled, making ordinary life feel beautiful.
months.11: Quiet, peaceful days still bring steady progress. Completed plans fill the home with warmth and happiness. Like an old tree sprouting again in spring, something dormant revives. Continue treating others with kindness.
months.12: Trouble withdraws and blessings fill the home, turning misfortune into benefit. Opportunities to accumulate resources become numerous. Working with people from the west is favorable and may bring several unexpected results.

823.chongun: Frost falls and leaves return to their roots, an image of someone returning home with success and honor. The opening verse refers to autumn, while the following sentence says frost in the third month; the source preserves both images. Wealth and recognition are favored this year, but rash conduct could turn favorable circumstances into loss. Keep steady and stay within your means, since one careless act could undo an unexpected gain. The beginning is difficult and the later period more favorable. Wait humbly for the right moment: this is the image of a goal achieved after ten years of patience, with renewed energy and many matters finally resolved. The traditional text recommends sincere observance at the beginning of the year to preserve these blessings.

months.1: Divine assistance is pictured as bringing repeated happy developments. Yet sitting at home waiting for blessings is unwise: go out and find work to do. Your plans can eventually succeed. Be careful, however, because someone close may cause harm.
months.2: A helpful person assists you, and an unexpected development brings resources. With the household comfortable and peaceful, family members enjoy their good circumstances. Guard against pride to make the most of this favorable period.
months.3: Rain falls on crops preparing to ripen. Visible prospects of profit and a harvest encourage diligent work. Conditions favor the result you have been expecting; proceed with conviction rather than doubt.
months.4: A wealth star follows you, with the image of gathering considerable resources even at rest. Prosperity allows a triumphant homecoming, making earlier worries seem distant. Be cautious of a person associated with Metal, from whom the text expects harm rather than benefit. Look deeply, as one can see pebbles at the bottom of a clear well.
months.5: An accidental development brings an unexpected financial gain. Yet an unfavorable influence accompanies the good fortune, and mourning is mentioned. The traditional text recommends sincere prayer at a renowned mountain to avert trouble.
months.6: Many matters are favorable and resources grow, but worries may interrupt the good period. A quarrel with a close acquaintance is indicated, along with concern for a wife, possibly involving illness and bed rest. The traditional passage recommends prayer beforehand for protection.
months.7: Family members unite around one purpose, allowing plans to succeed. However, people associated with Wood or Metal are described as unfavorable companions. Careful conduct helps the month proceed reasonably smoothly.
months.8: Working with a helpful person may bring several times the benefit of working alone. Give special attention to cultivating relationships. Financial opportunities can increase household resources, making this a joyful and prosperous month.
months.9: An unexpected source of income multiplies your happiness. A helpful person may support recognition or office. Yet official or legal trouble is also indicated, so avoid rash behavior and long journeys that might disrupt the favorable course.
months.10: A boat sails on calm water with a favorable wind: plans proceed steadily. Going out offers financial opportunities, so frequent activity outside the home is preferred to staying in. A good opportunity and an unexpected gain may follow.
months.11: Unexpected success spreads your name and brings abundant resources, pictured as gold and jade. Others look up to you and offer support. You may enjoy gains that arrive without having to pursue each one actively.
months.12: You sit peacefully in a fine house, comfortably considering your resources. Further wealth or the birth of a son is indicated. Joy grows and worries feel distant, though concerns involving your parents still deserve attention.

831.chongun: Entering the mountains to cultivate the Way reveals your original nature. A phoenix settling in a paulownia tree symbolizes a succession of happy events. Helpful people enable you to accomplish even what you could not manage alone. The year is generally favorable, with marriage especially associated with blessings; a good match is worth considering. Staying home is favored over going out, so work with your family toward a peaceful life. The year is pictured as receiving abundant blessings from heaven, sailing smoothly with a favorable wind and gathering plentiful resources. As an extra precaution, the traditional text recommends sincere prayer at the beginning of the year.

months.1: Many matters go as you wish, leaving no reason to envy another person’s resources. A substantial achievement brings deep happiness. Financial prospects are favorable, though even good developments can attract gossip. Be careful with what is said.
months.2: A favorable star assists you, allowing completion of work you once abandoned as impossible alone. Conditions support progress without strain. Stay calm and settled, and matters can proceed as intended.
months.3: Moving east or west is favorable. Like a red peach blossom alone in the spring light on a southern mountain, your work stands out and reaches a good outcome. Avoid disputes, gossip and conduct that strays from what is right.
months.4: A wealth star supports you in obtaining what you seek. Take courage and concentrate your effort: both circumstances and the purpose of your work favor completion. However, the text advises against working in partnership this month.
months.5: A mouse moves freely through a winter storehouse, symbolizing comfort and ready access to resources. Matters around you go as intended, and unexpected gains allow a peaceful rest. With body and mind at ease, the world feels pleasant.
months.6: Seeking a small result brings several times the return, multiplying your joy. Your reputation and influence spread, and many people greet you with respect. Further cultivation of your character draws others to you.
