months.7: Trouble enters a favorable situation, so an apparent gain may end in loss. Turning away from the light toward darkness symbolizes repeated obstacles. If matters do not unfold this way, the text warns of a possible fire and advises care with flames.
months.8: Cloud-like trouble withdraws and favorable conditions arrive. Bees gathering over flowers in a spring garden symbolize opportunity. Do not covet what belongs to someone else, or you may lose your own resources and regret it.
months.9: A bird loses its way and circles high in the sky without direction. Financial loss and people leaving your side may make you feel unsettled. Do not give up because of hardship; the passage says favorable circumstances eventually return.
months.10: A helpful person restores peace to your life. With resources available, your undertakings produce results and a taste of success. Like fish and dragons finding water, you feel confident and well placed. The month is broadly favorable.
months.11: Travel is unfavorable. Preserve existing work and remain steady; rash action may otherwise expose you to an unexpected mishap. Stay within your means. The text also mentions a startling incident involving water or fire.
months.12: Meeting a helpful person may usher in a peaceful period. People surnamed Lee or Park are singled out as potential supporters, so cultivate relationships sincerely. Conditions are favorable overall, but gossip still calls for care.

832.chongun: Fishing in a pond brings golden-scaled fish day after day. Like an old tree meeting spring, long-held intentions finally bear fruit. A rare favorable turn is associated with the birth of a son and family celebration. Unexpected resources bring comfort, and further gains help sustain happy, peaceful days. South is favorable for success, while north is unfavorable for travel. Even amid financial abundance, remain humble: others will value and support you. Respect from people and plentiful resources make this a year with little cause for envy. The traditional passage recommends sincere prayer at the year’s beginning to preserve its favorable course.

months.1: Peach trees in an eastern garden blossom in their season, signaling good fortune. The text foretells a marriage or, alternatively, the birth of a son. Unexpected blessings allow your work to exceed expectations and bring widespread happiness.
months.2: Small gains accumulate into something substantial, and many matters proceed smoothly. Trouble disappears while blessings arrive from different directions; resources stay with you. A person associated with Metal is especially favorable as a working partner.
months.3: Spiritual assistance is pictured as helping plans and wishes come true. Unexpected resources begin a period of prosperity and recognition. Meeting someone associated with Wood is beneficial. Do not neglect care and respect for your parents.
months.4: Even with abundant resources, concern for a descendant may make it difficult to enjoy your prosperity. Private worries weigh on you. The traditional passage recommends prayer at a renowned mountain to overcome the difficulty.
months.5: An unexpected honorable deed earns praise for your kindness. Remaining settled is favorable, while impulsive movement is not. Wait calmly in one place: your roots have already taken hold in the ground.
months.6: People surnamed Jeong and Kim may unexpectedly offer help. Their support enables plans to succeed and may bring influence and a wider reputation. Favorable prospects lift your confidence and motivation, like spring warmth awakening new shoots.
months.7: A wealth star signals incoming resources. Someone met by chance joins your efforts and helps fulfill a long-held wish. Income may increase, and the home is also associated with a happy event.
months.8: Kind intentions, upright conduct and unselfish dealings build merit. Fair and honest words and actions are pictured as drawing blessings, with resources as large as a mountain. Choose a clear and honorable path.
months.9: Favorable circumstances bring good developments wherever you go, with few obstructions. Resources accumulate, and results may exceed what you planned. Family harmony and the arrival of a cherished descendant add to the blessings.
months.10: Trying to profit through greed or deception may instead bring serious harm. Keep your intentions honest. Personal worries and disputes make the month somewhat unfavorable. Avoid close dealings with a person associated with Wood, as another person may leave your efforts empty.
months.11: What first looks like a gain may prove a loss on reflection. Romantic entanglements are particularly associated with trouble and financial loss. Do not lose heart: a more favorable period follows the current difficulty. Wait for its time.
months.12: Favorable household fortune restores peace of mind. You recover your smile and enjoy a calmer, more leisurely life. Repeated happy developments accompany days of physical and mental wellbeing.

833.chongun: Within stillness lies an unusual richness. Quiet living is associated with honor or the birth of a cherished child, while patient waiting brings peace. Helpful people support one another like a warm spring breeze. Recognition or the birth of a son makes this a comfortable year. Life is described as plentiful and unhurried, with the latter part better than the beginning. Staying settled in one place is favorable; rash conduct or reaching beyond your means may cause harm. Even a dangerous situation can yield a calmer position. Initial difficulties give way to comfort, and the year’s end brings personal honor and a more prosperous household. The traditional text recommends humble, sincere observance at the year’s beginning.

months.1: The first month is somewhat unfavorable, so comfort lies in restraint and staying within your means. Rash movement or travel may lead toward trouble. Act carefully in all matters.
months.2: A helpful person may bring resources and recognition. If that does not occur, the text instead suggests the birth of a cherished child. If neither favorable outcome appears, it warns that the circumstances could turn toward gossip.
months.3: Digging into the earth and finding gold symbolizes a substantial gain. East and south are both favorable directions for resources. Personal honor is also indicated, leaving little more to wish for.
months.4: Past kindness brings a considerable blessing. Alternatively, a happy event involving a descendant brings repeated joy. Resources are favored, so make use of the opportunity. Many undertakings can reach completion.
months.5: Quarrels or careless travel may reverse your fortunes. Disputes attract gossip, while a startling incident on the road may cause harm. Trade and transactions are favorable for resources this month, but long journeys are discouraged.
months.6: The month is not especially favorable. Harm from someone close may leave you disillusioned about placing trust in them. Choose relationships carefully and consider even casual remarks before speaking.
months.7: Resources follow you, suggesting a substantial gain. Taking the opportunity to act generously earns widespread praise. Favorable conditions make your aims easier to achieve. Remain honest even when no one is watching.
months.8: A hungry person encounters a rich harvest and finally has enough. Yet concern involving a wife may make it hard to enjoy the improved circumstances. Be especially careful with close acquaintances, since trouble is pictured nearby.
months.9: Plans pursued solely from home are unlikely to advance. Going out and taking action is favored for reaching your aims. Choose partners carefully, however; working indiscriminately with others may lead to a serious financial loss.
months.10: You may appear prosperous while privately struggling with limited resources. Do not readily follow others’ advice, which could exhaust hard-earned savings. Gossip is also indicated. Act cautiously and keep away from disputes.
months.11: A blue dragon finally finds water, allowing an undertaking to succeed. Meeting a helpful person may bring recognition and a stronger reputation. Avoid haste: a later result is preferable to forcing an early one.
months.12: Seeking peace amid difficulty suggests that an initial loss can be followed by gain. Someone close may envy you over an insignificant matter, so do not speak carelessly merely because you trust them. Stability and restraint remain favorable; avoid rash behavior.

841.chongun: A busy, uncertain life struggles to find rest. Flowers fall and spring disappears, leaving a sense of having lost the way. The early part of the year is somewhat unfavorable, with setbacks and sadness. Staying home brings little benefit, while going out may ease your mind and offer useful work. Keep making sincere, diligent efforts. A helpful person may gradually clear what has been blocked. As circumstances improve, body and mind feel more at ease around the seventh and eighth lunar months. Some resources arrive, but frequent expenses make them hard to retain. Toward the year’s end, a favorable star is pictured as dispersing worries and allowing a long-held intention to be fulfilled.

months.1: A business may be active without producing income, making a comfortable livelihood difficult. You hurry east and west looking for resources but fail to obtain what you intended. Unfulfilled effort may leave you discouraged.
months.2: Hardship away from home brings loneliness, while unfavorable circumstances obstruct your efforts. The text also describes losing a prospective marriage partner and feeling the emptiness of life. Romantic involvement is discouraged this month because it may lead to regret.
months.3: Several undertakings remain unresolved, making you anxious and low in spirits. Even money that arrives may pass straight through rather than becoming lasting savings. Effort can therefore feel empty.
months.4: There is a beginning without an ending, like a passing cloud. Home may be peaceful while you personally struggle, making resources difficult to accumulate. A person associated with Metal can offer temporary relief, though not lasting ease. Continue sincerely, trusting that spring follows winter.
months.5: The outlook is dark, pictured as lamenting difficult circumstances beneath a dim inn lamp. The text warns either of financial loss or of trouble concerning a descendant. It traditionally recommends prayer beforehand to avert misfortune.
months.6: A helpful person appears, improving prospects and allowing plans to succeed. Documents or writing may bring welcome news and income. Resources are limited at first but arrive later, so patience is favored.
months.7: A wealth star links resources to writing or literary work. Going out is more favorable than staying home. An unexpected gain or the birth of a cherished son is indicated. Conduct yourself uprightly and take part in good deeds; scattered household resources may come together again.
months.8: Favorable circumstances help you carry out a plan. A large gain is difficult, but a smaller one is possible even amid obstacles. Meeting someone surnamed Lee may bring a modest benefit.
months.9: Home feels unsettling, while going out offers benefits. West and south are favorable for resources and good developments. Seek a modest result rather than an ambitious one: even a long journey begins with a single step.
months.10: Life is peaceful but may feel unproductive. Resources do not arrive in proportion to the effort spent. Restraint and steadiness maintain the calm, while abandoning what is right may invite trouble. Keep this in mind as you act.
months.11: An undertaking may bring losses without completion, leaving you disappointed. Long journeys are discouraged because avoiding loss may be difficult. Drinking establishments are linked to financial loss and gossip; the text advises caution around indulgence.
months.12: Unfavorable financial circumstances unsettle the household. Trying to force a quick result achieves little. Staying home is favored over going out to start something, and the text warns of possible loss of resources.

842.chongun: Gathering firewood and drinking water contains its own happiness. Farming is favored while trade is not, suggesting contentment through modest living in a quiet place. Keep a clear heart, avoid wrongdoing and cultivate yourself as one would cultivate the Way; abundance may follow. Meeting a helpful person can bring good developments and completion of plans. This year favors calm restraint over expanding business. Long journeys are unfavorable, so remaining in one place is associated with eventual comfort and progress. The year’s end is favorable and pictures plentiful resources. Use sound judgment when pursuing a task. The traditional text recommends sincere observance at the beginning of the year to preserve good fortune.

months.1: A dry tree meets spring and returns to life. Many matters proceed smoothly, allowing a wish to be fulfilled and household resources to grow. An unexpected gain or an unanticipated new household member is indicated.
months.2: Stay within your means and avoid excessive desires. Modesty itself brings benefits, and resources may come without strenuous pursuit. Blessings are pictured as quietly entering from many directions, like flowers filling a spring garden.
months.3: Setting aside worldly greed and living quietly brings satisfaction and worthwhile results. Sincere, diligent attention to your work is pictured as drawing blessings and realizing a dream. A helpful person may appear this month.
months.4: Cooperation between spouses helps a tiring, complicated undertaking proceed more smoothly. Honor or office may spread your name. People show respect for the kindness you have practiced. Continue treating everyone with humility.
months.5: After a difficult journey to cross a river, you find no boat waiting. The disappointment resembles a strenuous climb up a mountain. A disturbed household spirit is the traditional image for worry at home; moving is described as a way to leave that trouble behind and meet a better period.
months.6: Financial conditions are unfavorable. An apparent early gain may turn into a later loss, and undertakings can falter. Be careful with a person associated with Metal. Meeting a helpful person, however, may change the course toward a more favorable outcome.
months.7: Worries withdraw and peace returns. Resources or land may be acquired, with enough food and clothing and a wish fulfilled. East and north are favorable for good developments and financial gains. Putting your intentions into action resembles a crane flying toward you.
months.8: Plentiful resources settle the household, allowing family members to live without complaints. A happy event involving a descendant adds to the joy. Unexpected success may bring a windfall. The text pictures an honored seat waiting for you.
months.9: Honesty and generosity are recognized as past merit and returned as blessings. Trouble leaves, allowing a peaceful life in comfortable surroundings. The text offers either a small household concern or, in its absence, honor or office.
months.10: A small household worry may concern a wife. It is described as limited rather than a major calamity. However, romantic entanglements call for particular caution, since an unusual incident may cause distress.
months.11: Marriage or the birth of a son is indicated. Financial prospects are generally favorable, but relationships may bring an unnecessary controversy and gossip. Be especially cautious with people close to you and avoid readily following others’ words.
months.12: Resources and grain fill the stores, with welcome developments in many places. Numerous people become helpful allies, supporting your aims and clearing obstacles. The image is of catching a fish that is also full of roe: a gain carries further promise.

843.chongun: A person with a meaningful connection arrives unexpectedly to help. A dragon opens heaven’s gate, clouds part and rain falls. South and north are favorable this year, and helpful people may enable your wishes to take shape. Yet losses may match gains; fortune contains both. The traditional text recommends prayer at a renowned mountain to avert trouble. Conditions improve as the year progresses, and action can bring returns. Supporters gather like clouds, returning kindness you have previously shown. Resources can be obtained, but they become lasting reserves only when sought with restraint and integrity. Sincere prayer at the year’s beginning is traditionally considered favorable.

months.1: Very favorable circumstances support many undertakings. A helpful person appears, enabling substantial progress even without strenuous action. You may find a practical benefit within something that initially seems empty or unpromising.
months.2: Living uprightly within your present circumstances brings happiness. South is favorable for a successful venture. However, harmony between spouses is strained this month and deserves particular attention.
months.3: Rich dew falls from heaven and sweet springs emerge from the earth. Abundant grain symbolizes enough food and clothing. A helpful person consistently supports you, allowing business to proceed without major difficulty.
months.4: Preserving established work and remaining steady brings benefits. Changing occupations or starting a new venture because of another person’s words may instead cause harm. Set aside unrealistic desires and do your best with the situation you have.
months.5: Favorable circumstances bring peace to the home. Spiritual help is pictured as placing resources within reach and allowing a wish to be fulfilled. Marriage or an unexpected financial gain is indicated, with lasting comfort like fragrant grass moving in a spring breeze.
months.6: Resources increase, arriving from several places and allowing a satisfying position without excessive striving. Like a cow grazing quietly beside a green riverbank, life feels peaceful and unhurried. A warm atmosphere remains around you.
months.7: Your name spreads widely, and honor or office brings people who respect and follow you. Accumulating resources and gaining influence create a prosperous situation with little cause for envy.
months.8: Avoid excessive desires, which may turn a favorable situation into trouble. The traditional passage recommends sincere prayer at a renowned mountain for protection. Risks are pictured nearby this month, so approach every matter calmly.
months.9: A warm spring breeze brings good news from many directions, and fulfilling a wish lifts your spirits. If financial gain does not arrive, a happy event involving a descendant is offered instead. Unexpected resources may also substantially increase the household’s means.
months.10: Do not become angry at an initial loss; a greater gain may follow soon. A helpful person appears, supporting success. With sincere effort, the text describes this as the year’s strongest month for achievement: what you sow shapes what you reap.
months.11: While walking in deep darkness, you unexpectedly find a candle. Favorable financial circumstances support smooth progress and a substantial gain. The traditional image is of a blessing from heaven that no one can easily obstruct.
months.12: Do not reach beyond your means; doing so is unfavorable. Be careful with a person associated with Wood, since a joint undertaking may cause a loss followed by regret. Restraint and humble conduct leave room for blessings.

851.chongun: Divided intentions leave affairs unsettled, like drifting clouds. The opening phrase is unclear in the source, but the passage describes a year with frequent obstacles and the possibility of difficult personal events. Be careful, stay within your means and act uprightly; rash conduct may leave considerable regret. Even adversity contains something to learn. Private worries may persist, while disagreements at home make plans difficult to complete. Clouds covering the sun symbolize blocked blessings and a lack of harmony between yin and yang. With circumstances generally unfavorable, the text discourages beginning new undertakings this year.

months.1: Your mind is busy, rushing east and then west, yet plans fail to take shape. The effort resembles chasing clouds. Home feels unsettling, but going out produces little benefit either.
months.2: You want to fly high but resemble a bird that has lost its wings. Be careful in all matters, especially with gossip. Someone close is pictured as hiding a blade behind a smile, so do not assume friendliness guarantees good intentions.
months.3: Trouble withdraws and favorable circumstances gradually return, bringing prosperity and recognition. Remaining settled and within your means supports a peaceful home. Avoid starting something carelessly. An initially difficult situation may become comfortable later.
months.4: Dark troubles retreat and blessings arrive. Peaceful circumstances and improving financial prospects support your plans and daily gains. As resources accumulate, harmony and warmth follow naturally.
months.5: A disturbed household spirit is the traditional image for repeated illness. Alternatively, a dispute may lead to litigation. Unfavorable conditions suggest either concern for a descendant or difficulty avoiding financial loss.
months.6: Keep away from disputes and gossip. Alcohol and sexual indulgence are described as threats to household stability and reputation. Avoid greed and coveting others’ possessions. Work instead on your own conduct and on cultivating a worthwhile life.
months.7: Waiting for gain without making an effort achieves little. Sincere attention to your work creates room for benefit, while chasing vague hopes does not. West is favorable for a useful development.
months.8: Remaining settled in one place is favored, while careless movement may bring harm. The text pictures danger while crossing a river and traditionally recommends sincere prayer to the water deity for protection and relief from misfortune.
months.9: A bird injures its wing and cannot take flight. Early financial prospects may seem favorable but lead to regret later. Be cautious around people close to you, as an unexpected incident may cause harm.
months.10: Trying to begin a long voyage in shallow water brings labor without benefit. Resources do not accumulate, and a distracted mind struggles to complete anything. Choose relationships carefully to avoid a considerable loss.
months.11: The opening autumn image is unclear in the source, but conveys sadness. The text warns of personal illness or, alternatively, mourning. Help from a person associated with Metal may nevertheless allow a plan to succeed and bring unexpected resources.
months.12: Favorable circumstances finally arrive, displacing trouble with blessings. The Traveling Horse at the gate suggests movement toward the northwest. An unexpected success brings resources you had not sought. Maintain harmony with relatives: cultivating relationships is described as the most important kind of cultivation.

852.chongun: Entering a mountain gate, you go unrecognized, as though isolated in a silent world with nowhere to lean. Life feels dreamlike and beyond your control. This year is described as personally difficult, with household worries adding to the burden. You may feel that constant solitary effort merely keeps you going, while attempts to advance do not find the right connection. East is associated with someone intending harm, so the text advises avoiding that direction and remaining within your means. Do not join disputes or take sides in another person’s quarrel, since an accidental involvement may bring legal trouble. The year is busy with little profit; the traditional passage recommends prayer for relief from adversity.

months.1: Conditions support smooth work and incoming resources. However, be cautious of a person associated with Metal: assuming they share your intentions may lead to harm and regret. Mountains and water are favorable settings this month.
months.2: Turning away from wrongdoing and putting effort into good deeds brings benefit and eventual progress. Do not resent hardship. A more peaceful life can come in time; patience and sincerity may bring welcome news.
months.3: Going west may bring a helpful person and a favorable setting for work. Financial conditions remain somewhat weak, with perhaps half of a gain slipping away. Quietly staying in an unhurried place is also described as beneficial.
months.4: A long journey is indicated, but wandering carelessly after leaving home may bring loss. South is unfavorable for completing plans. Avoid impulsive action and wait quietly. Meet unexpected events with a steady mind.
months.5: Settle your attention on one task and you may achieve what you intended. An unexpected success brings happiness and helps an existing plan reach completion. A wealth star follows you, so make use of the moment.
months.6: What starts well may become unfavorable later, so act carefully. Avoid the east, where harm is pictured. Your personal circumstances are relatively calm, but projects and financial prospects are less favorable; moderate expectations are advised.
months.7: Choosing a suitable place to move may help leave trouble behind. Do not look down on others because circumstances improve; contempt may bring harm back to you. Remaining modest and attentive to home is also associated with blessings, in proportion to sincere effort.
months.8: A hungry person encounters a rich harvest. A rare opportunity helps fulfill your expectations. Sexual misconduct may turn this favorable situation into trouble, so keep your intentions and conduct clear and focus on your work.
months.9: An old tree meets spring. A happy occasion restores harmony to a quiet home and gives the family something to enjoy. However, close dealings with a person associated with Wood are described as harmful, so proceed carefully.
months.10: Financial matters go well, but concern for a descendant keeps worries alive. The text also mentions illness affecting either you or a wife, unsettling the household. It traditionally recommends sincere prayer in response to these difficulties.
months.11: You work toward an apparently achievable result, yet things refuse to unfold as expected. An accidental involvement may bring gossip and distress. Conditions are described as gradually improving after this month, so allow time for the change.
months.12: Long-awaited financial prospects arrive and trouble recedes. A helpful person may bring good developments, with resources coming from several directions without strenuous pursuit. Household comfort and peace of mind increase. Remember the difficult period and remain grateful.

853.chongun: Entering a mountain to capture a tiger places life in uncertain danger. Clouds obscure the sun, making a favorable outlook hard to expect. Do not reach beyond your means this year, as the text sees loss rather than benefit in excessive ambition. Rash movement is also unfavorable; staying settled and waiting is preferred even when progress is frustrating. Avoid involvement in official or legal disputes, where an accidental connection could bring serious trouble. Home feels unsettling, but outside you may feel alone with nowhere to go. The year resembles plants withering after three years of drought, full of frustration and disappointment. Amid these difficulties, however, the passage also describes a welcome romantic connection.

months.1: Favorable household circumstances provide warmth and stability, renewing your courage. A helpful star is associated with honor or office. Yet reaching beyond your means may cause harm. Upright conduct and restraint are the favorable course.
months.2: Conditions are unfavorable, so avoid official or legal disputes and remain quiet. An encouraging beginning may deteriorate, leaving matters started but unfinished. The passage describes few joyful developments this month.
months.3: A wealth star supports efforts to obtain resources. However, the text warns either of concern for a wife or personal illness. Be especially careful with someone close, since an unexpected incident may cause harm.
months.4: You begin with a clear intention but lack the means to bring the work to completion. Staying home feels unfavorable, while going out leaves you uncertain where to turn. Even so, some modest benefit is associated with outside activity.
months.5: Meeting a tiger in the mountains leaves you unable to advance or retreat. Spiritual assistance is pictured as rescuing you from danger. Starting a new undertaking is discouraged: maintaining existing work is preferable to risking loss. Remain careful and quietly observe.
months.6: An unexpected honorable development brings joy to the household. A person associated with Fire may become a beneficial connection and help complete your plans. Concern involving a descendant is mentioned, but the text describes its consequences as limited.
months.7: A traveler loses the mountain path and wanders alone. Hurrying east and west produces little return, while sadness weighs on the mind. Each mountain seems to reveal another beyond it, prolonging the strain.
months.8: A visitor loses the way in green mountains, symbolizing an unexpected mishap. The traditional passage recommends prayer to the mountain deity. Avoid official or legal disputes; another person’s affairs may cost you resources and cause considerable harm. An unsettled mind adds to the difficulty.
months.9: An anxious mind cannot settle to work, and days drift like clouds. The text warns of financial loss or another misfortune. Avoid reaching beyond your means, which may activate further loss.
months.10: Do not begin something new. Effort spent forcing an unsatisfactory task yields little. A person associated with Metal and the western direction are both unfavorable. Keep away from disputes and gossip. Patience is described as the best source of relief this month.
months.11: Sitting alone by a quiet window, you may dwell on difficult circumstances. An unsettled body and mind make smooth progress difficult. Do not quarrel; even when you feel wronged, restraint and patience are described as beneficial.
months.12: Heavenly help is pictured as gradually removing trouble and suffering. A wealth star brings unexpected resources and eventual prosperity. Alternatively, the text mentions concern for a descendant. It traditionally recommends prayer to avert that adversity.

861.chongun: A traveler hurries home as the sun sets. A project pursued for ten years seems close yet remains unfinished, bringing frustration. Early circumstances are unfavorable, like losing your horse just as you set out on a long journey. Yet later progress is possible, so wait calmly for the right time. The year may bring household worry or personal illness. Happiness and concern alternate. Of three traveling companions, one cannot be trusted; the image is of being told to catch a dog while chasing a chicken. Unfavorable influences make new plans difficult. Reduce excessive desires and try to be content with what you already hold.

months.1: You are busy in every direction but achieve little. Numerous tasks and persistent effort do not bring the hoped-for return, so avoid expecting a large gain. Changing occupations or beginning a new enterprise is discouraged.
months.2: Thunder sounds across a hundred miles yet has no visible form: much noise produces little substance. Even if resources fail to accumulate, remain settled and within your means. No particular calamity is indicated. Care with close acquaintances and attention to existing work can make this an ordinary month.
months.3: The third month’s east wind brings happiness. If no personal good development occurs, a celebration involving a descendant is offered instead. Unexpected resources may make the household more comfortable.
months.4: East is favorable for resources and south for happy developments. A celebration that gives you good news to share, or alternatively an unexpected gain, is indicated. Financial prospects are favorable, but gossip still calls for care.
months.5: Family tensions bring raised voices and arguments. The text describes a possible split between siblings or a break with a close neighbor. Bringing an existing undertaking to a close is favored.
months.6: Conditions become unfavorable, and misplaced expectations may only hurt your feelings. Busy movement in every direction fails to bring the resources you seek. Be cautious of a person in the west, who is described as a source of harm.
months.7: Avoid drinking establishments, where the text sees wasted resources and damaged reputation. Unfavorable circumstances also call for care against theft. Excessive closeness and unquestioning trust in a familiar person may cause harm; maintain an appropriate distance.
months.8: Although financial prospects seem strong and you obtain what you seek, losses may exceed the amount collected. A troublesome spirit is the traditional image for repeated obstacles. Romantic entanglements are especially discouraged as a source of serious trouble.
months.9: Effort is present, but the means to complete your plans are insufficient. Frustration may leave you grieving alone. Unease between spouses adds to household worries, making the month emotionally difficult.
months.10: Private worries weigh heavily, and others may struggle to relieve them. The text also describes lingering illness or physical discomfort. A person associated with Wood may nevertheless bring an unexpected financial benefit and a welcome connection.
months.11: Renovating an old house symbolizes improvement arriving late. The source points to a helper from the west, though its directional wording is irregular. A major problem may still place you in difficulty; an inventive solution is needed to avoid a prolonged impasse.
months.12: Financially, little comes in while much goes out, leaving limited substance. Concern may involve a descendant or a wife. An unexpected gain is also possible, so remain attentive to an opportunity even amid difficulty.

862.chongun: A single cannon blast startles birds and beasts. The beginning is difficult and the later part favorable, so the year should not be judged only by its first troubles. Happiness and tears alternate, and gossip requires care. A restless mind and frequent movement may leave hard work without clear reward. Even so, effort can help you reach what you seek. The text presents an unexpected gain or, alternatively, a blessing turning into a frightening setback. Beware of unforeseen mishaps throughout the year; setting sail on rough waves symbolizes more difficulties than favorable events. By the year’s end, trouble recedes and long-awaited resources accumulate. Endurance brings eventual progress. Sincere prayer at the start of the year is traditionally recommended.

months.1: Two bees fight, making nearby observers uneasy. Merely being close to a conflict may expose you to harm. Launching a boat on a rough sea is the image of hoping for safety in risky conditions. Difficulties outweigh favorable influences; practice restraint in all matters.
months.2: Obstacles make plans difficult to complete. Hard work may feel like energy spent on an empty prospect. Avoid the north. East and west are more favorable places to pursue your work.
months.3: Placing trust in others may bring loss rather than benefit. The text warns of gossip, an unexpected mishap or, alternatively, mourning. It recommends caution in all matters and traditionally suggests prayer beforehand for protection.
months.4: Hurrying east and west does not complete the work you hoped to finish. Resources are specifically associated with the west this month. An unusual illness is also pictured through the language of a troublesome influence. The traditional text recommends devoted observance morning and evening.
months.5: Seeking fish in the mountains symbolizes looking for a result in the wrong place. Illness or concern between spouses is mentioned. A favorable spirit nevertheless offers the image of peace amid danger. Practice moderation: even medicine taken in excess can become harmful.
months.6: Kind intentions and avoiding wrongdoing create breathing room amid adversity. Do not place unquestioning trust in a close acquaintance, who may cause financial loss and damage your reputation. Avoid new undertakings, since what is gained may be lost again. Act carefully throughout the month.
months.7: Maintain established work and remain settled. A long journey may bring trouble. Avoid quarrels and insisting only on your own view, as gossip is indicated. A substantial gain is difficult, but a modest one is possible.
months.8: Starting a venture is discouraged because the effort may end without income. Unexpected resources could nevertheless bring a delayed return even without activity. If no windfall occurs, the text instead mentions a needless fright. Keep your courage, as a better development lies ahead.
months.9: Effort produces little visible achievement, while the mind seems to drift in midair. Romantic entanglements are discouraged this month; the text links them to serious harm to household stability and reputation, followed by regret.
months.10: Being away from home may expose you to intermittent danger. Plans pursued along a difficult path are unlikely to reach completion. Avoid close dealings with strangers, which may bring significant loss. The traditional passage recommends prayer in advance to avert trouble.
months.11: Going to sea in pursuit of sudden riches symbolizes an unrealistic plan that drains your energy. Preserve existing work and stay steady rather than acting in excitement. Even if resources arrive, they may subsequently be lost.
months.12: Trouble finally withdraws and worries disperse. A helpful person brings support and a happy household event, ending a gloomy period. Strength and resources return together. Share your good circumstances through generous deeds.

863.chongun: A warm east wind brings spring flowers into splendor. Digging into the ground and finding gold symbolizes returns in proportion to effort. Household and financial circumstances are particularly favorable this year. Repeated blessings may bring unexpected recognition, a wider reputation and people who respect and follow you. Resources are plentiful and many undertakings proceed smoothly. Honor, prosperity and influence draw congratulations and fill the home with joy. Though appearances may seem modest, the substance within is well developed. You establish your position through honorable work and receive praise for both achievement and kindness. The traditional text recommends sincere prayer at the beginning of the year for an even more favorable course.

months.1: A dragon acquires many pearls, an image of abundant possibilities. Matters go as you wish, and resources may accumulate even at rest. Great blessings arrive without excessive ambition, helping you guide a stable household and retain a cheerful outlook.
months.2: Spring returns in every direction and living things revive. Resources and opportunities lift your confidence. Acting at the right time draws a helpful person to your work, and favorable conditions support your plans, multiplying your joy.
months.3: Trouble has retreated and favorable circumstances returned. Put your plans into action and you may obtain the result you seek. Prosperity supports expanding land or household resources, and the family may gain a member.
months.4: Heavenly blessings are pictured as bringing a happy development. A helpful collaborator may turn a modest expected result into a tenfold harvest. However, south is unfavorable; the text advises against traveling there.
months.5: Many expectations are fulfilled, bringing peace and a comfortable, quiet household. A family celebration, helpful people and honor or office are all indicated. Remembering hardship even amid prosperity is described as a mark of greatness.
months.6: Gold and jade fill the stores, symbolizing prosperity that you can enjoy freely. Personal worries are absent, good developments arise in many places, and resources accumulate. A peaceful, favorable period continues without a sense of lack.
months.7: Heaven and earth are pictured as helping your work, leaving a clear road ahead. Someone from the east may bring substantial resources, so cooperation with a favorable eastern connection is encouraged. Plans proceed toward completion.
months.8: A wish is fulfilled and you pursue business in peaceful circumstances. The passage first favors going farther afield over staying home, even suggesting work elsewhere. It then warns that fortunes could reverse and travel may be dangerous. Both directions are present in the original text.
months.9: A precious tree fills the courtyard with fragrance, symbolizing a family celebration. The old text specifically associates it with the birth of a cherished son. If that does not occur, it warns of possible financial loss and traditionally recommends sincere prayer beforehand.
months.10: Fish and dragons find water, bringing confidence and freedom. Resources are pictured beside the road, available through going out and seeking them. Many tasks reach completion, with favorable influences outweighing difficulties. The text also describes the arrival of a daughter who brings joy to the home.
months.11: Favorable circumstances sustain a flow of blessings. Progress continues without major obstacles, allowing the household to enjoy prosperity and peaceful days. Financial prospects are very good, though gossip is possible. Take particular care with speech.
months.12: The text offers household honor if no mourning occurs, describing adversity turning toward benefit. Resources and land may both be acquired, increasing comfort while work proceeds smoothly. An unexpected gain adds to the happiness and sense of abundance.
